name.zh: &honey Deep Moist Shampoo 1.0
name.en: &honey Deep Moist Shampoo 1.0

company.zh: ViCREA
company.en: ViCREA

launch.en: April 5, 2018

market.zh: 日本全国药妆、综合零售、品牌电商及跨境电商
market.en: Japanese drugstores, general retail, brand e-commerce and cross-border e-commerce

positioning.zh: 以“头发水分量 14%”和“保水有机美容”为核心，把蜂蜜、有机油和美容液成分组合成高保湿洗护体系。产品的核心差异是把整个洗护流程都指向“保持发丝水分”这一件事。系列化步骤编号、香味变化和高装饰性瓶身进一步强化仪式感。
positioning.en: Built around “14% hair moisture” and a moisture-organic beauty proposition. Honey, organic oils and beauty-serum ingredients are organized into a hydration system. The core difference is that the entire wash routine points to one goal — keeping hair hydrated. Numbered steps, changing fragrances and jewel-like packaging create ritual value.

target.zh: 面向干燥、毛躁、缺水、卷曲和希望获得明显滋润感的人群。品牌视觉年轻、甜美、适合社交媒体传播，核心用户更偏年轻女性，但实际购买人群很广。对细软、容易塌发的人群，Deep Moist 的丰润感可能偏重。
target.en: For consumers with dry, frizzy and moisture-depleted hair who want a rich conditioning feel. The brand’s visual language is young, sweet and social-media friendly, although its actual audience is broad.

distribution.zh: 440 mL / ¥1,540，与日本大众高机能洗护主流价位一致。全国药妆、Ainz & Tulpe、综合零售、电商覆盖广，渠道优势明显。长期在售与高评论量形成较强社会证明，替代成本来自品牌认知而非高技术壁垒。
distribution.en: 440 mL at ¥1,540, aligned with Japan’s mainstream mass-premium haircare segment. Wide drugstore, lifestyle retail and e-commerce distribution gives the brand a major channel advantage.

ingredients.zh: 品牌强调 90% 以上由蜂蜜、有机油、蜂王浆等保湿与保护成分构成，并使用摩洛哥有机油。蜂蜜配比故事为 Manuka 50%、Acacia 30%、日本生蜂蜜 20%。洗净体系配合油脂、保湿剂和调理成分，目标是减少洗后干涩并维持含水感。
ingredients.en: The brand emphasizes that more than 90% of the formula consists of honey, organic oils, royal jelly and other moisturizing or protective ingredients. The honey story uses a 50% Manuka, 30% Acacia and 20% Japanese raw honey blend.

evidence.zh: 公开资料主要是配方比例、成分来源、自由配方和消费者评论。没有在官方产品页看到完整临床或仪器测试方案。其证据优势来自长期市场销售、较高评论量和清晰的成分比例传播，而非公开临床研究。
evidence.en: Public evidence is mainly formula ratios, ingredient sourcing, free-from claims and large volumes of consumer reviews. No full clinical or instrumental study protocol was found on the official product page.

packaging.zh: 琥珀色透明液体、几何切面瓶和金色泵头第一眼就传递出很强的蜂蜜高级感，步骤编号让消费者自然理解使用顺序。这种包装是&honey最难被低成本复制的品牌资产之一。
packaging.en: The amber liquid, faceted bottle and gold pump read as high-end honey at first glance, with step numbering that makes the routine order obvious. This look is one of &honey's hardest-to-copy brand assets.

insight.zh:
&honey 用一个概念（保水）统一了整条产品线。

* 概念先行，成分是配角："水分量14%"这个数字比任何具体成分名都好记，配方本身不难仿，真正难复制的是围绕这个数字建立起来的整套体系（步骤编号、命名逻辑、瓶身设计）。
* 编号制造系统感：1.0/1.5/2.0 的步骤编号把护发变成一套要买齐才完整的系统，跟 Olaplex 的编号逻辑类似，但做在了消费级价位，直接拉高客单价和复购绑定。
* 定价卡在中间地带：走大众高机能（masstige）价位，靠"保水"这个普通人都懂的概念说服消费者，不需要专业沙龙渠道背书。

战略启示：一个简单、可感知的核心概念，比堆砌专业成分名更容易建立品牌记忆和跨渠道统一。
insight.en:
&honey uses a single concept, water retention, to unify its entire product line.

* Concept leads, ingredients follow: the "14% water content" number is more memorable than any ingredient name; the formula itself isn't hard to copy, but the whole system built around that number (step numbering, naming logic, bottle design) is.
* Numbering creates a system: the 1.0/1.5/2.0 step numbers turn hair care into a set you need to buy in full to feel complete — similar logic to Olaplex's numbering, but applied at a consumer price point, pushing up basket size and repeat purchase.
* Priced in the middle ground: sits in the mass-premium band, using an everyday-understandable concept ("water retention") to persuade consumers, with no need for salon-channel endorsement.

Strategic takeaway: one simple, perceptible core concept builds brand memory and cross-channel consistency more effectively than stacking up technical ingredient names.

name.zh: 8 THE THALASSO Moist Shampoo
name.en: 8 THE THALASSO Moist Shampoo

company.zh: Stella Seed
company.en: Stella Seed

launch.zh: 系列既有产品；现版本于 2025 年夏季更新
launch.en: Existing range; current version renewed in summer 2025

market.zh: 日本全国药妆、电商、Loft / PLAZA 等
market.en: Japanese drugstores, e-commerce, Loft, PLAZA and lifestyle retail

capacity.zh: 本体 475 mL / 替换装 400 mL

positioning.zh: “护肤化的保水美容液洗发水”。把海洋来源成分、干细胞提取物概念、PPT 系洗净成分和 84% 美容液成分整合为高保湿修护的宣称方向。差异点是“洗发步骤即美容液护理”这一整体概念，成分本身并不独特。
positioning.en: A skincare-inspired moisture serum shampoo that combines marine-derived ingredients, stem-cell-extract concepts, PPT cleansing agents and an “84% beauty serum ingredients” claim. Its differentiation is the overall idea that shampooing itself functions as a serum-care step; the individual actives are not unique.

target.zh: 核心面向干燥、毛躁、打结、缺乏光泽、有染烫或热工具损伤的人群。年龄并未在官方页面明确限定，视觉风格更接近重视成分感、简洁包装和药妆可得性的年轻至中青年消费者。
target.en: Aimed at people with dryness, frizz, tangling, dullness and damage from coloring, perming or heat tools. The minimalist packaging and ingredient-focused language appeal mainly to young and middle-aged beauty consumers.

distribution.zh: 本体 475 mL / ¥1,540；替换装 400 mL / ¥1,210。属于日本中价位大众高机能洗护，依赖药妆与大型生活方式零售触达，同时通过官方电商和平台电商覆盖。
distribution.en: 475 mL at ¥1,540 and a 400 mL refill at ¥1,210. It sits in Japan’s mid-priced mass-premium haircare segment, with broad distribution through drugstores, lifestyle retailers and e-commerce.

ingredients.zh: 氨基酸系洗净成分 + PPT 系洗净成分；代表成分包括 Cocoyl Hydrolyzed Collagen K、Cocoyl Hydrolyzed Keratin K。Polyquaternium-51 作为保湿与顺滑强化点，“Thalasso stem-cell formula”则是品牌复合概念。新版去除了 Olefin(C12-16) Sulfonate Na，意图降低强清洁印象。
ingredients.en: Amino-acid cleansing agents plus PPT-derived surfactants, including Cocoyl Hydrolyzed Collagen K and Cocoyl Hydrolyzed Keratin K. Polyquaternium-51 strengthens hydration and slip, while the “Thalasso stem-cell formula” acts as the brand’s composite technology claim.

evidence.zh: 当前公开页面以配方、成分功能及品牌内部比较为主。公开资料明确提到产品中 84% 为美容液成分，但该比例包含水；未看到完整第三方临床报告、详细样本量或公开统计结果。
evidence.en: Public materials focus on formula composition, ingredient functions and internal brand comparisons. The 84% beauty-serum figure includes water. No complete third-party clinical report or detailed sample size was found.

packaging.zh: 透明瓶身、垂直排版和银白配色营造出"实验室美容液"的克制冷感，第一眼传递的是专业感而非亲和力。系列扩张后不同功效款外观趋同，货架上不太容易一眼分辨具体是哪一款。
packaging.en: The clear bottle, vertical layout and silver-white palette create a restrained, lab-serum coolness, reading as clinical rather than approachable at first glance. As the range has expanded, different-benefit variants look increasingly alike, making them harder to tell apart on shelf.

insight.zh:
8 THE THALASSO 卖的是"洗发步骤等于护肤步骤"这句话本身。

* 数字是翻译不是新成分："84%美容液"本质是把配方里的水基成分重新翻译成护肤语言里的"美容液"，消费者听得懂、也愿意为这种翻译多付钱。
* 概念给旧成分找了新故事：干细胞、海洋成分在护发赛道不算新鲜，但绑定"Skinification（护肤化护发）"这个更大叙事后，变成了一个能被完整讲述的故事，而不是零散的成分清单。
* 定价不需要专业背书：走中端大众高机能价位，靠"护肤化"这个跨品类联想直接对普通消费者说话，不依赖沙龙渠道。

战略启示：给普通成分换一套更容易共情的语言体系，有时候比研发新成分更快建立差异化。
insight.en:
8 THE THALASSO sells the phrase "a shampoo step is a skincare step" itself.

* The number is a translation, not a new ingredient: "84% essence" is really the water-based portion of the formula re-labeled in skincare language, something consumers understand and are willing to pay a premium for.
* The concept gives old ingredients a new story: stem cells and marine ingredients aren't novel in haircare, but tying them to the bigger "skinification" narrative turns them into one coherent story instead of a scattered ingredient list.
* No professional endorsement needed: priced in the mid-tier mass-premium band, speaking directly to everyday consumers through the cross-category "skincare" association rather than relying on salon channels.

Strategic takeaway: reframing ordinary ingredients in a more relatable language can build differentiation faster than developing new ingredients.

ingredients.zh: 水、鲸蜡醇、甘油、双十八烷基二甲基氯化铵、肉豆蔻酸异丙酯、椰子油、水解角蛋白、丝氨基酸、水解米蛋白、泛醇（维生素B5）、乳木果油、聚季铵盐硅油-3、羟乙基纤维素等。
ingredients.en: Water, cetyl alcohol, glycerin, behentrimonium chloride, isopropyl myristate, coconut oil, hydrolyzed keratin, silk amino acids, hydrolyzed rice protein, panthenol (vitamin B5), shea butter, silicone quaternium-3, hydroxyethylcellulose, and more.

evidence.zh: 宣称主要基于品牌自述的科学驱动配方与成分功效描述，未见公开的独立第三方临床或仪器测试数据；用户评论中有反馈香精浓郁引发头痛等敏感问题。
evidence.en: Claims rest mainly on the brand's self-described science-driven formula and ingredient-function descriptions; no public independent third-party clinical or instrumental data found. Some user reviews note the fragrance is strong enough to cause headaches for sensitive users.

packaging.zh: 塑料瓶身配成分icon化标签，走的是药房货架的临床感路线，不追求精品化视觉。第一眼传递的是"便宜但专业"，而不是"奢华"。
packaging.en: A plastic bottle with icon-heavy labeling reads as drugstore-clinical rather than prestige. The first impression is affordable-but-scientific, not luxurious.

insight.zh:
Advanced Clinicals 把"cosmeceutical"这个护肤界的词直接搬进了平价发膜。

* 品牌名本身就是话语资产：同样是角蛋白+乳木果油配方，叫"Advanced Clinicals"比叫普通发膜听起来更有科学背书，即使背后临床数据并不更强。
* 借话语体系不需要走专业渠道：定价停在平价段，用"专业感包装"而不是专业沙龙渠道建立差异化，普通货架也能让消费者觉得"更科学"。
* 体验没完全跟上话语：香精浓度等细节缺少配套的"科学感"体验，说明话语体系可以借，但产品实际体验跟不上会打折扣。

战略启示：品牌命名和术语可以比研发本身更快复制到新品类，但产品体验跟不上，这种借来的信任会打折扣。
insight.en:
Advanced Clinicals transplants the skincare-world term "cosmeceutical" straight into a budget hair mask.

* The brand name is the language asset: the same keratin-plus-shea-butter formula sounds more clinically backed under the name "Advanced Clinicals" than a generic hair mask name, even without stronger clinical data behind it.
* Borrowed language doesn't need a professional channel: priced at the budget tier, differentiating through a "clinical-sounding" package rather than a salon channel — ordinary shelf presence is enough to feel "more scientific."
* Experience hasn't fully caught up: details like fragrance concentration lack the matching "clinical" feel, showing that language can be borrowed but the actual product experience needs to keep pace.

Strategic takeaway: brand naming and terminology can be copied into a new category faster than the underlying R&D, but if the product experience doesn't back it up, that borrowed trust erodes.

positioning.zh: 以键合强化科技（Bond Fortifying Technology）为核心的修护型洗发水，主打用1次即2倍强韧、减少55%断裂，走沙龙专业与美妆零售兼具的Masstige路线。
positioning.en: A repair shampoo built on Bond Fortifying Technology, positioned around 2x stronger hair with 55% less breakage after one use, a masstige play spanning both salon-professional and beauty-retail channels.

target.zh: 1-4c各类发质中因环境压力、热工具、化学处理导致受损脆弱的人群，尤其是高多孔发质；愿意为临床验证背书支付溢价的消费者。
target.en: All hair types 1-4c experiencing damage from environmental stress, heat tools or chemical treatments, especially high-porosity hair; consumers willing to pay a premium for clinically proven claims.

ingredients.zh: 水、C14-16烯烃磺酸钠、椰油酰胺丙基甜菜碱、甘油、椰油酰两性基二乙酸二钠、PEG-7椰油酸甘油酯、沙棘果/籽油、琉璃苣籽油、牛油果油、芒果籽脂、乳木果油、水解藜麦蛋白（植物蛋白）、薰衣草花提取物、洋甘菊花提取物、迷迭香叶提取物等。
ingredients.en: Water, sodium C14-16 olefin sulfonate, cocamidopropyl betaine, glycerin, disodium cocoamphodiacetate, PEG-7 glyceryl cocoate, sea buckthorn fruit/seed oil, borage seed oil, avocado oil, mango seed butter, shea butter, hydrolyzed quinoa (vegan protein), lavender flower extract, chamomile flower extract, rosemary leaf extract, and more.

evidence.zh: 宣称洗发水+护发素组合使用后1次即2倍强韧、减少55%断裂已经过临床验证；另有安全用于染发的临床验证宣称。完整测试方法、样本量与统计结果未公开披露。
evidence.en: Claims that the shampoo + conditioner system delivers 2x stronger hair with 55% less breakage after one use are described as clinically proven, as is a claim of being clinically proven safe for color-treated hair. Full protocol, sample size and statistics are not publicly disclosed.

packaging.zh: 薄荷绿瓶身配B Corp认证标识，第一眼传递的是"干净、可持续"而非"奢华"调性，符合amika一贯的Z世代环保定位。
packaging.en: The mint-green bottle with visible B Corp certification reads as clean and sustainability-driven rather than luxurious, consistent with amika's Gen-Z eco-conscious positioning.

insight.zh:
amika 靠"量化宣称+渠道背书"两件事一起做，把大众价位撑到了 Masstige。

* 数字比形容词更有说服力："1次即2倍强韧、减少55%断裂"这类具体数字，比"更强韧"这种模糊表述更容易被记住和转述，是从功效护肤借来的打法。
* 双线渠道同时占住两头：沙龙专业渠道+美妆零售双线铺货，既有专业背书又不牺牲购买便利，不用像纯沙龙品牌那样牺牲触达。
* 可持续认证是第三层叠加：跟数字宣称、渠道背书一起，把整体定价往上顶到了大众和沙龙线中间。

战略启示：单一网红成分容易被复制，但"量化数据+多元渠道+可持续认证"这套组合打法更难被平价品牌一次性抄走。
insight.en:
amika combines quantified claims with channel endorsement to push a mass-tier haircare product into masstige pricing.

* Numbers persuade more than adjectives: claims like "2x stronger, 55% less breakage after one use" are more memorable and shareable than vague phrases like "stronger" — a tactic borrowed from efficacy-led skincare.
* Two channels cover both ends: distributed through both professional salons and beauty retail, gaining professional credibility without sacrificing purchase convenience.
* Sustainability certification adds a third layer: stacked with the quantified claims and channel presence, together pushing the overall price point between mass and salon tiers.

Strategic takeaway: a single trendy ingredient is easy to copy, but the combination of quantified data, multi-channel presence, and sustainability certification is harder for a budget brand to replicate all at once.

positioning.zh: 以阿育吠陀余甘子（Amla）油与婆罗米（Brahmi）草本为核心的修护型发油，主打改善头发稀疏与断裂、打开受阻毛囊、促进头皮循环。
positioning.en: An Ayurvedic-inspired restorative hair oil built on amla oil and Brahmi herbal infusions, positioned to combat thinning and breakage while opening blocked follicles and improving scalp circulation.

target.zh: 面临头发稀疏、断裂困扰的天然发/纹理发消费者，偏好美食感命名与草本疗法定位的大众价位购物者。
target.en: Natural/textured-hair consumers dealing with thinning and breakage, drawn to gourmet-style naming and herbal-remedy positioning at a mass price point.

ingredients.zh: 余甘子果提取物、芝麻籽油、椰子油、荷荷巴籽油、橄榄油、夏威夷果籽油、乳木果油、可可籽脂、蜂蜜、生物素、MSM、田菁（Shikakai）提取物、鱼藤木果粉（Aritha）、婆罗米提取物、旱莲草提取物、茶树叶油、BTMS、无邻苯二甲酸盐香精。
ingredients.en: Amla fruit extract, sesame seed oil, coconut oil, jojoba seed oil, olive oil, macadamia seed oil, shea butter, cocoa seed butter, honey, biotin, MSM, shikakai extract, aritha fruit powder, Brahmi extract, bhringraj extract, tea tree leaf oil, BTMS, phthalate-free fragrance.

evidence.zh: 宣称主要基于阿育吠陀传统草本功效描述（余甘子、婆罗米），未见公开的第三方临床或仪器测试数据；电商评论中存在过蜡感/太重的负面反馈，提示配方感官体验因发质而异。
evidence.en: Claims lean mainly on traditional Ayurvedic herbal function (amla, Brahmi); no public third-party clinical or instrumental data found. E-commerce reviews include negative feedback about a waxy/heavy feel, suggesting sensory experience varies by hair type.

packaging.zh: 卡通感可可豆插画营造出"零食柜"式的亲切感，跟专业沙龙线的克制视觉形成明显反差。第一眼传递的是"平价好用"，而非精品调性。
packaging.en: The cartoonish cocoa-bean illustration reads like a snack aisle rather than a beauty counter, in sharp contrast to more restrained professional lines. The first impression is affordable and approachable, not premium.

insight.zh:
Camille Rose 靠"草本疗法+好吃的名字"两件事撑住纹理发市场的差异化。

* 命名比成分本身更抓眼球：余甘子、婆罗米这类阿育吠陀成分本身不算新，"Cocoa Nibs + Honey"这种美食感命名才是真正让人愿意拿起来看的部分——闻起来像甜点，用起来像药方。
* 定价没有明显溢价空间：走大众段，跟 SheaMoisture、Mielle 这类同赛道品牌直接竞争，靠命名和口碑建立记忆点，而不是价格差异化。
* 评论两极分化暴露复购风险：好评差评都很极端，说明差异化命名能带来第一次购买，但复购要靠肤感本身撑住，这支产品在这块还没完全过关。

战略启示：好名字能让人愿意试一次，但留住复购靠的是配方本身经不经得起反复使用的考验。
insight.en:
Camille Rose builds its differentiation in the textured-hair market on herbal remedy positioning plus a food-inspired name.

* The name grabs attention more than the ingredients: amla and brahmi aren't novel Ayurvedic ingredients, but a name like "Cocoa Nibs + Honey" is what actually makes people pick it up — it smells like dessert and works like a remedy.
* Little room for price premium: priced in the mass tier, competing directly with brands like SheaMoisture and Mielle in the same category, building memorability through naming and word of mouth rather than price differentiation.
* Polarized reviews expose a repeat-purchase risk: reviews swing between "holy grail" and "too heavy," showing a distinctive name drives the first purchase, but repeat purchase depends on how the formula actually feels on hair — something this product hasn't fully nailed.

Strategic takeaway: a good name earns a first try, but repeat purchase depends on whether the formula itself holds up to repeated use.

name.zh: Cécred Restoring Hair & Edge Drops
name.en: Cécred Restoring Hair & Edge Drops

company.zh: Cécred（Beyoncé Knowles-Carter）
company.en: Cécred (Beyoncé Knowles-Carter)

launch.zh: 品牌2024年2月20日成立；本品为持续在售单品
launch.en: Brand launched Feb 20, 2024; ongoing lineup item

market.zh: DTC官网 + Ulta Beauty（2025年4月起进驻1,400+门店）
market.en: DTC (cecred.com) + Ulta Beauty (1,400+ stores since April 2025)

positioning.zh: 每日使用的头皮密度精华，主打「密度肽」技术改善发际线与头发密度，是Beyoncé「hair is sacred」品牌仪式感定位的核心单品之一。
positioning.en: A daily scalp density serum built on peptide technology to improve edges and hair density, a hero item in Beyoncé's ritual-driven 'hair is sacred' brand positioning.

target.zh: 发际线稀疏、头发变细、追求「可见密度提升」的消费者；愿意为明星背书的高端仪式化护理买单的人群。
target.en: Consumers with thinning edges or reduced density seeking visible improvement; willing to pay a premium for a celebrity-backed ritual routine.

ingredients.zh: 核心为Biopeptide-5（Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3 + Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1），搭配专利Bioactive Keratin Ferment（乳酸菌/蜂蜜/角蛋白发酵物）、生物素、姜根提取物、玫瑰提取物、薄荷叶提取物。无硅油、SLS/SLES、邻苯二甲酸盐、Paraben。
ingredients.en: Built on Biopeptide-5 (Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3 + Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1) plus a patent-pending Bioactive Keratin Ferment (lactobacillus/honey/keratin ferment), biotin, ginger root extract, rose extract and peppermint leaf extract. Free of silicones, SLS/SLES, phthalates and parabens.

evidence.zh: 第三方消费者研究（16周）显示头发密度可见提升1.5倍；另有84%改善头皮与头发健康的宣称；皮肤科测试、沙龙测试。未见公开的仪器测量或对照组设计细节。
evidence.en: A third-party 16-week consumer study reports up to 1.5x visibly denser hair; also claims 84% improved scalp and hair health. Dermatologist- and salon-tested. Full protocol and control-group details are not publicly disclosed.

packaging.zh: 米白与金色的滴管瓶延续品牌一贯的仪式感，第一眼传递"专业+获奖背书"的可信度，而非单纯的高级感堆叠。
packaging.en: The cream-and-gold dropper bottle continues the brand's ritual aesthetic, reading as credible and award-backed rather than simply luxurious.

insight.zh:
Cécred 靠"仪式感定位+专利成分命名"把一支头皮精华卖到了高端价位。

* 专属命名是别人拿不走的资产：Biopeptide-5 这类专有名词，本质上可能只是常见多肽的品牌化命名，一旦注册成专属术语，配方能仿，名字仿不走。
* 仪式感对冲了功效品类的冷感：Beyoncé 的"hair is sacred"定位，把日常护理动作包装成自我关照的姿态，跟 Rogaine 这类纯功效药品的冷感形成明显反差。
* 对标的是功效赛道而非大众市场：竞品是 Vegamour、Rogaine 这类专业发际线护理品类，说明 Cécred 想抢的是原本靠药妆和处方产品占据的市场，不是大众洗护。

战略启示：名人光环加专属技术命名，可以让一个功效性品类跳过"平价教育市场"这一步，直接站上高端。
insight.en:
Cécred sells a scalp density serum at a premium price through ritual positioning plus a patented ingredient name.

* A proprietary name is an asset competitors can't take: Biopeptide-5 may essentially be a branded name for a common peptide, but once registered as proprietary terminology, the formula can be copied while the name can't.
* Ritual framing offsets the coldness of a functional category: Beyoncé's "hair is sacred" positioning turns a routine care step into an act of self-care, a sharp contrast to the clinical coldness of a purely functional product like Rogaine.
* Benchmarked against the efficacy category, not the mass market: its named competitors are Vegamour and Rogaine — professional hairline-care players — showing Cécred is targeting territory previously held by drugstore-medical and prescription products, not mass haircare.

Strategic takeaway: celebrity halo plus proprietary technology naming lets a functional category skip the "educate the mass market at a low price" step and go straight to premium.

positioning.zh: 13种植物油+萃取物组成的免洗发油，主打「无硅油仍有光泽」，密封水分、强化脂质屏障。
positioning.en: A leave-in oil blend of 13 botanical oils and extracts, positioned as 'shine without silicone', sealing moisture and reinforcing the hair's lipid barrier.

target.zh: 干燥、暗淡、中至粗发质，追求可携带、旅行友好护理的消费者。
target.en: Dry, dull, medium-to-thick hair; consumers who want a portable, travel-friendly treatment.

ingredients.zh: 非洲油组合（猴面包树籽油、辣木籽油、黑籽油）、沙棘果油、牛膝草提取物、Bioactive Keratin Ferment（乳酸菌/蜂蜜/角蛋白发酵物）；另含椰子油、甜杏仁油、蓖麻籽油、橄榄油、摩洛哥坚果油、亚麻籽油、金黄荷荷巴油、西瓜籽油等共13种油脂。
ingredients.en: African oil blend (baobab, moringa, black seed), sea buckthorn oil, hyssop extract, and Bioactive Keratin Ferment (lactobacillus/honey/keratin ferment); plus coconut, sweet almond, castor, olive, argan, flaxseed, golden jojoba and watermelon seed oils, 13 oils total.

evidence.zh: 宣称基于品牌方描述的成分功效（如沙棘富含omega脂肪酸与维生素E），未见独立第三方临床或仪器测试数据公开。
evidence.en: Claims are based on brand-stated ingredient functions (e.g. sea buckthorn's omega fatty acids and vitamin E); no independent third-party clinical or instrumental data is publicly disclosed.

packaging.zh: 旅行装延续正装的米白金色视觉，第一眼给人"缩小版奢华"的印象，而非廉价感的旅行装既视感。
packaging.en: The travel size mirrors the full-size cream-and-gold look, reading as a shrunken version of the same luxury rather than a downgraded travel afterthought.

insight.zh:
旅行装是 Cécred 用来降低高端品牌试用门槛的钥匙。

* 小规格是获客工具不是便携选项：正装价格高，旅行装用更低的决策成本让新客户"敢买第一次"，本质是拿小规格当获客手段。
* 要打破的是一个固有预设：13种植物油组合本身不算稀有成分，"无硅油仍有光泽"这句话才是真正要说服的点——消费者对无硅油配方普遍有"不够顺滑"的预设。
* 差异化更多来自人设而非配方：跟 Moroccanoil、OUAI 这些同样走精品护发油路线的品牌相比，Cécred 的差异化更多来自品牌人设（Beyoncé），配方本身并不独特。

战略启示：小规格试用装不只是方便携带，更是高价品牌降低首次购买门槛、换取长期复购的入口设计。
insight.en:
The travel size is Cécred's key to lowering the trial barrier for a premium brand.

* A small size is a customer-acquisition tool, not just a convenience: the full size is expensive, so the travel size lowers the decision cost enough for new customers to try it for the first time — essentially using a mini format to acquire customers.
* It's working to break a preset assumption: the 13-oil blend isn't a rare ingredient combination; the real persuasion point is "still shiny without silicone," since consumers generally assume silicone-free formulas feel less smooth.
* Differentiation leans on persona more than formula: compared with prestige hair-oil peers like Moroccanoil and OUAI, Cécred's differentiation comes more from its brand persona (Beyoncé) than from a genuinely unique formula.

Strategic takeaway: a small trial size isn't just about portability — it's an entry-point design that lowers the first-purchase barrier for a premium brand in exchange for long-term repeat purchase.

name.zh: Cécred 头皮清爽喷雾
name.en: Cécred Scalp Refreshing Spray

company.zh: Cécred（Beyoncé Knowles-Carter）
company.en: Cécred (Beyoncé Knowles-Carter)

launch.zh: 品牌2024年2月成立；旅行装为常规SKU
launch.en: Brand launched Feb 2024; travel size is a standard SKU

market.zh: DTC官网（含澳洲等海外站点）+ Ulta Beauty
market.en: DTC (incl. international storefronts e.g. AU) + Ulta Beauty

capacity.zh: 227 mL（8 fl oz，另有75 mL旅行装）
capacity.en: 8 fl oz / 227 mL (also available in a 2.5 fl oz travel size)

positioning.zh: 洗发之间的即时清洁，免冲洗喷雾，用定向喷头清洁头皮、分解堆积物与死皮，同时中和异味，不会打乱编发、假发等防护性发型。核心成分PhytoFerment（乳酸杆菌/紫柳树皮发酵提取物）负责舒缓头皮，搭配薄荷醇与樟脑带来清凉感。官方评分4.9/5（145条评价），是该品类里评价最高的单品之一。
positioning.en: Instant between-wash cleansing, a no-rinse spray with a targeted nozzle that cleanses the scalp, breaks down buildup and dead skin, and neutralizes odor without disturbing braids or protective styles like wigs. The core ingredient PhytoFerment (Lactobacillus/Salix Purpurea Bark Ferment Extract) soothes the scalp, paired with menthol and camphor for a cooling effect. Rated 4.9/5 by official reviewers (145 reviews), among the brand's highest-rated items.

target.zh: 编发、脏辫、护发造型期间需要头皮清洁但不便洗发的人群；旅行/差旅场景下需要快速清新头皮的消费者。
target.en: People wearing braids, locs or protective styles who need scalp cleansing without a full wash; travelers wanting a quick scalp refresh.

ingredients.zh: 水、聚山梨醇酯80、丙二醇、薄荷醇、樟脑、蜂蜜、神经酰胺NP、薄荷叶油、甘油、乳酸杆菌/紫柳树皮发酵提取物（PhytoFerment）、迷迭香叶油、一枝黄花提取物、白毛茛根提取物、桉树叶油、丁香叶油、茶树叶油、烟酸甲酯、苦橙花提取物、法国蔷薇花提取物、天竺葵花油、氯化十六烷基三甲铵、薰衣草油、薰衣草提取物、苦橙皮油、香精、苯氧乙醇、山梨酸钾、苯甲酸钠、苯乙醇、柠檬酸、柠檬烯、芳樟醇、香豆素、香茅醇、α-异甲基紫罗兰酮、羟基香茅醛、水杨酸苄酯、乙酸芳樟酯、广藿香油、四甲基乙酰基八氢萘。
ingredients.en: Water/Aqua/Eau, Polysorbate 80, Propanediol, Menthol, Camphor, Honey/Mel/Miel, Ceramide NP, Mentha Piperita (Peppermint) Oil, Glycerin, Lactobacillus/Salix Purpurea Bark Ferment Extract (PhytoFerment), Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Oil, Solidago Virgaurea (Goldenrod) Extract, Hydrastis Canadensis (Goldenseal) Root Extract, Eucalyptus Globulus Leaf Oil, Eugenia Caryophyllus (Clove) Leaf Oil, Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Leaf Oil, Menthyl Nicotinate, Citrus Aurantium Amara (Bitter Orange) Flower Extract, Rosa Centifolia Flower Extract, Pelargonium Graveolens Flower Oil, Cetrimonium Chloride, Lavandula Oil, Lavandula Extract, Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil, Fragrance (Parfum), Phenoxyethanol, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate, Phenethyl Alcohol, Citric Acid, Limonene, Linalool, Coumarin, Citronellol, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Hydroxycitronellal, Benzyl Salicylate, Linalyl Acetate, Pogostemon Cablin Oil, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes.

evidence.zh: 官方评价系统显示4.9/5（145条评价），属于电商评价数据，非独立第三方功效测试；官方未公开具体临床测试数据。
evidence.en: The official review system shows 4.9/5 (145 reviews), an e-commerce review metric rather than independent third-party efficacy testing; the brand hasn't disclosed specific clinical test data.

packaging.zh: 小巧喷雾瓶配定向喷头，第一眼传递的是"精准工具感"而非美妆产品的装饰性，功能优先于颜值。
packaging.en: The compact spray bottle with a targeted nozzle reads as a precision tool rather than a decorative beauty object, function over form.

insight.zh:
这支喷雾解决的是一个具体冲突——护理频率和造型保留打架。

* 瞄准的是一个真实的时间窗口：编发、护发造型耗时耗钱，做好后通常想尽量保留久，但头皮又需要定期清洁，这支产品正好卡在这个矛盾期。
* 使用场景的精准度比配方更重要：免冲洗+定向喷头的设计是为了不破坏已经做好的发型结构，产品形态是围绕这个场景专门设计的。
* 差异化仍落在品牌层面：跟 Klorane、Living Proof 这类经典干洗喷雾比，功能上没有本质区别，Cécred 的差异化仍然是品牌人设和渠道定位，不是产品形态创新。

战略启示：找到一个具体的使用场景冲突，比堆砌新成分更容易让消费者一秒理解"这个产品是为我设计的"。
insight.en:
This spray is designed around one specific conflict: care frequency versus style preservation.

* It targets a real time window: braided and protective styles take time and money, and once done, people want to keep them as long as possible — but the scalp still needs regular cleaning. This product sits right in that tension.
* Precision of use case matters more than the formula: the rinse-free, targeted-nozzle design exists specifically to avoid disturbing an already-set hairstyle; the product format is built around this scenario.
* Differentiation still sits at the brand level: functionally there's no real difference from classic dry-shampoo sprays like Klorane or Living Proof — Cécred's differentiation remains brand persona and channel positioning, not a new product format.

Strategic takeaway: finding one specific use-case conflict makes it easier for consumers to instantly feel "this product was made for me" than stacking up new ingredients.

name.zh: Cécred Heat Activated Silk Glaze
name.en: Cécred Heat Activated Silk Glaze

company.zh: Cécred（Beyoncé Knowles-Carter）
company.en: Cécred (Beyoncé Knowles-Carter)

launch.zh: 2026年3月17日上市（品牌首个造型系列Styling Collection的核心单品）
launch.en: Launched Mar 17, 2026 as a hero item of the brand's first Styling Collection

market.zh: DTC官网 + Ulta Beauty（官网售价US$34，Ulta同价，常有5%首单折扣）
market.en: DTC (cecred.com) + Ulta Beauty (US$34 at both; Ulta often runs a 5% first-order discount)

positioning.zh: 面向所有发质、尤其是做Silk Press的卷发/卷曲发人群的「热激活丝滑造型精华」——定位为凝胶与精华的混合新品类（gel-serum hybrid）：吹风时靠热与张力激活成膜，用更少的加热次数做出玻璃感直发，同时抗湿气抗毛躁，且可洗净还原自然卷度。
positioning.en: A heat-activated silkening styler for all hair types, aimed above all at the silk-press ritual in curly and coily hair. Positioned as a new gel-serum hybrid category: it activates under blow-dry heat and tension to form a weightless film, delivering glass-like straight styles with fewer heat passes while resisting humidity and frizz — and it washes out so natural texture returns.

target.zh: 做Silk Press／拉直造型的卷发与卷曲发人群；担心高温损伤但仍想要顺滑光泽的消费者；佩戴真人发假发/接发、以及做过化学处理头发的使用者。
target.en: Curly and coily consumers who silk-press or blow out their hair; users who want sleekness and shine but fear heat damage; wearers of human-hair wigs and weaves and those with chemically treated hair.

ingredients.zh: 水基配方，核心为品牌新技术StemShield Complex（形状记忆聚合物＋植物干细胞脂质＋黑蜂蜜发酵物），配合水解丝蛋白、Thermal Gloss Blend沙漠油混合（西瓜籽油/Mongongo油/野李籽油）、荷荷巴油、芦荟、泛醇，以及Polyquaternium-68与Polyquaternium-11两种成膜阳离子聚合物、瓜尔胶与黄原胶增稠体系。含香精（芳樟醇、香茅醇、香豆素等致敏物申报）。
ingredients.en: Water-based, built on the brand's new StemShield Complex (shape-memory polymers + plant stem-cell lipids + black honey fermentation), with Hydrolyzed Silk, a 'Thermal Gloss Blend' of desert oils (Kalahari melon seed, mongongo, wild plum), jojoba oil, aloe leaf juice and panthenol, plus two film-forming cationic polymers (Polyquaternium-68, Polyquaternium-11) and a guar/xanthan thickening system. Fragranced (linalool, citronellol, coumarin and other declared allergens).

evidence.zh: 官方宣称450°F/232°C耐热保护与抗湿气防护，标注为「专利申请中」的StemShield Complex；官网提供「有/无StemShield Complex」的对比视觉。截至2026年7月官网评分4.8/5（66条评价），100%推荐率。未见公开的仪器测量方法、样本量或对照组设计，属于品牌自述宣称层级。
evidence.en: Brand claims 450°F/232°C heat protection and humidity protection from a patent-pending StemShield Complex, illustrated with a with/without visual on the PDP. As of Jul 2026 the official page shows 4.8/5 from 66 reviews with a 100% recommend rate. No instrumental protocol, sample size or control design is published — these remain brand-level claims.

packaging.zh: 延续品牌米白金色仪式感视觉，第一眼跟同系列其他单品高度统一，传递"系列化护理"而非单品购买的印象。
packaging.en: Continues the brand's cream-and-gold ritual look, reading as part of a coordinated routine rather than a standalone purchase, visually unified with the rest of the range.

insight.zh:
这支产品的核心卖点是"少加热一次"这件事本身。

* 创造混合品类而非改良旧品类：把凝胶的定型力和精华的顺滑感合成一个新东西（gel-serum hybrid），绕开了"要顺滑就选精华、要定型就选啫喱"这个二选一。
* "少加热"回应的是一个健康顾虑：高温造型伤发是纹理发人群普遍的担忧，把功效诉求从"顺滑"换成"少伤害"，给同一个结果找了个更有说服力的理由。
* 竞品选了Olaplex、Mielle、Pattern这些同样服务纹理发/卷发市场的品牌，说明Cécred想抢的是这群人日常热造型环节的预算，不只是多卖一支精华。

战略启示：把两个原本分属不同产品的功能合成一个新品类，往往比单独做好其中一个更容易建立差异化。
insight.en:
This product's core selling point is the phrase "one less pass with the heat tool."

* Creates a hybrid category instead of improving an old one: combines a gel's hold with a serum's smoothness into one new thing (gel-serum hybrid), sidestepping the either/or between smooth and hold.
* "Less heat" answers a health concern: heat damage is a common worry for textured-hair users, reframing the benefit from "smoothness" to "less damage" gives the same outcome a more persuasive reason.
* Its competitors, Olaplex, Mielle, and Pattern, all serve the same textured/curly hair market, showing Cécred is competing for budget in the daily heat-styling routine, not just selling another serum.

Strategic takeaway: merging two functions that usually belong to separate products into one new category is often easier to differentiate than perfecting either one alone.

局限：未公开仪器测量方法、样本量与对照组设计，属品牌自述宣称
en: Brand claims: 450°F/232°C heat protection and humidity protection (patent-pending StemShield Complex)
Official site rating: 4.8/5 from 66 reviews, 100% would recommend (Jul 2026)
Visual evidence: with/without StemShield Complex demonstration on the PDP
Limitation: no instrumental method, sample size or control design disclosed — brand-level claims

zh: 质地：泵头凝胶精华（gel-serum hybrid），轻盈不压发
用法：湿发分4区，每区2泵→梳匀→立即带张力吹干→全干后夹板定型
关键限制：必须湿发使用、必须分区、变干需补水雾，操作门槛偏高
卖点感知：官方与用户反馈集中在光泽、顺滑与抗湿气，「亮而不腻」
提示：品牌自身提示频繁高温可能松弛天然卷型
en: Texture: pump gel-serum hybrid, lightweight and non-weighing
Usage: damp hair in 4 sections, 2 pumps each → comb through → blow-dry immediately with tension → flat-iron once fully dry
Key constraints: must be damp hair, must be sectioned, re-mist if it dries — a high execution barrier
Perceived benefit: shine, slip and humidity resistance dominate both brand and user language — 'glossy, not greasy'
Caveat: the brand itself warns that frequent high heat may loosen the natural curl pattern

zh.title: StemShield Complex（专利申请中）
zh.desc: 把形状记忆聚合物、植物干细胞脂质与黑蜂蜜发酵物打包命名为一套「屏障防护」技术，作为整个造型系列的共同技术底座，而非单品成分。

zh.title: 热与张力双激活的成膜设计
zh.desc: 配方不在涂抹时成型，而是依靠吹风的热量与梳子/圆梳的张力共同激活定型，因此产品说明把「分区、立即吹干、变干补水」写成必须遵守的步骤。

zh.title: 可洗净的可逆造型策略
zh.desc: 刻意设计为易洗净、卷度可还原，把「造型」与「化学拉直」区隔开——降低消费者对永久性改变发质的顾虑。

zh.title: 系列级可叠加验证
zh.desc: 造型系列7个SKU以「层层叠加不堆积」为共同开发前提，技术评估单位是组合而非单品。

en.title: StemShield Complex (patent-pending)
en.desc: Bundles shape-memory polymers, plant stem-cell lipids and black honey fermentation into one named barrier-protection technology that anchors the whole styling collection rather than a single SKU.

en.title: Dual heat-and-tension activation
en.desc: The formula does not set on application; it is activated by blow-dryer heat together with comb or round-brush tension, which is why sectioning, immediate drying and re-misting are written as mandatory steps.

en.title: Reversible, washes-out styling strategy
en.desc: Deliberately engineered to rinse out and let curl return, separating 'styling' from 'chemical straightening' and lowering the fear of permanently altering hair.

en.title: Collection-level layering validation
en.desc: All 7 styling SKUs were developed against a shared 'layer without buildup' requirement, so the unit of technical evaluation is the routine, not the product.

name.zh: HONEYQUE Rich Gloss Treatment
name.en: HONEYQUE Rich Gloss Treatment

company.zh: Bottle Works
company.en: Bottle Works

launch.en: September 13, 2023

market.zh: 日本药妆、电商及生活方式零售
market.en: Japanese drugstores, e-commerce and lifestyle retail

capacity.zh: 本体 450 mL / 替换装 400 mL

positioning.zh: 围绕“貯水リペア”和“蜜髪”构建光泽修护定位。产品把有机麦卢卡蜂蜜的保水故事、三种胶原蛋白的空洞损伤修护、角质层护理和热保护整合在一起，主打毛躁、粗硬、内部空洞化和光泽不足。
positioning.en: Positioned around water-retention repair and glossy “honey hair.” Organic Manuka honey, three collagen types, cuticle care and heat protection are combined to address frizz, coarse texture, internal hollow damage and lack of shine.

target.zh: 主要面向染烫、吹风和夹板使用频繁、发丝干燥粗糙、缺乏光泽及难以服帖的人群。视觉和香味偏女性化，但官方没有严格限定年龄。
target.en: For consumers with color, perm and heat-tool damage who experience dryness, roughness, poor shine and difficult manageability. The visual and fragrance direction is feminine, though the brand does not impose a strict age limit.

distribution.zh: 本体 450 mL / ¥1,650；替换装 400 mL / ¥1,210。属于日本大众高机能洗护的主流价位。药妆和电商是核心渠道，替换装有利于维持复购。
distribution.en: 450 mL at ¥1,650 and a 400 mL refill at ¥1,210. It occupies the mainstream Japanese mass-premium haircare price band, relying on drugstores and e-commerce for reach.

ingredients.zh: 核心故事包括有机麦卢卡蜂蜜、三种胶原蛋白、透明质酸衍生物、神经酰胺、角蛋白和水解丝。官方还提到 γ-Docosalactone 与水解芝麻蛋白衍生物作为热保护相关成分。
ingredients.en: Organic Manuka honey, three collagen types, a hyaluronic-acid derivative, ceramides, keratin and hydrolyzed silk. Heat-care ingredients support a story of retaining internal moisture and smoothing the cuticle.

evidence.zh: 官方公开页面主要提供成分功能、产品特征和热保护成分说明，未见完整公开的人体临床方案、仪器测试数据或样本量。其支撑更偏向成分机理与品牌内部产品开发逻辑。
evidence.en: Official communication mainly provides ingredient functions and product-development logic. No complete public human clinical protocol, instrumental data set or sample size was found.

packaging.zh: 柔和浅色瓶身与圆润泵头传递出"甜润但克制"的印象，比&honey收敛、比专业沙龙品牌亲和，卡在两者中间。
packaging.en: The soft-toned bottle and rounded pump read as sweet but restrained — less decorative than &honey, more approachable than salon-professional brands, sitting squarely between the two.

insight.zh:
HONEYQUE 把四种功效拼成一句话能讲完的故事。

* 保湿和修复不用二选一：蜂蜜保水+胶原蛋白空洞修护，两个原本各自独立的护发逻辑被打包进同一支产品，用户不用在"要保湿"还是"要修复"之间选。
* 走细分功效路线：跟 Gisou（蜂蜜叙事鼻祖）、OUAI（生活方式品牌）比，HONEYQUE 走的是更细分的日系精细功效路线，把光泽、毛躁、空洞化拆成具体问题逐一对应。
* 靠数量取胜而非单点极致：定价卡在大众高机能主流价位，没有走 Gisou 那种精品定价，靠功效点数量取胜。

战略启示：把多个功效点打包成一个整体故事，比单点极致更容易让消费者觉得划算，但也考验能不能把故事讲得不啰嗦。
insight.en:
HONEYQUE packs four benefits into one story that can be told in a single sentence.

* Hydration and repair aren't an either/or: honey for water retention plus collagen for hollow-damage repair — two separate haircare logics bundled into one product, so users don't have to choose.
* Takes a niche-benefit route: compared with Gisou (the originator of the honey narrative) and OUAI (a lifestyle brand), HONEYQUE goes for a more granular, Japanese-style precision-benefit approach, breaking shine, frizz, and hollowing into distinct problems each addressed individually.
* Wins on quantity, not a single extreme claim: priced in the mainstream mass-premium tier, not at Gisou's prestige level, competing through the number of benefit points rather than perfecting one.

Strategic takeaway: bundling multiple benefits into one overall story feels like better value to consumers than perfecting a single claim — but it also tests whether the story can be told without dragging.

positioning.zh: 打结今日终结，奶油质地的草本护发素/免洗顺发乳，专为浓密纠结的卷发/紧致纹理发梳理设计，可作冲洗型护发素或免洗使用。
positioning.en: Knot Today (a play on 'not today'), a creamy herbal conditioner/detangler for thick, tangle-prone curly and coily hair, usable as either a rinse-out conditioner or a leave-in.

target.zh: 浓密卷发/紧致纹理发、拆卸编发/延伸发后急需梳理的人群；天然发社群中配方极简的忠实拥趸。
target.en: Thick, curly/coily hair, especially post-braid or post-extension detangling needs; loyal natural-hair community members who favor minimalist formulas.

ingredients.zh: 有机芒果果提取物、有机榆树皮提取物、有机蜀葵根提取物、有机柠檬草提取物、鲸蜡醇、双十八烷基甲基硫酸铵甲基硫酸盐（Behentrimonium Methosulfate）、柠檬酸、苯氧乙醇、天然香精。
ingredients.en: Organic mango fruit extract, organic slippery elm, organic marshmallow root, organic lemongrass, cetyl alcohol, behentrimonium methosulfate, citric acid, phenoxyethanol, natural fragrance.

evidence.zh: 宣称主要基于成分描述与十余年的消费者口碑（天然发博主评测、社群评价），未见公开的独立临床或仪器测试数据。
evidence.en: Claims rest mainly on ingredient descriptions and over a decade of consumer word-of-mouth (natural-hair blogger reviews, community reviews); no public independent clinical or instrumental data found.

packaging.zh: 粉色手写体logo传递出怀旧、社群感的第一印象，识别度高但明显不走精品化路线。
packaging.en: The pink palette and handwritten-style logo read as nostalgic and community-driven at first glance, recognizable but clearly not positioned as premium.

insight.zh:
产品名本身就是承诺——"Knot Today"直接说出了要解决的问题。

* 名字比成分更快建立记忆："打结今日终结"这个双关名字，不需要看成分表就知道产品要做什么，降低了理解成本。
* 一瓶覆盖两种用法：冲洗型或免洗的双用途设计扩大了使用场景，同一瓶能覆盖不同护理步骤，提高了单品的使用频率。
* 靠口碑不靠预算：定价停在社群常青款价位，跟 Cantu、Uncle Funky's Daughter 这些同赛道品牌一样，靠社群口碑而非营销预算维持存在感。

战略启示：一个直接说出使用效果的产品名，比精致的成分故事更容易被口口相传。
insight.en:
The product name itself is the promise — "Knot Today" states the problem it solves right in the name.

* A name builds memory faster than ingredients: the pun "Knot Today" tells you what the product does without reading the ingredient list, lowering the comprehension cost.
* One bottle, two uses: the rinse-out-or-leave-in dual design widens the use occasions, letting a single bottle cover different steps and raising usage frequency.
* Runs on word of mouth, not marketing budget: priced at the community-staple tier, alongside peers like Cantu and Uncle Funky's Daughter, sustaining presence through community reputation rather than ad spend.

Strategic takeaway: a product name that states the result directly spreads by word of mouth more easily than an elaborate ingredient story.

positioning.zh: 欧莱雅专业线针对头屑与头皮微生态失衡人群推出的沙龙级治疗型洗发产品。适合希望获得比大众去屑洗发水更专业、更温和、更具美容护理体验的消费者，也适合由发型师推荐、愿意在沙龙或专业渠道购买的人群。
positioning.en: A salon-grade treatment shampoo from L'Oréal Professionnel, developed for people with dandruff and scalp micro-ecology imbalance. It suits people seeking a more professional and sensorial alternative to mass-market anti-dandruff shampoos, especially those who rely on salon recommendations.

target.zh: 核心消费者是反复出现可见头屑、同时担心头皮干燥、油腻或不适的人群。适合希望获得比大众去屑洗发水更专业、更温和、更具美容护理体验的消费者，也适合由发型师推荐、愿意在沙龙或专业渠道购买的人群。官方未限定性别；产品覆盖干性与油性头屑场景。
target.en: Designed for consumers with recurring visible dandruff who may also experience dryness, oiliness or discomfort. It suits people seeking a more professional and sensorial alternative to mass-market anti-dandruff shampoos, especially those who rely on salon recommendations. Official communication is gender-neutral and covers both dry and oily dandruff.

distribution.zh: 300 mL 与 500 mL 两种规格，主要依赖专业沙龙、L’Oréal Professionnel 官方渠道及各国授权零售。日本并非其最强本土渠道，进口电商价格差异较大，因此价格竞争力不如日本本土药妆洗护，但专业品牌形象和针对性头皮功效支撑了溢价。
distribution.en: Available in 300 mL and 500 mL sizes through professional salons, official L’Oréal Professionnel channels and authorized retailers. In Japan, import pricing varies considerably, so it is less price-competitive than domestic drugstore products. Its premium is supported by professional branding and targeted scalp efficacy.

ingredients.zh: 核心活性为 Piroctone Olamine，用于去屑及抑制与头屑相关的微生物；配方中还可见 Salicylic Acid、Glycerin、Coco-Betaine、Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride 等。整体是较经典的阴离子表活 + 两性表活洗净框架，通过珠光剂、保湿剂、调理聚合物及清凉感成分改善专业使用体验。品牌将其放入 Scalp Advanced 的皮肤学活性组合中，与 Niacinamide、AHA、Clay 等系列语言共同构建头皮“skinification”。
ingredients.en: The key active is Piroctone Olamine for dandruff control. The formula also includes Salicylic Acid, Glycerin, Coco-Betaine and Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride. The cleansing base is conventional, while humectants, conditioning polymers and sensorial modifiers improve the professional-use experience. The broader Scalp Advanced range frames these ingredients within a scalp-skinification story.

evidence.zh: 官方公开资料给出了较清晰的测试层级：首次使用后“最多去除 100% 可见头屑”为消费者测试；“最长 72 小时去屑保护”为临床测试；另有 44 名受试者、每周使用 3 次的临床测试描述，用于支持头屑外观减少。公开页面仍未完整披露各测试的详细设计、对照组和统计方法，因此适合归类为“有消费者与临床支持，但完整研究报告未公开”。
evidence.en: Official materials describe consumer and clinical testing, including removal of up to 100% visible dandruff after first use and protection lasting up to 72 hours. A 44-subject clinical test used three applications per week. However, full protocols, control design and statistical details are not publicly available.

packaging.zh: 大面积留白、黑色标识与浅蓝绿功能标签第一眼传递"临床、专业"的印象，但系列内单品外观相近，容易被误认成同一款。
packaging.en: Generous white space, a black logo and pale blue-green functional labels read as clinical and professional at first glance, though products across the range look similar enough to be mistaken for one another.

insight.zh:
这支产品卖的是渠道信任，不是配方本身。

* 专业推荐是买大众货架买不到的信任：走发型师推荐+沙龙渠道路线，把"专业推荐"变成购买理由的一部分，这是H&S这类大众货架产品拿不到的信任来源。
* 身份本身自带溢价：定价明显高于H&S，靠的不是配方本身有多突破，而是"沙龙专业线"这个身份本身自带溢价。
* 在自家专业线里切细分：跟 Kérastase、Aveda 同台竞争，说明欧莱雅是想在自己的专业线内部再切出一个"去屑治疗"细分品类，不是跟大众去屑品类正面竞争。

战略启示：渠道本身可以是一种定价资产——同样的配方放在沙龙渠道卖，比放在大众货架卖更容易被接受高价。
insight.en:
This product sells channel trust, not the formula itself.

* Professional endorsement is trust a mass shelf can't buy: going through stylist recommendation and salon channels turns "professionally recommended" into part of the purchase reason — a trust source mass-shelf products like Head & Shoulders can't access.
* The identity itself carries a premium: priced notably above Head & Shoulders, not because the formula is a breakthrough, but because "salon professional line" itself commands a premium.
* Carves out a niche within its own professional line: competing alongside Kérastase and Aveda shows L'Oréal is carving a "dandruff treatment" sub-category within its own professional line, not competing head-on with mass dandruff shampoos.

Strategic takeaway: the channel itself can be a pricing asset — the same formula sold through a salon channel is accepted at a higher price than the same formula on a mass shelf.

positioning.zh: 双用途定型泡沫，主打零结块的中至强定型力，既能定义卷发又能抚平直发边缘，强调不结块、不留白屑的专利聚合物技术。
positioning.en: A dual-use styling foam positioned around medium-to-firm hold without the crunch, defining curls or smoothing straight edges alike, built on a proprietary polymer for a no-flake, no-crunch finish.

target.zh: 追求手感柔软但持牢的卷发造型人群，也覆盖需要抚平边缘、抗湿度的直发/编发造型场景。
target.en: Curl stylers who want soft, touchable hold without stiffness, as well as those smoothing edges or fighting humidity for sleek/braided styles.

ingredients.zh: 水、聚季铵盐-55（Polyquaternium-55，核心定型聚合物）、椰油酰胺丙基羟基磺基甜菜碱、芦荟叶、PVP、生育酚乙酸酯、柠檬酸、丝氨基酸、聚山梨醇酯20、乙基己基甘油、Oleth-20、香精、甘油醚-2椰油酸酯、异硬脂酰胺丙基吗啉乳酸酯、苯氧乙醇、苯甲酸、依地酸二钠。
ingredients.en: Water, Polyquaternium-55 (the core styling polymer), cocamidopropyl hydroxysultaine, aloe vera leaf, PVP, tocopheryl acetate, citric acid, silk amino acids, polysorbate 20, ethylhexylglycerin, oleth-20, fragrance, glycereth-2 cocoate, isostearamidopropyl morpholine lactate, phenoxyethanol, benzoic acid, disodium EDTA.

evidence.zh: 宣称主要基于品牌自述的pH平衡配方与聚合物技术描述，未见公开的独立第三方临床或仪器测试数据；获多个行业奖项认可（品牌官网列为award-winning）。
evidence.en: Claims rest mainly on the brand's own description of a pH-balanced formula and polymer technology; no public independent third-party clinical or instrumental data found. The brand cites multiple industry awards (award-winning per the official site).

packaging.zh: 黑白撞色配大字产品名，第一眼传递年轻、街头文化的调性，明显区别于天然发品牌惯用的草本视觉。
packaging.en: The black-and-white color block with bold product-name type reads as youthful and street-culture at first glance, a clear departure from the herbal look typical of natural-hair brands.

insight.zh:
这支泡沫解决的是一个具体的技术痛点——定型力和不结块通常是矛盾的。

* 冲的是一个具体的配方矛盾：定型力越强通常越容易结块留白屑，这支产品的专利聚合物技术就是冲着这个矛盾去的，是个具体的配方工程问题，不是概念包装。
* 一瓶服务两种造型需求：双用途（卷发定型+直发抚平）扩大了适用发质范围，降低了消费者的选择成本。
* 差异化落在配方细节：定价在masstige造型品价位，跟DevaCurl、Cantu同台，差异化落在配方技术细节而非品牌故事。

战略启示：造型品类的差异化可以纯粹靠解决一个具体的配方矛盾，不一定需要额外的品牌叙事。
insight.en:
This mousse solves a specific technical conflict — hold strength and no flaking usually work against each other.

* Targets a specific formula conflict: stronger hold usually means more flaking and residue; this product's patented polymer technology is aimed directly at that conflict — a concrete formulation engineering problem, not conceptual packaging.
* One bottle serves two styling needs: the dual-use design (defining curls, smoothing straight edges) widens the applicable hair types and lowers the choice cost for consumers.
* Differentiation sits in formula detail: priced at the masstige styling tier alongside DevaCurl and Cantu, differentiating through formulation technicalities rather than brand story.

Strategic takeaway: differentiation in a styling category can rest purely on solving one specific formula conflict, without needing an added brand narrative.

insight.zh:
"唤醒你本来的卷度"这句话，把产品定位成恢复而不是改造。

* 针对一个具体的过程性问题：湿发时卷、干发后塌，这个过程性问题比笼统的"定型"更精准。
* 恢复而非改造更有社群共鸣："唤醒本来的卷度"暗示产品是在帮用户找回天然状态而不是强加新造型，这种说法对天然卷发社群更有共鸣。
* 靠口碑不靠营销预算：定价在社群常青款价位，跟同品牌的 Knot Today 一样走口碑路线。

战略启示：把"恢复原状"包装成产品承诺，比"改变现状"更容易获得强调天然、拒绝改造的细分社群认同。
insight.en:
"Awaken your natural curl" positions the product as restoration, not transformation.

* Targets a specific process-level problem: curly when wet, frizzy and flat once dry — a more precise problem than a generic "hold" claim.
* Restoration resonates more than transformation: "awaken your natural curl" implies the product helps users recover their natural state rather than imposing a new look, resonating more with the natural-curl community.
* Runs on word of mouth, not marketing spend: priced at the community-staple tier, same word-of-mouth route as the same brand's Knot Today.

Strategic takeaway: framing a product promise as "restoring your natural state" earns more trust from communities that value naturalness and resist transformation than a "changing you" framing does.

price.en: US$34 full size / US$16 travel; 10% off with subscription

positioning.zh: 以苹果醋为核心概念的高端清洁洗发水，定位为「每周一次的重置」而非日常洗发水：面向频繁使用干洗喷雾、造型品堆积、硬水地区的都市消费者，主打去除残留同时靠水解角蛋白保留强韧感。
positioning.en: A prestige clarifying shampoo built around an apple-cider-vinegar concept, positioned as a weekly reset rather than a daily wash: aimed at urban consumers heavy on dry shampoo, styling buildup and hard water, promising to strip residue while hydrolyzed keratin keeps hair feeling strong.

target.zh: 频繁使用干洗喷雾和造型品的都市消费者；硬水地区居民；头皮易出油、发丝暗沉的人群；被名人造型师背书吸引的年轻女性。
target.en: City consumers who lean on dry shampoo and styling products; people in hard-water areas; oily scalps and dull-looking hair; younger women drawn in by celebrity-stylist credibility.

ingredients.zh: 清洁体系为Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate（主表活）＋Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate＋Cocamidopropyl Betaine＋Decyl Glucoside的复配，属中强清洁；含Vinegar（醋）承接「苹果醋」概念，Hydrolyzed Keratin提供修护感，另有甘油、Polyquaternium-7调理。含香精（芳樟醇、香茅醇）与三种色素（Red 4 / Yellow 5 / Green 5）。标榜无Paraben、无邻苯二甲酸盐、无SLS/SLES、无麸质、不做动物实验。
ingredients.en: A medium-strong cleansing system of Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate (primary surfactant) with Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine and Decyl Glucoside. 'Vinegar' appears on the INCI to carry the apple-cider-vinegar concept, with Hydrolyzed Keratin for a repair cue plus glycerin and Polyquaternium-7 for conditioning. Fragranced (linalool, citronellol) and dyed with three colorants (Red 4 / Yellow 5 / Green 5). Marketed as paraben-, phthalate-, SLS/SLES- and gluten-free, cruelty-free.

evidence.zh: 官方页面未列出量化临床数据，宣称层级以功能描述为主（去除污垢、油脂、造型品残留与硬水沉积）。品牌反而用使用频次指引替代数据：干性发质建议每周1次起步，油性发质可1-2次/周。属于「用法建议＋感官承诺」而非循证支撑。
evidence.en: The official page publishes no quantified clinical data; claims stay descriptive (removes dirt, oil, product buildup and hard-water deposits). Instead of data the brand offers frequency guidance — start at once a week for dry hair, 1-2x weekly for oily hair. This is a usage-guidance-plus-sensory promise rather than evidence-led support.

packaging.zh: 绿色半透明瓶身与极简字体是货架上辨识度很高的品牌资产，第一眼传递环保与简约的调性，而非装饰性。
packaging.en: The green translucent bottle and minimal type are a highly recognizable shelf asset, reading as eco-conscious and understated at first glance rather than decorative.

insight.zh:
OUAI 把"清洁去残留"这个功能性动作重新定义成了一个生活方式仪式。

* 一句话把功能升级成仪式："每周一次的重置"把一支功能性去残留洗发水从日常用品升级成了生活方式步骤，跟冥想、断舍离这类概念处在同一话语体系里。
* 借用已有认知不用重新教育市场：苹果醋是消费者已经熟悉的天然清洁概念，护肤和家居清洁都在用，OUAI直接借用这个认知。
* 靠调性支撑溢价：定价在prestige生活方式护发价位，靠品牌调性和场景重新定义支撑溢价，不是靠配方本身多特殊。

战略启示：把一个功能性步骤重新包装成"仪式"，可以让同样的功能卖出更高的价格。
insight.en:
OUAI reframes the functional act of "clarifying buildup" as a lifestyle ritual.

* One phrase upgrades function to ritual: "a weekly reset" elevates a functional clarifying shampoo from a daily item into a lifestyle step, sitting in the same vocabulary as meditation or decluttering.
* Borrows existing awareness instead of educating the market: apple cider vinegar is already a familiar natural-cleansing concept from skincare and home cleaning, and OUAI borrows that awareness directly.
* Premium supported by tone, not formula novelty: priced at the prestige lifestyle-haircare tier, the premium is supported by brand tone and reframed occasion rather than a uniquely special formula.

Strategic takeaway: repackaging a functional step as a "ritual" lets the same function sell at a higher price.

company.en: The Doux (founded by Maya Smith; Black- and veteran-owned, based in Macon, Georgia)

launch.zh: 2024年2月上市，属品牌Classics系列的清洁位产品
launch.en: Launched Feb 2024 as the clarifying slot in the brand's Classics line

market.zh: 品牌官网 + Target + Sally Beauty + Amazon；英国等地有本地经销商
market.en: Brand DTC + Target + Sally Beauty + Amazon; local distributors in markets such as the UK

positioning.zh: 面向卷发与天然发人群的「不剥夺式深层清洁」洗发水：明确针对造型品堆积、油脂残留导致卷型塌陷的问题，主张洗到「squeaky clean」但仍保持柔软，是护理循环中的重置步骤而非日常洗发水。
positioning.en: A non-stripping deep-cleanse shampoo for curly and natural hair: explicitly aimed at product buildup and oil residue that flatten curl definition, promising squeaky-clean without the harsh strip. It is the reset step in a routine, not the daily wash.

target.zh: 卷发·卷曲发人群，尤其大量使用发油、发蜡、慕斯等造型品者；卷型因残留而失去弹性和定义度的人；寻找沙龙级但价格亲和产品的黑人消费者。
target.en: Curly and coily consumers, especially heavy users of oils, butters and mousses; those whose curl definition and bounce have collapsed under residue; Black consumers seeking salon-grade performance at an accessible price.

ingredients.zh: 清洁体系为Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate＋Cocamidopropyl Betaine的经典双表活组合，配方极简（仅约15个成分）：含PEG-6 Caprylic/Capric Glycerides增溶、Polyquaternium-10调理、洋甘菊与迷迭香叶提取物、维生素E乙酸酯（Tocopheryl Acetate）、甘油。不含硅油与蛋白质。
ingredients.en: A classic two-surfactant system of Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate plus Cocamidopropyl Betaine in a notably short INCI (about 15 ingredients): PEG-6 Caprylic/Capric Glycerides as solubilizer, Polyquaternium-10 for conditioning, chamomile and rosemary leaf extracts, tocopheryl acetate and glycerin. No silicones, no protein.

evidence.zh: 无量化临床数据，宣称建立在「沙龙实测（salon tested）」与「stylist created」的从业者背书上——品牌创始人本人是持证美容师并经营沙龙，配方经真实客户操作检验。这是一种以专业实践替代实验室数据的证据策略，在天然发社群中可信度高于数字。
evidence.en: No quantified clinical data; the claim base rests on practitioner endorsement — 'salon tested' and 'stylist created'. The founder is a licensed cosmetologist running her own salon, so formulas are validated against real clients. This substitutes professional practice for lab data, and in the natural-hair community that carries more credibility than numbers.

packaging.zh: 高饱和度色块配街头风字体，第一眼传递的是嘻哈文化调性而非传统美妆语言，产品命名本身也是这套调性的一部分。
packaging.en: High-saturation color blocking and street-style type read as hip-hop culture rather than conventional beauty language at first glance, with the product naming itself reinforcing that tone.

insight.zh:
这支产品要同时满足两个听起来矛盾的诉求——洗得干净和保持柔软。

* 直接回应一个共同顾虑："不剥夺式深层清洁"回应了纹理发人群的共同顾虑——深层清洁产品通常被认为会让卷发变干变硬，这个顾虑被直接写进了定位里。
* 降低使用频率预期，也降低心理门槛：定位成护理循环中的重置步骤而不是日常洗发水，降低了"会不会太刺激"的心理门槛。
* 靠精准回应顾虑建立差异化：定价在纹理发大众高机能价位，跟 Mielle、SheaMoisture 同社群竞争，靠精准回应顾虑而非价格建立差异化。

战略启示：直接说出目标用户最担心的顾虑，并证明产品不会触发这个顾虑，是清洁类产品最直接的说服方式。
insight.en:
This product needs to satisfy two seemingly conflicting demands at once — cleaning thoroughly while staying soft.

* Directly addresses a shared concern: "non-stripping deep cleanse" responds to a common worry in the textured-hair community that deep-cleaning products dry out and stiffen curls — that worry is written directly into the positioning.
* Lowers frequency expectation and the mental barrier: positioned as a reset step within a care cycle rather than a daily shampoo, lowering the "is this too harsh" concern.
* Differentiates by precisely addressing the worry: priced at the masstige textured-hair-care tier, competing with community peers like Mielle and SheaMoisture through precisely addressing the concern rather than price.

Strategic takeaway: naming the target user's biggest worry directly, then proving the product won't trigger it, is the most direct way to persuade in a cleansing category.

name.zh: OLAPLEX Nº.4 Bond Maintenance Shampoo
name.en: OLAPLEX Nº.4 Bond Maintenance Shampoo

company.zh: Olaplex Holdings, Inc.（NASDAQ: OLPX，总部美国加州）
company.en: Olaplex Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: OLPX, California, USA)

launch.zh: 2018年上市；据Circana为美国高端市场销量第一的洗发水（2024年1-12月）
launch.en: Launched 2018; the US #1 prestige shampoo by Circana (Jan-Dec 2024)

market.zh: 沙龙专业渠道 + Sephora/Ulta + 品牌DTC + Amazon；全球多市场本地站点
market.en: Professional salon channel + Sephora/Ulta + brand DTC + Amazon, with localized sites across global markets

capacity.zh: 250 mL / 8.5 fl oz（另有100 mL、1000 mL、2000 mL Jumbo）
capacity.en: 250 mL / 8.5 fl oz (also 100 mL, 1000 mL and 2000 mL jumbo)

positioning.zh: 键结修护品类的定义者，面向中至粗发质、各种卷度与孔隙度的受损发：以专利分子在分子层面重建二硫键，把「一次清洗即修复日常损伤」作为核心承诺，是从沙龙后台走向家用日常的旗舰洗发水。
positioning.en: The product that defined bond maintenance. Aimed at damaged hair from medium to coarse across all curl patterns and porosities, it rebuilds disulfide bonds at the molecular level and promises to repair everyday damage in a single wash — the flagship shampoo that carried bond repair from the salon backroom into daily home use.

target.zh: 染烫、漂发等化学处理后受损人群；频繁热造型者；追求「洗护即修护」而非额外护理步骤的消费者；沙龙客户的家庭延续护理。
target.en: Consumers with chemical damage from color, perming or bleaching; frequent heat stylists; those who want repair built into washing rather than as an extra step; salon clients continuing treatment at home.

ingredients.zh: 核心为专利分子Bis-Aminopropyl Diglycol Dimaleate（OLAPLEX Bond Building Technology）。清洁体系刻意避开SLS/SLES，采用Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate、Potassium Cocoyl Glycinate、Disodium Cocoyl Glutamate等椰油衍生温和表活复配；辅以Amodimethicone、Polyquaternium-10调理，透明质酸钠、泛醇、生物素、多种果提取物与向日葵籽油。无硫酸盐、SLS/SLES、邻苯二甲酸盐、MIC/MIT、Paraben；纯素、染发安全。
ingredients.en: Built on the patented Bis-Aminopropyl Diglycol Dimaleate (OLAPLEX Bond Building Technology). The cleansing base deliberately avoids SLS/SLES, using coconut-derived mild surfactants such as Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate, Potassium Cocoyl Glycinate and Disodium Cocoyl Glutamate, with amodimethicone and Polyquaternium-10 for conditioning plus sodium hyaluronate, panthenol, biotin, several fruit extracts and sunflower seed oil. Free of sulfates, SLS/SLES, phthalates, MIC/MIT and parabens; vegan and color-safe.

evidence.zh: 官方公布量化临床结果：与Nº.5搭配使用时90%更顺滑·更易梳理·更滋润，断裂减少49%，保湿提升73%；皮肤科测试。市场地位引用Circana美国高端市场2024年1-12月数据。需要注意的是，OLAPLEX的临床数据均由品牌自行委托，且2023年曾因用户脱发投诉引发集体诉讼与舆情危机，公司自2023年起营收持续承压（2026年Q1营收9,940万美元，同比+2.5%，全年指引为-2%至+3%）。
evidence.en: Quantified clinical results are published: used as a system with Nº.5, 90% smoother, better detangling and more conditioned, 49% less breakage and 73% more hydration; dermatologist tested. Market position cites Circana US prestige data for Jan-Dec 2024. Two caveats: all clinical data is brand-commissioned, and a 2023 class action over consumer hair-loss complaints triggered a reputational crisis. Revenue has been under pressure since — Q1 2026 net sales were US$99.4M (+2.5% YoY) against full-year guidance of -2% to +3%.

packaging.zh: 极简白瓶配巨大编号，第一眼传递的是"系统化护理"而非单品购买的印象，编号本身就是最容易被记住的品牌资产。
packaging.en: The minimal white bottle dominated by a huge number reads as a system to be collected rather than a single purchase at first glance, with the number itself the most memorable brand asset.

insight.zh:
Olaplex 卖的是品类，不是产品。

* 后来者都活在它定义的框架里：No.4 把自己定义成"键结修护"这个品类本身的起点，后来者（K18、Kérastase、Redken）不管配方多先进，都要先在"这是不是Olaplex平替"这个框架里被讨论。
* 专业下放本身就是护城河：从沙龙后台走向家用日常，是把原本只有专业发型师才懂的分子修护概念，翻译成消费者能自己在家完成的日常步骤。
* 先发定义权维持溢价：定价卡在prestige修护价位，即使后来者功能上追平甚至更强，Olaplex靠先发的品类定义权维持认知优势。

战略启示：第一个把一个技术概念命名并教育市场的品牌，即使后来配方被追平，仍然靠"品类代名词"这个位置维持溢价。
insight.en:
Olaplex sells a category, not a product.

* Later entrants live inside the frame it defined: No.4 defines itself as the origin point of the "bond repair" category itself, so later entrants (K18, Kérastase, Redken), however advanced their formulas, get discussed first through the frame of "is this an Olaplex alternative."
* Democratizing a professional concept is itself a moat: moving from the salon backroom to daily home use translates a molecular-repair concept once understood only by professional stylists into a step consumers can do themselves.
* First-mover category ownership sustains the premium: priced at the prestige bond-repair tier; even as later entrants catch up or surpass it functionally, Olaplex holds a perception advantage as the first to define the category.

Strategic takeaway: the brand that first names and educates the market on a technical concept keeps its premium through category ownership, even after formulas catch up.

en.title: Category Creation Through a Patented Molecule
en.desc: A single molecule invented and patented by materials scientists let OLAPLEX create the bond care category and hold definitional authority ever since. Before it, repair claims rested on silicones and cationic conditioners acting on the cuticle surface.

en.title: Numbered Product Architecture
en.desc: Replacing functional names with Nº.0 through Nº.9 turns the range into an ordered system, making cross-sell intrinsic to the architecture rather than dependent on marketing scripts.

en.title: Salon-First Technology Education
en.desc: Credibility was established in professional backbars first, with stylists doing the consumer education before retail scale-up — the prerequisite that made bond repair legible to the mass market.

en.title: System-Level Clinical Test Design
en.desc: Headline data is generated with Nº.4 and Nº.5 used together rather than as single products, which both improves the numbers and structurally steers shoppers toward buying the pair.

name.zh: OLAPLEX Nº.5 Bond Maintenance Conditioner
name.en: OLAPLEX Nº.5 Bond Maintenance Conditioner

company.zh: Olaplex Holdings, Inc.（NASDAQ: OLPX，总部美国加州）
company.en: Olaplex Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: OLPX, California, USA)

launch.en: Launched alongside Nº.4 in 2018; the US #1 prestige conditioner by Circana (Jan-Dec 2024)

capacity.en: 250 mL / 8.5 fl oz (also 100 mL, 1000 mL and 2000 mL jumbo)

positioning.zh: 与Nº.4构成系统的键结护发素，面向中至粗发质受损发：在提供顺滑与易梳理的同时把专利分子带入调理步骤，核心差异化是明确宣称「无蛋白」——直接回应键结修护人群最担心的蛋白过载僵硬问题。
positioning.en: The conditioner half of the Nº.4 system for damaged medium-to-coarse hair: it delivers slip and detangling while carrying the patented molecule into the conditioning step. Its sharpest differentiator is an explicit protein-free claim, answering the stiffness from protein overload that bond-repair users fear most.

target.zh: 化学处理与热造型受损人群；打结严重、梳理困难的中粗发质；已使用Nº.4希望完成系统的用户；担心蛋白过载导致发丝僵硬的消费者。
target.en: Users with chemical and heat damage; medium-to-coarse hair that tangles badly; Nº.4 users completing the system; consumers worried that protein overload will leave hair stiff.

ingredients.zh: 核心同为Bis-Aminopropyl Diglycol Dimaleate。调理体系以Cetearyl Alcohol、Behentrimonium Chloride、Cetrimonium Chloride等阳离子调理剂为主，配合Quaternium-91、多种硅（Divinyldimethicone/Dimethicone Copolymer、Amodimethicone、Polysilicone-15）；护理成分含水解透明质酸、泛醇、磷脂、鳄梨油、葡萄籽油、绿茶籽油与生物素。明确无蛋白，同时无硫酸盐、SLS/SLES、邻苯二甲酸盐、磷酸盐、MIC/MIT、Paraben。
ingredients.en: Also built on Bis-Aminopropyl Diglycol Dimaleate. The conditioning base leads with cetearyl alcohol, behentrimonium chloride and cetrimonium chloride, joined by Quaternium-91 and several silicones (divinyldimethicone/dimethicone copolymer, amodimethicone, polysilicone-15). Care actives include hydrolyzed hyaluronic acid, panthenol, phospholipids, avocado oil, grape seed oil, green tea seed oil and biotin. Explicitly protein-free, and free of sulfates, SLS/SLES, phthalates, phosphates, MIC/MIT and parabens.

evidence.zh: 官方公布：即时减少断裂66%并防护未来断裂，保湿提升91%，梳理性提升91%；皮肤科测试。市场地位引用Circana美国高端市场2024年1-12月数据。与Nº.4相同的局限：数据由品牌自行委托，未公开样本量与对照设计；且母公司自2023年舆情危机后营收持续承压。
evidence.en: Published claims: 66% less breakage instantly with defense against future breakage, 91% more hydration and 91% easier detangling; dermatologist tested. Market position cites Circana US prestige data for Jan-Dec 2024. Same caveats as Nº.4 — brand-commissioned data with no disclosed sample size or control design, against a parent company whose revenue has been under pressure since the 2023 reputational crisis.

packaging.zh: 跟Nº.4几乎一模一样的白瓶编号视觉，第一眼就传递"这两支必须一起买"的暗示，是编号玩法最直接的延伸。
packaging.en: Visually near-identical to Nº.4 — white bottle, big number — the pairing reads as 'buy both together' at first glance, the most direct extension of the numbering device.

insight.zh:
No.5 最大的卖点是它不做什么，不是它做了什么。

* 否定式宣称直击顾虑："无蛋白"直接回应键结修护人群最担心的问题——蛋白过载导致头发僵硬，别的品牌强调加了什么，No.5反着来。
* 编号在锁定成套购买：跟No.4搭配成系统，是Olaplex靠步骤化锁定用户的方式，买了No.4很自然会配No.5，编号本身在暗示"这是一套流程，不是单品"。
* 守住系统完整性：竞品都是新一代键结修护品牌（K18、Kérastase、Redken），说明这个赛道已经不是Olaplex一家独大，No.5要守住的是系统完整性这个阵地。

战略启示：说清楚产品不含什么，有时候比说清楚含什么更能精准打消目标用户的顾虑。
insight.en:
No.5's biggest selling point is what it doesn't do, not what it does.

* A negative claim addresses the concern head-on: "protein-free" directly answers bond-repair users' biggest worry — protein overload making hair stiff. Where others tout what they add, No.5 goes the other way.
* Numbering locks in the full set purchase: pairing with No.4 as a system is how Olaplex locks users into a step-by-step routine — buying No.4 naturally leads to No.5, the numbering itself implying "this is a routine, not a single item."
* Defending system completeness: its competitors are all next-generation bond-repair brands (K18, Kérastase, Redken), showing Olaplex no longer dominates the category alone — No.5's job is defending the completeness of the system.

Strategic takeaway: stating clearly what a product doesn't contain can address a target user's worry more precisely than stating what it does contain.

ingredientsNote.zh: 「无蛋白」是本品最重要的宣称设计：键结修护人群往往同时使用多个修护产品，蛋白叠加导致的僵硬和断裂是高频抱怨，因此在护发素这一必用步骤上明确无蛋白，实际是在为整个护理系统做风险控制。配方含多种硅，追求无硅routine的卷发人群需注意。
ingredientsNote.en: The protein-free claim is this product's most important design choice: bond-repair users typically stack several treatments, and the resulting protein overload — stiffness and snapping — is a frequent complaint. Declaring the mandatory conditioning step protein-free is effectively risk management for the whole routine. The formula does contain several silicones, so silicone-free curly routines should note this.

name.zh: OLAPLEX Nº.7 Bonding Oil

company.zh: Olaplex Holdings, Inc.（NASDAQ: OLPX，总部美国加州）

launch.zh: 2019年上市（日本2020年3月）；Allure Readers' Choice 2026获奖单品

market.zh: 沙龙专业渠道 + Sephora/Ulta + 品牌DTC + Amazon

positioning.zh: 把键结修护带入免洗造型环节的高浓缩美发油：2-3滴即可，同时承担光泽、抗毛躁、减少断裂与450°F热防护四重功能，是OLAPLEX编号系统里唯一的日常造型型产品，也是全线中最容易被非受损发人群接受的入口单品。
positioning.en: A highly concentrated styling oil that carries bond repair into the leave-in step: 2-3 drops deliver shine, frizz control, breakage reduction and 450°F heat protection at once. It is the only everyday styling product in the OLAPLEX numbering system and the easiest entry point in the line for people whose hair is not visibly damaged.

target.zh: 所有发质；频繁使用吹风机与直发夹板的人群；追求光泽与色彩鲜艳度的染发人群；希望以一支产品同时完成造型与热防护的消费者。
target.en: All hair types; frequent blow-dryer and flat-iron users; color clients chasing shine and vibrancy; consumers who want one product to handle both styling and heat protection.

ingredients.zh: 无水配方，基底为Dimethicone、Isohexadecane、C13-14 Isoparaffin、Coco-Caprylate与Phenyl Trimethicone的挥发性／成膜硅油体系；专利分子Bis-Aminopropyl Diglycol Dimaleate位列第六。护理成分含玉米油、β-胡萝卜素、向日葵籽油、石榴籽油、维生素E与绿茶籽油发酵滤液。无硫酸盐、磷酸盐、邻苯二甲酸盐、Paraben、无蛋白；纯素、染发安全。
ingredients.en: A waterless formula built on a volatile and film-forming silicone system — dimethicone, isohexadecane, C13-14 isoparaffin, coco-caprylate and phenyl trimethicone — with the patented Bis-Aminopropyl Diglycol Dimaleate sixth on the INCI. Care ingredients include corn oil, beta-carotene, sunflower seed oil, pomegranate seed oil, vitamin E and a green tea seed oil ferment filtrate. Free of sulfates, phosphates, phthalates, parabens and protein; vegan and color-safe.

evidence.zh: 官方公布：光泽提升125%（对照未使用本品的漂发）、72小时抗毛躁与抗湿气、断裂减少77%、450°F/232°C热防护。对照条件被明确写出（vs. 未使用本品的漂发），透明度高于同类；但仍为品牌自行委托测试，未公开样本量与仪器方法。
evidence.en: Published claims: 125% more shine (versus bleached hair without the product), 72-hour frizz and humidity control, 77% reduction in breakage and 450°F/232°C heat protection. The comparator is stated explicitly — more transparent than most peers — though the testing remains brand-commissioned with no disclosed sample size or instrumental method.

packaging.zh: 透明瓶身展示金黄油体，配合定量滴取瓶口，第一眼传递全系列里最"珍贵"的质感，包装本身参与了产品故事的讲述。
packaging.en: The clear bottle showing off the golden oil, paired with a metered-drop neck, reads as the most precious item in the line at first glance — packaging doing some of the storytelling itself.

insight.zh:
No.7 是Olaplex用来接触"没受损"人群的钥匙。

* 唯一的日常入口单品：整条编号系统里，No.7是唯一日常造型型产品，也是最不需要"我的头发受损了"这个前提就能购买的单品，功能上更接近大众发油品类。
* 用量设定拉长使用周期：2-3滴的用量把一支瓶子的使用周期拉得很长，单次使用成本被稀释，抵消了单价不低的观感。
* 借修护人设切入大众品类：跟Moroccanoil这类经典发油正面竞争，说明Olaplex是想借这支产品把"修护专家"人设延伸进普通消费者的日常护发油品类。

战略启示：一个技术型品牌想扩大用户群，与其说服核心用户买更多，不如做一支门槛最低的产品去接触边缘用户。
insight.en:
No.7 is Olaplex's key to reaching people whose hair isn't damaged.

* The only everyday entry item: the only styling product in the whole numbering system, and the one item that doesn't require "my hair is damaged" as a purchase prerequisite — functionally closer to a mainstream hair oil.
* Dosage stretches the usage cycle: a 2-3 drop dose stretches out how long one bottle lasts, diluting the per-use cost and offsetting its not-cheap sticker price.
* Uses the repair persona to enter a mainstream category: competing head-on with classic oils like Moroccanoil shows Olaplex using this product to extend its "repair expert" persona into everyday hair oil, beyond damaged-hair users.

Strategic takeaway: for a technical brand to grow its user base, building the lowest-barrier product to reach fringe users often works better than convincing core users to buy more.

ingredientsNote.zh: 这是一支以硅油为主体的产品：无水配方，前五位全为硅油与挥发性烷烃。对追求无硅routine的卷发人群不适用，但正是硅膜体系才使450°F热防护与72小时抗湿气成为可能——在热防护品类里，无硅与高性能目前仍难兼得。专利分子位列第六，添加量具备功能意义。
ingredientsNote.en: This is fundamentally a silicone product: waterless, with the top five slots all silicones and volatile alkanes. It does not suit silicone-free curly routines — but it is precisely the silicone film that makes 450°F protection and 72-hour humidity resistance possible; in heat protection, silicone-free and high performance remain hard to reconcile. The patented molecule sits sixth, at a functionally meaningful level.

en.concept: Bis-Aminopropyl Diglycol Dimaleate, invented by materials scientists Craig Hawker and Eric Pressly, is one of the very few molecules to genuinely create a category in hair care — OLAPLEX redefined 'repair' from surface conditioning to the chemical rebuilding of disulfide bonds, and built the entire bond-care segment on it.

zh.name: CÉCRED Heat Activated Silk Glaze
points: 用法极简（2-3滴，干湿发皆可），无严格分区吹干要求
一支同时覆盖光泽、抗毛躁、断裂与热防护四个诉求
Cécred在Silk Press这一具体场景的针对性更强，文化归属更明确

zh.name: Moroccanoil Treatment

热防护温度明确标称450°F，数据披露更完整
Moroccanoil的香型辨识度与沙龙渠道历史更悠久

points: Radically simpler use — 2-3 drops on damp or dry hair, with no strict sectioning and drying protocol
One product covering shine, frizz, breakage and heat protection at once
Cécred is sharper on the specific silk-press occasion and clearer on cultural belonging

en.name: Moroccanoil Treatment

States a specific 450°F heat rating with fuller data disclosure
Moroccanoil's scent recognition and salon-channel history run deeper

en.name: K18 Molecular Repair Hair Oil
points: Lower price in a smaller size, so the trial barrier is low
The system association created by the numbering is an asset K18 lacks
K18's peptide technology reads as a newer generation professionally, and claims results in four minutes

72-hour frizz and humidity control
77% reduction in breakage
450°F/232°C heat protection

Use: damp or dry hair, before or after heat, suitable daily
Texture: exceptionally light and non-greasy with excellent spread from the waterless base
Economy: 30 mL lasts months, so real cost per use is far below what the price suggests

zh.title: 无需承认损伤的入口型产品设计

zh.title: 无水高浓缩配方设计
zh.desc: 完全去水的硅油基底使单次用量压缩到2-3滴，既支撑「高浓缩」的价值主张，也让30 mL的小规格具备数月使用周期。

zh.title: 包装参与浓度感知的设计
