zh.title: 明确对照条件的宣称披露
zh.desc: 关键数据标注对照组（未使用本品的漂发），在自行委托测试的行业惯例中提供了相对更高的可验证性。

en.title: Entry-Product Design That Requires No Admission of Damage
en.desc: Leading on shine and heat protection rather than repair lets consumers who do not consider their hair damaged enter the brand system, breaking the audience ceiling inherent to repair-led brands.

en.title: Waterless High-Concentration Formulation
en.desc: A fully anhydrous silicone base compresses the dose to 2-3 drops, supporting the concentration value claim while giving a small 30 mL size a multi-month life.

en.title: Packaging as a Concentration Cue
en.desc: The metered-drop neck and the beta-carotene golden oil together build a precious, highly-concentrated perception at almost no formulation cost.

en.title: Claim Disclosure With a Stated Comparator
en.desc: Headline data names its control (bleached hair without the product), offering relatively higher verifiability within an industry norm of brand-commissioned testing.

name.zh: KUNDAL Airy Volume Hyaluron Shampoo
name.en: KUNDAL Airy Volume Hyaluron Shampoo

company.zh: THE SKINFACTORY Co., Ltd.（韩国首尔，2016年10月成立）
company.en: THE SKINFACTORY Co., Ltd. (Seoul, Korea; founded Oct 2016)

launch.zh: Airy Volume Hyaluron系列（洗发水／护发素双支线）
launch.en: Airy Volume Hyaluron line (shampoo + treatment)

price.en: US$20.90 (500 mL, Stylevana); US$41.99 for the shampoo+treatment set on Amazon

market.zh: 韩国、日本、东南亚跨境电商为主
market.en: Korea, Japan and Southeast Asian cross-border e-commerce

sources: KUNDAL official store — Airy Volume Hyaluron

positioning.zh: 面向细软塌发质与头皮容易出油人群的丰盈型洗发水：用8种形态的透明质酸做保湿，同时靠PHA与水杨酸衍生物清理头皮堆积，把「保湿」与「蓬松」这一对通常互相冲突的诉求放进同一支产品。定价在US$20上下，属于韩系大众线中偏上的位置。
positioning.en: A volumising shampoo for fine, limp hair and oil-prone scalps. It pairs eight forms of hyaluronic acid for hydration with a PHA and a salicylic-acid derivative to clear scalp buildup, putting two usually conflicting promises — moisture and lift — in one bottle. At around US$20 it sits at the upper end of the Korean mass tier.

target.zh: 细软发、扁塌发顶、头皮易出油但发梢干燥的消费者
target.en: Fine, flat-at-the-root hair with an oily scalp but dry ends

zh: 细软发质、发根容易扁塌的人群
头皮易出油但发梢干燥的混合型头皮
偏好韩系香氛型个护、看重香味的消费者
希望免硫酸盐但仍要清爽洗净感的用户
en: Fine hair that goes flat at the roots
Combination scalps — oily roots, dry ends
Shoppers who buy Korean personal care for fragrance
Users who want sulfate-free but still a clean-rinse feel

zh: 8种形态透明质酸复合保湿
AHA・PHA温和去角质，清理头皮堆积
免硫酸盐洗净基剂
专业调香师打造的signature香型
7种海藻提取物与6种植物水解蛋白
en: Eight forms of hyaluronic acid
AHA/PHA gentle exfoliation to clear scalp buildup
Sulfate-free cleansing base
Signature fragrance developed with professional perfumers
Seven seaweed extracts and six hydrolysed plant proteins

ingredients.zh: 洗净基剂为Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate配合Lauryl Betaine与Cocamide MIPA，属温和的磺基琥珀酸酯体系，无SLS/SLES。透明质酸以8种形态出现：Sodium Hyaluronate（标注110ppb）、Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate（阳离子化，可吸附于发丝）、Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate、Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid、Hyaluronic Acid、Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer、Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate、Potassium Hyaluronate。海洋成分包括裙带菜、海带、羊栖菜、Ecklonia cava、石莼、马尾藻、石花菜共7种提取物，另配海水（Maris Aqua）。蛋白部分为大豆、大米、豌豆、榛子、大麦共5种植物水解蛋白，加甘氨酸、谷氨酸、精氨酸三种游离氨基酸与生物素。
ingredients.en: The cleansing base is disodium laureth sulfosuccinate with lauryl betaine and cocamide MIPA — a mild sulfosuccinate system with no SLS or SLES. Hyaluronic acid appears in eight forms: sodium hyaluronate (labelled 110 ppb), hydroxypropyltrimonium hyaluronate (cationised, so it deposits on the fibre), sodium acetylated hyaluronate, hydrolysed hyaluronic acid, hyaluronic acid, sodium hyaluronate crosspolymer, hydrolysed sodium hyaluronate and potassium hyaluronate. Marine content covers seven extracts — wakame, kombu, hijiki, Ecklonia cava, Codium fragile, Sargassum and Gelidium — plus sea water. Proteins are five hydrolysed plant proteins (soy, rice, pea, hazelnut, barley) with glycine, glutamic acid, arginine and biotin.

ingredientsNote.zh: 品牌宣传写「AHA & PHA」，但全成分中只有Gluconolactone（PHA）与Capryloyl Salicylic Acid（水杨酸衍生物，通常归类为LHA），并没有甘醇酸、乳酸这类严格意义上的AHA。这一点在做同类宣称时需要留意合规边界。
ingredientsNote.en: Marketing says “AHA & PHA,” but the INCI list contains only gluconolactone (a PHA) and capryloyl salicylic acid (a salicylic derivative usually classed as LHA). There is no glycolic or lactic acid — no AHA in the strict sense. Worth noting when writing comparable claims.

zh.name: 8形态透明质酸复合物
zh.desc: 从小分子水解型到交联型再到阳离子化型，覆盖不同分子量与附着方式。其中Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate带正电，是唯一能在冲洗后仍附着于发丝的形态。

zh.name: Gluconolactone（PHA）
zh.desc: 分子量大于AHA，渗透慢、刺激低，同时具吸湿性。承担清理头皮堆积的角色。

zh.name: Capryloyl Salicylic Acid
zh.desc: 水杨酸的脂溶性衍生物（LHA），亲油性强，针对头皮皮脂堆积。

zh.name: 7种海藻提取物 + 海水
zh.desc: 裙带菜、海带、羊栖菜、Ecklonia cava等，构成KUNDAL区别于其他韩系品牌的成分识别点。

en.name: Eight-form hyaluronic complex
en.desc: From low-molecular hydrolysed to crosspolymer to cationised, covering different molecular weights and deposition routes. Hydroxypropyltrimonium hyaluronate is the only positively charged form, so it is the one that stays on the fibre after rinsing.

en.name: Gluconolactone (PHA)
en.desc: Larger molecule than an AHA, so it penetrates slowly with less irritation while also acting as a humectant. Handles the scalp-buildup job.

en.name: Capryloyl salicylic acid
en.desc: An oil-soluble salicylic derivative (LHA) that targets sebum buildup on the scalp.

en.name: Seven seaweed extracts + sea water
en.desc: Wakame, kombu, hijiki, Ecklonia cava and others — the ingredient signature that separates KUNDAL from other Korean mass brands.

zh.title: 多形态同成分堆叠
zh.desc: 把同一种功效成分拆成8种分子形态同时投料。单看每一种的添加量都不高（Sodium Hyaluronate标注110ppb），但成分表上连续出现8个hyaluronate词根，形成了强烈的视觉说服力。这是韩系大众线常见的成分表设计手法。

zh.title: 酸类分工：PHA管头皮、HA管发丝
zh.desc: 用大分子PHA与脂溶性LHA处理头皮侧的堆积，用阳离子化HA处理发丝侧的保湿，两条路径在同一支洗发水里分工，避免了「洗得干净就不保湿」的矛盾。

zh.title: 香氛前置的产品开发
zh.desc: KUNDAL全线以专业调香师开发的signature香型作为核心识别，Airy Volume Hyaluron也有Blossom Breeze等多个香型分支。对这个品牌来说香型是SKU分化的主轴，功效是次轴。

en.title: Stacking one active in multiple forms
en.desc: The same functional ingredient is split into eight molecular forms and dosed together. Individually the levels are modest (sodium hyaluronate is labelled at 110 ppb), but eight consecutive “hyaluronate” entries on the INCI list carry real visual persuasion. This is a common INCI-design tactic in the Korean mass tier.

en.title: Divided acid duties: PHA for scalp, HA for fibre
en.desc: A large-molecule PHA and an oil-soluble LHA handle buildup on the scalp side while cationised HA handles hydration on the fibre side. Splitting the two jobs inside one shampoo avoids the usual trade-off between a clean rinse and moisture.

en.title: Fragrance-first development
en.desc: KUNDAL builds its whole range around signature scents developed with professional perfumers, and Airy Volume Hyaluron branches into variants such as Blossom Breeze. For this brand fragrance is the primary axis of SKU differentiation and efficacy is the secondary one.

evidence.zh: 没有公开的临床或消费者测试数据，也没有第三方机构报告。可验证的只有全成分表本身（INCIDecoder与Hwahae均可查证，48个成分）与「110ppb」这一个具体数字。品牌宣称中的「AHA & PHA」与实际成分表存在偏差。整体属于成分表驱动型的说服结构，而非数据驱动型。
evidence.en: No published clinical or consumer test data and no third-party reports. The only verifiable material is the INCI list itself (48 ingredients, checkable on INCIDecoder and Hwahae) and the single “110 ppb” figure. The “AHA & PHA” claim does not match the actual list. Persuasion here rests on the ingredient list, not on data.

zh: Sodium Hyaluronate 110ppb（唯一公开的具体浓度数字）
全成分48项，第三方数据库可查证
无临床测试、无消费者测试、无第三方报告
宣称与成分表偏差：标示AHA但实际只有PHA与LHA
en: Sodium hyaluronate at 110 ppb — the only concentration figure published
48 ingredients, verifiable on third-party databases
No clinical test, no consumer test, no third-party report
Claim/INCI gap: labelled AHA but only PHA and LHA are present

zh: 泡沫：中等泡量，细密，冲洗顺畅无涩感
干后手感：轻盈蓬松，刻意不留厚重包覆感
局限：受损发单用可能润度不足，设计上依赖同系列护发素
香型：Blossom Breeze等多个花香分支，是SKU分化的主轴
规格：300 mL / 500 mL，大容量为主
en: Lather: moderate volume, fine bubbles, rinses clean without squeak
Dry feel: light and lifted, deliberately no heavy coating
Limitation: damaged hair may find it under-conditioned on its own — the design assumes the matching treatment
Fragrance: several floral variants such as Blossom Breeze, the main axis of SKU split
Sizes: 300 mL / 500 mL, weighted to the large size

packaging.zh: 细长瓶身配色随香型变化，第一眼传递韩系个护常见的"香型即配色"调性，主打大容量的性价比感。
packaging.en: The slim bottle's color shifts with the fragrance variant, reading as classic Korean personal-care 'scent equals colorway' at first glance, leaning into a value-size impression.

distribution.zh: 韩国本土线上为主，日本Qoo10、东南亚跨境电商，欧美通过Stylevana、YesStyle、Amazon等转售渠道
distribution.en: Mostly online in Korea, Qoo10 in Japan, Southeast Asian cross-border, and Stylevana / YesStyle / Amazon resale in the West

japan: Qoo10 Japan为主力渠道，品牌曾公开介绍日本市场进入策略
日本市场以香型与性价比为主要卖点
zh.channelDesc: 不依赖线下沙龙或药妆店，几乎全部销售来自跨境电商平台，渠道成本低但品牌控制力弱

global: K-beauty cross-border platforms such as Stylevana and YesStyle
japan: Qoo10 Japan is the main channel; the brand has publicly discussed its Japan entry strategy
Fragrance and value for money are the lead arguments in Japan
en.channelDesc: No salon or drugstore dependency — almost all sales come through cross-border e-commerce, which keeps channel cost low but brand control weak

zh.tagline: Nature meets science
zh.concept: KUNDAL以澳洲坚果油为基底，把植物提取物与配方技术结合，做面向大众的个护产品。品牌名取自德语与英语的组合，2016年在首尔创立，以香型开发与高性价比大容量规格快速扩张，是韩国增长最快的个护品牌之一。

en.concept: KUNDAL builds mass personal care on a macadamia oil base, combining botanical extracts with formulation technology. Founded in Seoul in 2016 with a name coined from German and English, it scaled fast on fragrance development and large-format value sizing, and is now one of Korea's fastest-growing personal care brands.

zh.name: 8 THE THALASSO Moist Shampoo（日本）
points: 两者都用海洋成分做保湿的技术外衣：8T是Thalasso干细胞与海洋来源成分，KUNDAL是Blue Marine Complex与海水、海藻提取物
8T把保湿量化成「84%美容液成分」这一个数字（含水），KUNDAL用透明质酸的多种形态与成分种类堆叠，没有可核对的比例
8T用PPT系氨基酸洗净成分，KUNDAL用磺基琥珀酸酯类免硫酸盐基剂，两者都在回避硫酸盐但走了不同路线
8T本体475 mL ¥1,540（约US$10）且有替换装，KUNDAL 500 mL约US$20.90——同为大容量，8T的日本本土价格明显更低

zh.name: &honey Deep Moist Shampoo 1.0（日本）
points: 同为「保湿+香型+高颜值包装」的组合，是最直接的可比对象
&honey把保湿收敛成蜂蜜一个概念并给出50/30/20的配比，KUNDAL堆叠透明质酸形态，&honey的说法更容易被记住
&honey有「头发水分量14%」这一个对外数字，KUNDAL的宣称中没有等价的量化表达
&honey 440 mL ¥1,540，单价高于KUNDAL；KUNDAL以500 mL大容量与跨境低价取胜

zh.name: CeraVe Gentle Hydrating Shampoo（美国）
points: 同样主打保湿，但保湿资产不同：CeraVe用3种神经酰胺加透明质酸讲屏障，KUNDAL用透明质酸多形态加海洋成分讲水润
CeraVe无香精、以皮肤科背书为核心；KUNDAL的香型是主要购买理由之一，两者对香精的处理完全相反
CeraVe 355 mL US$10.99（US$0.031/mL），KUNDAL 500 mL约US$20.90（US$0.042/mL），CeraVe单毫升更便宜
CeraVe的说服力来自品牌体系与渠道，KUNDAL来自香型与视觉，同一保湿诉求下两种完全不同的建立方式

en.name: 8 THE THALASSO Moist Shampoo (Japan)
points: Both dress hydration in marine ingredients: 8T with its Thalasso stem-cell concept and marine-derived actives, KUNDAL with Blue Marine Complex, sea water and seaweed extracts
8T reduces hydration to one number — 84% beauty serum ingredients, water included — while KUNDAL stacks hyaluronic acid forms and ingredient counts with no checkable ratio
8T uses PPT amino-acid cleansers; KUNDAL uses a sulfosuccinate sulfate-free base. Both avoid sulfates by different routes
8T is 475 mL at ¥1,540 (about US$10) with a refill; KUNDAL is 500 mL at about US$20.90. Both large format, but 8T is clearly cheaper in its home market

en.name: &honey Deep Moist Shampoo 1.0 (Japan)
points: The same combination of hydration, fragrance and high-appeal packaging — the closest direct comparison
&honey compresses hydration into one concept, honey, with a stated 50/30/20 blend; KUNDAL stacks hyaluronic acid forms. &honey's version is easier to remember
&honey has one external number, 14% hair moisture; KUNDAL's claims contain no equivalent quantification
&honey is 440 mL at ¥1,540 and costs more per mL; KUNDAL wins on 500 mL volume and cross-border pricing

en.name: CeraVe Gentle Hydrating Shampoo (USA)
points: Also hydration-led, but on a different asset: CeraVe argues barrier through three ceramides plus hyaluronic acid, KUNDAL argues moisture through multi-form hyaluronic acid plus marine ingredients
CeraVe is fragrance-free and built on dermatologist endorsement; fragrance is one of KUNDAL's main purchase reasons. The two treat fragrance in opposite ways
CeraVe is 355 mL at US$10.99 (US$0.031/mL) against KUNDAL's 500 mL at about US$20.90 (US$0.042/mL) — CeraVe is cheaper per mL
CeraVe's persuasion comes from brand system and channel, KUNDAL's from fragrance and visuals — two different builds under the same hydration claim

insight.zh:
这支洗发水解决的是一个配方矛盾——保湿通常意味着厚重，蓬松通常意味着轻薄。

* 两套系统分别应对两个诉求：8种透明质酸负责保湿，PHA和水杨酸衍生物负责清头皮堆积，分别应对"保湿"和"蓬松"这两个通常互斥的诉求，是具体的配方工程。
* 对标的是外部市场不是韩妆内部：竞品选了日本（8 THE THALASSO、&honey）和美国（CeraVe）品牌而不是韩系同行，说明这支产品实际对标的是外部市场里同样主打保湿叙事的品牌。
* 靠配方复杂度撑价：定价韩系大众线偏上，约US$20，用配方复杂度而非成分噱头支撑这个价位。

战略启示：把两个通常互斥的诉求做进同一支产品，本身就是一种技术差异化，不需要额外的品牌故事包装。
insight.en:
This shampoo solves a formula conflict: hydration usually means heaviness, and volume usually means lightness.

* Two systems address two demands separately: 8 forms of hyaluronic acid handle hydration, while PHA and salicylic-acid derivatives clear scalp buildup — addressing hydration and volume, two usually conflicting demands, through concrete formulation engineering.
* Benchmarked against the outside market, not Korean peers: its competitors are Japanese (8 THE THALASSO, &honey) and American (CeraVe) brands rather than Korean peers, showing it's actually benchmarked against outside brands with a similar hydration narrative.
* Formula complexity supports the price: priced at the upper end of the Korean mass tier, around US$20, supported by formula complexity rather than an ingredient gimmick.

Strategic takeaway: building two usually conflicting demands into one product is itself a technical differentiation, without needing an added brand story.

notes.zh: 资料采集日 2026-07-31。价格随跨境平台波动较大，以官方商城与Stylevana为准。
notes.en: Researched 2026-07-31. Prices swing across cross-border platforms; the official store and Stylevana are the reference points.

name.zh: Kérastase Chronologiste Bain Régénérant
name.en: Kérastase Chronologiste Bain Régénérant

company.zh: L'Oréal Professional Products Division（法国，Kérastase创立于1964年）
company.en: L'Oréal Professional Products Division (France; Kérastase founded 1964)

launch.zh: Chronologiste为品牌顶级抗老线，Bain Régénérant为该线洗发单品（现行配方为restage版本）
launch.en: Chronologiste is the brand's top-tier anti-ageing line; Bain Régénérant is its shampoo (current formula is the restage version)

price.en: US$23 (80 mL) / US$48 (250 mL) / US$73 (500 mL) on the US site; £33.50 (250 mL) in the UK

market.zh: 全球沙龙渠道与高端百货，Sephora等美妆零售
market.en: Global salon channel, prestige department stores and beauty retail such as Sephora

positioning.zh: Kérastase价格带最高的Chronologiste线中的洗发单品，面向被定义为「老化」的头发与头皮：以透明质酸、Abyssine与维生素E为核心，针对光泽流失、密度下降、纤维脆弱等被归纳为「五个可见老化征兆」的问题。250 mL售价US$48，单毫升成本约US$0.19，是本库中单价最高的洗发水。渠道以沙龙与高端零售为主，靠专业背书而非成分新颖度定价。
positioning.en: The shampoo in Chronologiste, Kérastase's highest-priced line, aimed at hair and scalp framed as ageing. Hyaluronic acid, Abyssine and vitamin E address what the brand groups into “five visible signs of ageing” — lost shine, reduced density, fragile fibre. At US$48 for 250 mL, roughly US$0.19 per mL, it is the most expensive shampoo in this library. Distribution runs through salons and prestige retail, and the price rests on professional endorsement rather than ingredient novelty.

target.zh: 40岁以上、感受到发量与光泽变化的高消费力人群，以及沙龙客单价较高的客户
target.en: High-spend consumers over 40 who notice changes in density and shine, and salon clients at the top of the ticket

zh: 感受到发量、光泽、纤维强度下降的中年以上人群
沙龙推荐驱动的高客单价客户
已经在使用高端护肤抗老产品、愿意把同一逻辑延伸到头发的消费者
对香氛与使用仪式有要求的用户
en: Older consumers noticing loss of density, shine and fibre strength
High-ticket salon clients who buy on stylist recommendation
People already using prestige anti-ageing skincare who extend the same logic to hair
Users who care about fragrance and the ritual of use

zh: 针对头发与头皮的「五个可见老化征兆」
透明质酸深层保湿并使发丝显得更丰盈
Abyssine强化并活化发纤维
维生素E抗氧化
洗后更强韧、柔软、顺滑，带弹性
en: Targets the “five visible signs of ageing” in hair and scalp
Hyaluronic acid hydrates deeply and plumps strands for a fuller look
Abyssine revitalises and strengthens the fibre
Vitamin E provides antioxidant support
Leaves hair stronger, softer, smoother and with more bounce

ingredients.zh: 洗净基剂为Sodium Laureth Sulfate配Coco-Betaine与Cocamide MIPA，是传统的硫酸盐体系——在这个价格带里属于少见的选择。功效成分为Sodium Hyaluronate与Hyaluronic Acid（双形态）、Alteromonas Ferment Extract（即品牌所称Abyssine，一种深海嗜极菌发酵产物）、Tocopherol与Bisabolol。另含Salicylic Acid与Glycolic Acid做头皮角质更新，Amodimethicone与Dimethicone做顺滑，2-Oleamido-1,3-Octadecanediol为神经酰胺类似物。香精成分包括Benzyl Salicylate、Hexyl Cinnamal、Limonene、Citronellol、Geraniol、Linalool、Hydroxycitronellal，对应ベルガモット・玫瑰・广藿香的香调。
ingredients.en: The cleansing base is sodium laureth sulfate with coco-betaine and cocamide MIPA — a conventional sulfate system, which is an unusual choice at this price. Actives are sodium hyaluronate and hyaluronic acid (two forms), Alteromonas ferment extract (the brand's Abyssine, from a deep-sea extremophile), tocopherol and bisabolol. Salicylic and glycolic acid handle scalp renewal, amodimethicone and dimethicone handle slip, and 2-oleamido-1,3-octadecanediol is a ceramide analogue. Fragrance allergens — benzyl salicylate, hexyl cinnamal, limonene, citronellol, geraniol, linalool, hydroxycitronellal — correspond to the bergamot, rose and patchouli accord.

ingredientsNote.zh: 值得注意的是，在US$48这个价格带上，Kérastase仍然使用SLES作为主洗净剂，而本库中US$10.99的CeraVe与US$20的KUNDAL都是免硫酸盐配方。这说明在专业沙龙线的语境下，「免硫酸盐」并不是溢价的必要条件——溢价来自品牌与渠道，不来自基剂选择。
ingredientsNote.en: Note that at US$48 Kérastase still uses SLES as the primary surfactant, while the US$10.99 CeraVe and the US$20 KUNDAL in this library are both sulfate-free. In the professional salon context, sulfate-free is evidently not a precondition for a premium price — the premium comes from brand and channel, not from the base.

zh.name: Abyssine（Alteromonas Ferment Extract）
zh.desc: 深海热泉嗜极菌的发酵提取物，原本以抗刺激与修护为主要功效被开发。Kérastase以专属命名的方式使用，是Chronologiste线区别于其他线的核心标识。

zh.name: 透明质酸（双形态）
zh.desc: Sodium Hyaluronate与Hyaluronic Acid同时投料，承担「让发丝看起来更饱满」的视觉诉求。

zh.name: Glycolic Acid + Salicylic Acid
zh.desc: AHA与BHA同时使用，处理头皮角质堆积。这是把护肤的酸类护理逻辑直接移植到头皮的做法。

zh.name: Tocopherol + Bisabolol
zh.desc: 维生素E负责抗氧化，红没药醇负责头皮舒缓，二者共同支撑「抗老」的整体表达。

en.name: Abyssine (Alteromonas ferment extract)
en.desc: A ferment from a deep-sea hydrothermal extremophile, originally developed for anti-irritation and repair. Kérastase uses it under a proprietary name, and it is the marker that separates Chronologiste from the brand's other lines.

en.name: Hyaluronic acid (two forms)
en.desc: Sodium hyaluronate and hyaluronic acid dosed together, carrying the visual promise of fuller-looking strands.

en.name: Glycolic acid + salicylic acid
en.desc: An AHA and a BHA together to handle scalp buildup — skincare acid protocols transplanted directly onto the scalp.

en.name: Tocopherol + bisabolol
en.desc: Vitamin E for antioxidant support and bisabolol for scalp comfort, jointly supporting the overall anti-ageing message.

zh.title: 「五个可见老化征兆」的问题框架
zh.desc: 把光泽、密度、强度等分散的诉求整合成一个可命名、可计数的框架。消费者不需要理解成分机理，只需要在五项里认领自己的问题。这个框架本身比配方更难复制。

zh.title: 成分专属命名（Abyssine）
zh.desc: Alteromonas Ferment Extract是可采购的原料，但以Abyssine之名出现后就成为Kérastase的资产。用命名建立独占感，而不依赖专利——这条路径成本远低于分子专利。

zh.title: 护肤逻辑向头皮的移植
zh.desc: 抗老、酸类角质更新、抗氧化，三条都是护肤的成熟叙述框架，被整体搬到头皮场景。L'Oréal集团内部护肤与护发的技术共享是这套移植的基础。

zh.title: 沙龙背书驱动的定价
zh.desc: 通过发型师推荐建立专业性认知，再由零售渠道承接。价格支撑来自渠道结构而非成分成本，这一点从配方仍使用SLES可以看出。

en.title: The “five visible signs of ageing” frame
en.desc: Shine, density and strength are gathered into one nameable, countable frame. The shopper does not need to follow any mechanism — only to recognise their own problem among the five. The frame is harder to copy than the formula.

en.title: Proprietary ingredient naming (Abyssine)
en.desc: Alteromonas ferment extract is a purchasable raw material, but under the name Abyssine it becomes a Kérastase asset. Exclusivity built by naming rather than patent — far cheaper than a molecular patent.

en.title: Skincare logic moved onto the scalp
en.desc: Anti-ageing, acid renewal and antioxidant support are three mature skincare frames transplanted wholesale to the scalp. Technology sharing between L'Oréal's skincare and haircare divisions is what makes the transplant possible.

en.title: Pricing carried by salon endorsement
en.desc: Stylist recommendation establishes professional credibility, and retail picks up the volume. The price is supported by channel structure rather than ingredient cost — visible in the fact that the formula still uses SLES.

evidence.zh: 没有公开的量化临床数据。官网与零售页面提供的是功效描述（更强韧、更柔软、更顺滑、更有弹性）与成分功能说明，未见百分比数字、样本量或测试方法。可引用性低。真正支撑购买的是Sephora上超过2000条评价与4.6的评分，以及沙龙渠道的口碑，属于社会证据而非实验证据。
evidence.en: No published quantitative clinical data. The official and retail pages offer benefit descriptions — stronger, softer, smoother, bouncier — and ingredient function copy, with no percentages, sample sizes or test methods. Citability is low. What actually supports purchase is over 2,000 reviews at 4.6 stars on Sephora plus salon word of mouth: social proof rather than experimental proof.

zh: 无量化临床数据公开，未见百分比、样本量或测试方法
Sephora评分4.6，评价数逾2000条（社会证据）
Kérastase澳洲站评分4.4，73条评价
支撑逻辑：沙龙专业背书 + 用户口碑 + 品牌历史（1964年创立）
可引用性：低。做对标资料时只能引用成分与定价，不能引用功效数字
en: No quantitative clinical data published — no percentages, sample sizes or methods
4.6 stars with over 2,000 reviews on Sephora (social proof)
4.4 stars with 73 reviews on the Kérastase Australia site
Support rests on salon endorsement, user word of mouth and brand history (founded 1964)
Citability: low. For benchmarking, only ingredients and pricing can be quoted — not efficacy figures

zh: 泡沫：SLES体系，泡量丰富，洗净感明确
质地：半透明凝胶状
香调：佛手柑・玫瑰・广藿香，Chronologiste全线统一，留香明显
规格设计：80 mL旅行装承担试用入口，500 mL承担复购
单次成本：250 mL约US$0.19/mL，为本库洗发水中最高
en: Lather: SLES base, generous foam, clear cleansing feel
Texture: translucent gel
Scent: bergamot, rose and patchouli — consistent across Chronologiste and noticeably long-lasting
Size strategy: the 80 mL travel size is the trial entry, the 500 mL is for repeat purchase
Unit cost: about US$0.19/mL at 250 mL, the highest of any shampoo in this library

packaging.zh: 深金瓶身配黑盖是Chronologiste线的固定配色，第一眼传递的是分量感与专业沙龙线的区隔度，跟同品牌其他系列一眼可辨。
packaging.en: The deep-gold bottle with a black cap is Chronologiste's fixed colorway, reading as substantial and clearly separated from Kérastase's other lines at first glance.

distribution.zh: 全球沙龙专业渠道、Sephora、Ulta、高端百货、品牌官网DTC
distribution.en: Global salon channel, Sephora, Ulta, prestige department stores and brand DTC

japan: 日本为Kérastase重要市场，沙龙渠道成熟
Chronologiste在日本定位为顶级抗老线
zh.channelDesc: 以发型师推荐建立专业性，再由高端零售承接销量。价格支撑来自渠道结构，不来自成分成本

japan: Japan is a major Kérastase market with a mature salon channel
Chronologiste sits as the top-tier anti-ageing line there
en.channelDesc: Stylist recommendation builds the professional case and prestige retail carries the volume. The price is supported by channel structure, not ingredient cost

zh.tagline: Luxury care for exceptional hair since 1964
zh.concept: Kérastase由L'Oréal于1964年创立，把沙龙专业诊断的方法带入家用护发。品牌以「先诊断、后配方」的结构组织产品线，每条线对应一类头发状态。Chronologiste是其中价格最高的一条，把护肤的抗老框架整体移植到头发与头皮。

en.tagline: Luxury care for exceptional hair since 1964
en.concept: Founded by L'Oréal in 1964, Kérastase brought salon diagnostic method into home haircare. The range is organised around diagnosis first, formula second, with each line matched to a hair condition. Chronologiste is the most expensive of them, transplanting the anti-ageing frame of skincare wholesale onto hair and scalp.

zh.name: OLAPLEX
points: OLAPLEX靠专利分子建立技术壁垒，Kérastase靠沙龙渠道与命名策略建立壁垒
OLAPLEX有公开的量化数据，Kérastase几乎没有——但价格更高
OLAPLEX的编号体系驱动交叉销售，Kérastase的分线诊断体系驱动的是客单价

zh.name: Aveda Invati
points: 同为沙龙渠道的抗老/密度线，Aveda以植物性与可持续为主要说法
Aveda公布了具体的减少脱发百分比，Kérastase没有
Kérastase的香氛与包装质感更强，Aveda的环保定位更明确

zh.name: Shiseido SUBLIMIC（日本）
points: 同为集团背景的沙龙专业线，SUBLIMIC以日本沙龙渠道为主战场
SUBLIMIC按发质细分而非按老化征兆细分，问题框架不同
价格带低于Chronologiste，在日本市场对Kérastase形成直接竞争

en.name: OLAPLEX
points: OLAPLEX builds its barrier on a patented molecule; Kérastase builds it on salon channel and naming
OLAPLEX publishes quantified data and Kérastase publishes almost none — yet Kérastase costs more
OLAPLEX's numbering drives cross-sell; Kérastase's diagnostic line structure drives basket size

en.name: Aveda Invati
points: Also a salon anti-ageing/density line, but built on botanical and sustainability arguments
Aveda publishes a specific hair-loss reduction figure; Kérastase does not
Kérastase is stronger on fragrance and packaging feel; Aveda is clearer on environmental positioning

en.name: Shiseido SUBLIMIC (Japan)
points: Another group-backed salon professional line, fighting mainly in the Japanese salon channel
SUBLIMIC segments by hair type rather than by signs of ageing — a different problem frame
Priced below Chronologiste and a direct competitor to Kérastase in Japan

insight.zh:
这支洗发水的定价逻辑跟配方好不好关系不大。

* 撑住价格的是渠道不是成分：单毫升成本US$0.19，是库里最贵的洗发水，但核心成分（透明质酸、维生素E）在大众线里也很常见，真正撑住价格的是渠道（沙龙+高端零售）和品牌线定位。
* 把模糊感受变成可拆解清单：把"老化"包装成"五个可见征兆"，是把一个模糊的感受（头发变差了）转译成看起来可以逐项治疗的问题，跟护肤抗老的话术逻辑一致。
* 抢的是专业护理心智不是价格：竞品选了Olaplex（修护赛道）和Aveda Invati（防脱赛道），说明Kérastase是在跟其他"专业术语驱动"的高端品牌抢占专业护理这个心智位置。

战略启示：把护肤行业的抗老化清单话术平移到护发品类，可以直接借用消费者已经熟悉的付费逻辑，不需要重新教育。
insight.en:
This shampoo's pricing logic has little to do with whether the formula is good.

* Channel, not ingredients, supports the price: at US$0.19/mL, it's the most expensive shampoo in this library, yet its core ingredients (hyaluronic acid, vitamin E) are common even in mass lines — the price is really supported by channel (salon plus prestige retail) and line positioning.
* Turns a vague feeling into a checkable list: packaging "aging" as "five visible signs" translates a vague feeling (my hair got worse) into a set of problems that look individually treatable — the same logic as anti-aging skincare copy.
* Competing for professional-care mindshare, not price: its competitors are Olaplex (repair) and Aveda Invati (anti-hair-loss), showing Kérastase is competing with other terminology-driven prestige brands for the "professional care" mental position.

Strategic takeaway: transplanting skincare's anti-aging checklist language into haircare borrows a payment logic consumers already understand, no re-education needed.

notes.zh: 资料采集日 2026-07-31。美国官网价格为US$23/48/73三档，英国250 mL为£33.50。Sephora US常有5%订阅折扣（US$45.60）。
notes.en: Researched 2026-07-31. US site lists US$23/48/73; the UK 250 mL is £33.50. Sephora US commonly shows a 5% subscription price of US$45.60.

name.zh: UNOVE Deep Damage Treatment EX
name.en: UNOVE Deep Damage Treatment EX

company.zh: 由韩国头皮护理品牌Dr.ForHair的技术开发，UNOVE为其损伤护理专线
company.en: Developed on the technology of Korean scalp-care brand Dr.ForHair; UNOVE is its damage-care line

launch.zh: Olive Young护发品类2022–2025连续获奖；2025年成为首个进入美国Sephora的韩国护发品牌
launch.en: Olive Young haircare award winner 2022–2025; in 2025 became the first Korean haircare brand to enter Sephora US

price.zh: US$11（40 mL）/ US$26（207 mL）/ US$36（320 mL），官方全球商城价
price.en: US$11 (40 mL) / US$26 (207 mL) / US$36 (320 mL) on the official global store

market.zh: 韩国Olive Young为核心，日本、美国Sephora、东南亚跨境
market.en: Olive Young in Korea at the core, plus Japan, Sephora US and Southeast Asian cross-border

positioning.zh: 面向染烫热损伤发质的高浓度蛋白发膜：以30,000 ppm的Keratin-PF为核心数字，配合36种蛋白质与氨基酸，主打「非现实的柔软」这一感官承诺。207 mL售价US$26，单毫升约US$0.13，在韩系发膜中属中高价位。产品在韩国由Olive Young渠道建立起量，再以「韩国销量第一」的身份进入海外。
positioning.en: A high-concentration protein mask for heat- and chemically-damaged hair. Keratin-PF at 30,000 ppm is the headline number, backed by 36 proteins and amino acids, and the promise is sensory: “surreal softness.” At US$26 for 207 mL, about US$0.13 per mL, it sits mid-to-upper in the Korean mask field. Volume was built through Olive Young in Korea, then exported on the strength of a number-one-in-Korea claim.

target.zh: 频繁染烫、使用热工具的受损发人群；追求即时柔顺手感的消费者
target.en: Frequently coloured, permed and heat-styled damaged hair; consumers chasing immediate softness

zh: 频繁染发、烫发的重度受损发
每日使用吹风机与直发夹板的人群
追求洗后立刻能感知柔顺变化的消费者
关注K-beauty话题、通过Olive Young或Sephora接触品牌的用户
en: Heavily damaged hair from frequent colouring and perming
Daily blow-dryer and flat-iron users
Consumers who want a softness change they can feel immediately after rinsing
K-beauty followers who meet the brand at Olive Young or Sephora

zh: Keratin-PF 高浓度30,000 ppm
36种蛋白质与营养成分
DeepCore™ Bond Technology
减少高温造成的损伤
专业调香打造的花香调
en: Keratin-PF at a high concentration of 30,000 ppm
36 proteins and nutritional ingredients
DeepCore™ Bond Technology
Reduces damage caused by high heat
A floral accord refined through expert perfumery

ingredients.zh: 配方骨架为Water、Glycerin、Dimethicone、Cetyl Alcohol、Behentrimonium Chloride、Cetearyl Alcohol——即高级脂肪醇加阳离子表面活性剂加硅油的经典重型调理体系，冲洗后的顺滑感主要由这一层贡献。功效层为水解角蛋白（Keratin-PF）、水解胶原蛋白、水解丝蛋白、丝氨基酸，以及丝氨酸、天冬氨酸、丙氨酸、组氨酸、精氨酸、苏氨酸等游离氨基酸，另配泛醇与摩洛哥坚果油、橄榄果油、澳洲坚果油。品牌宣称的「36种蛋白质与营养成分」即由上述水解蛋白与氨基酸合计而来。
ingredients.en: The backbone is water, glycerin, dimethicone, cetyl alcohol, behentrimonium chloride and cetearyl alcohol — the classic heavy conditioning system of fatty alcohols, a cationic surfactant and silicone. Most of the post-rinse slip comes from this layer. The functional layer is hydrolysed keratin (Keratin-PF), hydrolysed collagen, hydrolysed silk and silk amino acids, plus free amino acids including serine, aspartic acid, alanine, histidine, arginine and threonine, with panthenol and argan, olive and macadamia oils. The claimed “36 proteins and nutritional ingredients” is the sum of these hydrolysates and amino acids.

ingredientsNote.zh: 需要区分两件事：30,000 ppm即3%的水解角蛋白，在发膜类产品中确实是较高的添加量；但使用时感受到的柔顺，主要来自Behentrimonium Chloride与Dimethicone构成的调理层，而非角蛋白。把感官结果直接归因于角蛋白浓度，是这个产品说服结构中最需要留意的一处。
ingredientsNote.en: Two things need separating. Thirty thousand ppm is 3% hydrolysed keratin, which is genuinely high for a mask. But the softness users feel comes mainly from the conditioning layer of behentrimonium chloride and dimethicone, not from the keratin. Attributing the sensory result directly to keratin concentration is the part of this product's persuasion structure that most needs watching.

zh.name: Keratin-PF 30,000 ppm
zh.desc: 水解角蛋白，30,000 ppm即3%。以ppm为单位表述是这个品牌的标志性做法——数字看起来比「3%」大得多，说服力更强。

zh.name: Behentrimonium Chloride
zh.desc: 长链阳离子表面活性剂，是发膜柔顺感的主要贡献者。虽然不在宣传前排，但在成分表中位置靠前。

zh.name: 水解胶原蛋白・水解丝蛋白・丝氨基酸
zh.desc: 与角蛋白共同构成「36种蛋白质」的计数基础。不同分子量的蛋白覆盖发丝表面与皮质层不同位置。

zh.name: 摩洛哥坚果油・橄榄果油・澳洲坚果油
zh.desc: 提供封闭性与光泽，同时支撑「营养」的整体表达。

en.name: Keratin-PF at 30,000 ppm
en.desc: Hydrolysed keratin; 30,000 ppm is 3%. Expressing it in ppm is this brand's signature move — the number looks far larger than “3%” and reads as more convincing.

en.name: Behentrimonium chloride
en.desc: A long-chain cationic surfactant and the main contributor to the mask's slip. It is not in the front row of the marketing but it is high in the INCI list.

en.name: Hydrolysed collagen, hydrolysed silk, silk amino acids
en.desc: Together with keratin these form the count behind “36 proteins.” Different molecular weights address different positions on the surface and in the cortex.

en.name: Argan, olive and macadamia oils
en.desc: Provide occlusion and shine while supporting the overall nourishment message.

zh.title: ppm单位的数字表达
zh.desc: 3%的水解角蛋白写成30,000 ppm。同一个事实，后者在货架和详情页上的视觉冲击远大于前者。这是最低成本的差异化手法之一，不需要任何配方改动。

zh.title: DeepCore™ Bond Technology
zh.desc: 品牌命名的技术体系，用于对接近年来的键结护理话题。与OLAPLEX的专利分子不同，这是一个命名而非专利，具体机理未公开。

zh.title: 成分种类计数（36种）
zh.desc: 把水解蛋白与游离氨基酸合并计数，形成一个具体的数字。计数式表达在韩系产品中很常见，其作用是把「成分丰富」这一模糊印象转化为可记忆的数字。

zh.title: 渠道排名转化为品牌资产
zh.desc: Olive Young护发品类2022–2025连续获奖，被转化为「韩国销量第一」的对外表述，成为进入海外市场时的主要背书。

en.title: Expressing concentration in ppm
en.desc: Three percent hydrolysed keratin written as 30,000 ppm. Same fact, but the second version lands far harder on a shelf or a product page. It is one of the cheapest differentiation moves available and requires no formula change.

en.title: DeepCore™ Bond Technology
en.desc: A brand-named technology system that connects the product to the bond-care conversation. Unlike OLAPLEX's patented molecule this is a name rather than a patent, and the mechanism is not disclosed.

en.title: Counting ingredient types (36)
en.desc: Hydrolysates and free amino acids are counted together to produce one concrete number. Count-based expression is common in Korean products; it converts the vague impression of a rich formula into something memorable.

en.title: Turning a channel ranking into a brand asset
en.desc: Winning the Olive Young haircare category from 2022 to 2025 is converted into a “number one in Korea” statement, and that becomes the main endorsement when entering overseas markets.

evidence.zh: 可验证的是浓度数字（30,000 ppm）与渠道奖项（Olive Young 2022–2025），二者都属于可查证的事实。但没有公开的临床或仪器测试数据支撑「减少高温损伤」这一功效宣称，也未见断裂强度、光泽度等常见指标。DeepCore™ Bond Technology未公开机理。此外，Reddit上有用户报告长期使用后头发变干、变脆，与品牌宣称方向相反——蛋白类产品在缺少足够油脂平衡时确实可能导致这一结果，属于品类内的已知风险。
evidence.en: The concentration figure (30,000 ppm) and the channel awards (Olive Young 2022–2025) are both verifiable facts. But there is no published clinical or instrumental data behind the heat-damage claim, and no breakage-strength or shine measurements. The mechanism of DeepCore™ Bond Technology is undisclosed. Separately, Reddit users report hair becoming dry and brittle after prolonged use — the opposite of the claim. Protein products without enough lipid balance genuinely can produce that outcome; it is a known risk within the category.

zh: Keratin-PF 30,000 ppm（＝3%），可验证的浓度表述
36种蛋白质与营养成分（计数式表达，非功效数据）
Olive Young护发品类2022–2025连续获奖（渠道事实）
2025年首个进入美国Sephora的韩国护发品牌（渠道事实）
无临床数据、无仪器测试、DeepCore™机理未公开
用户端反向反馈：长期使用后干燥脆化的报告（蛋白过量风险）
en: Keratin-PF at 30,000 ppm (= 3%), a verifiable concentration statement
36 proteins and nutritional ingredients (a count, not efficacy data)
Olive Young haircare category winner 2022–2025 (channel fact)
First Korean haircare brand into Sephora US in 2025 (channel fact)
No clinical data, no instrumental testing, DeepCore™ mechanism undisclosed
Counter-signal from users: reports of dryness and brittleness after prolonged use (protein overload risk)

zh: 质地：厚重，介于护发素与发膜之间，单次用量较大
即时效果：冲洗后柔顺感明显，是口碑的主要来源
香型：花香调，Tender Bloom、Warm Petal等分支
规格：40 / 207 / 320 mL，小规格覆盖试用
使用注意：高蛋白配方不宜每次洗发使用，建议与保湿型产品交替
en: Texture: thick, between conditioner and mask, needs a generous dose
Immediate effect: clear softness after rinsing — the source of its word of mouth
Scent: floral, with Tender Bloom and Warm Petal variants
Sizes: 40 / 207 / 320 mL, with the small size covering trial
Caution: a high-protein formula is not for every wash and is better alternated with a moisture product

packaging.zh: 包装正面直接放大"30,000 ppm"这个数字作为主视觉，第一眼传递的是"数据说话"而非成分名堆砌，跨语言也能秒懂。
packaging.en: The front of pack leads with '30,000 ppm' as the primary visual, reading as data-driven rather than ingredient-name-driven at first glance, understood instantly regardless of language.

distribution.zh: Olive Young（韩国核心）、Sephora美国、Amazon日本官方店、Watsons东南亚、跨境电商
distribution.en: Olive Young (core in Korea), Sephora US, official Amazon Japan store, Watsons in Southeast Asia and cross-border e-commerce

global: Sephora美国（2025年进入，韩国护发品牌首例）
japan: Amazon日本官方店为主要渠道，207 mL约¥2,399–2,630
日本市场以「韩国销量第一」与柔顺手感为主要卖点
zh.channelDesc: 先在Olive Young单一渠道做到品类第一，再把渠道排名转化为出海时的品牌背书

global: Sephora US (entered 2025, the first Korean haircare brand)
japan: The official Amazon Japan store is the main channel; 207 mL runs about ¥2,399–2,630
Japan sells on the number-one-in-Korea claim and on softness
en.channelDesc: Become category number one inside a single channel — Olive Young — then convert that ranking into brand endorsement for export

zh.tagline: Surreal softness
zh.concept: UNOVE由韩国头皮护理品牌Dr.ForHair的技术孵化，专注损伤发护理。品牌把「非现实的柔软」作为唯一的核心承诺，所有产品线都围绕这一个感官目标组织，不做多方向诉求。2022年起连续获得Olive Young护发品类奖项，2025年成为首个进入美国Sephora的韩国护发品牌。

en.concept: UNOVE was incubated on the technology of Korean scalp-care brand Dr.ForHair and focuses on damaged hair. The brand holds a single core promise — surreal softness — and organises every line around that one sensory goal rather than spreading across claims. It has won the Olive Young haircare category since 2022 and in 2025 became the first Korean haircare brand to enter Sephora US.

zh.name: OLAPLEX Nº.3 / Nº.8
points: OLAPLEX有专利分子与公开数据，UNOVE有渠道排名与浓度数字
OLAPLEX强调结构性修复，UNOVE强调即时柔顺手感，说服路径完全不同
UNOVE价格更低、用量更慷慨，OLAPLEX单价高但技术背书强

zh.name: K18
points: K18主打4分钟见效与肽技术，UNOVE主打高浓度与感官
K18有第三方可查的分子研究，UNOVE的DeepCore™未公开机理
K18定位专业沙龙，UNOVE定位大众药妆渠道

zh.name: Mise en Scène Perfect Serum系列
points: 同为韩系损伤护理，Mise en Scène以免洗精华起家
UNOVE在冲洗型发膜的浓度表达上更激进
Mise en Scène有爱茉莉太平洋支撑，UNOVE靠Olive Young单渠道打穿

en.name: OLAPLEX Nº.3 / Nº.8
points: OLAPLEX has a patented molecule and published data; UNOVE has a channel ranking and a concentration number
OLAPLEX argues structural repair, UNOVE argues immediate softness — entirely different persuasion routes
UNOVE is cheaper and more generous per use; OLAPLEX costs more but carries stronger technical endorsement

en.name: K18
points: K18 leads on four-minute results and peptide technology; UNOVE leads on concentration and feel
K18's molecular research is checkable by third parties; UNOVE's DeepCore™ mechanism is undisclosed
K18 is positioned in professional salons, UNOVE in mass drugstore channels

en.name: Mise en Scène Perfect Serum range
points: Also Korean damage care, but Mise en Scène was built on leave-in serums
UNOVE is more aggressive about concentration claims in rinse-off masks
Mise en Scène has Amorepacific behind it; UNOVE broke through on a single channel

insight.zh:
"30,000 ppm"这个数字，是这支产品唯一需要记住的东西。

* 数字比形容词更好记：具体的浓度数字比"高浓度蛋白"这种形容词更容易被记住和转述，不需要理解Keratin-PF是什么，只需要记住一个够大的数字。
* 本土销量是出海的信任背书：先在韩国本土Olive Young渠道做出销量，再带着"韩国销量第一"出海，是韩妆常见的本土验证再出海打法。
* 直接对标国际修护品牌：竞品选了Olaplex、K18这些国际修护品牌，说明这支产品对标的不是韩妆内部，是想直接切入国际修护发膜市场。

战略启示：一个足够大、足够具体的数字，可以替代复杂的成分教育，本地销量记录也可以被包装成进入新市场的信任背书。
insight.en:
"30,000 ppm" is the one thing this product needs you to remember.

* A number is more memorable than an adjective: a concrete concentration figure is easier to remember and repeat than a vague "high-protein" claim — no need to understand what Keratin-PF is, just remember a big enough number.
* Domestic sales become an overseas trust credential: building volume first through Olive Young in Korea, then going overseas carrying a "#1 in Korea" credential — a common K-beauty playbook of validating locally before expanding.
* Benchmarked directly against international repair brands: its competitors are international repair names like Olaplex and K18, showing this product is targeting the global repair-mask market, not competing within K-beauty.

Strategic takeaway: a big enough, specific enough number can substitute for complex ingredient education, and a local sales record can be repackaged as a trust credential for entering a new market.

notes.zh: 资料采集日 2026-07-31。价格取自UNOVE官方全球商城；日本Amazon官方店207 mL约¥2,399–2,630。
notes.en: Researched 2026-07-31. Prices from the official UNOVE global store; the official Amazon Japan store lists 207 mL at about ¥2,399–2,630.

name.zh: CeraVe Gentle Hydrating Shampoo
name.en: CeraVe Gentle Hydrating Shampoo

company.zh: L'Oréal（CeraVe于2017年被欧莱雅收购，原属Valeant）
company.en: L'Oréal (CeraVe was acquired in 2017; previously Valeant)

launch.zh: 2024年11月，CeraVe首次进入护发品类的两条产品线之一（另一条为去屑线）
launch.en: November 2024 — one of the two lines with which CeraVe first entered haircare (the other being anti-dandruff)

price.en: US$10.99 (official site), about US$0.031 per mL

market.zh: 美国药妆与商超为主（Target、Walmart、Ulta、Amazon）
market.en: US drugstore and mass retail — Target, Walmart, Ulta, Amazon

positioning.zh: CeraVe把护肤端建立起来的屏障修护体系整体搬到头皮的第一支洗发水：三种神经酰胺（EOP、NP、AP）配合神经酰胺前体与胆固醇，加烟酰胺与透明质酸，主打「清洁但不破坏头皮屏障」。US$10.99／355 mL，单毫升约US$0.031，是本库中单价最低的洗发水。无香精、免硫酸盐、pH平衡、致敏性测试，面向敏感头皮。
positioning.en: CeraVe's first shampoo moves the barrier-repair system it built in skincare wholesale onto the scalp: three ceramides (EOP, NP, AP) with a ceramide precursor and cholesterol, plus niacinamide and hyaluronic acid, promising cleansing that does not disrupt the scalp barrier. At US$10.99 for 355 mL — about US$0.031 per mL — it is the cheapest shampoo in this library. Fragrance-free, sulfate-free, pH-balanced and allergy-tested, aimed at sensitive scalps.

target.zh: 敏感头皮、干性头皮人群；已经在使用CeraVe护肤产品并信任该体系的消费者
target.en: Sensitive and dry scalps, and existing CeraVe skincare users who already trust the system

zh: 敏感头皮、易受刺激的人群
干性头皮但不希望使用重型调理产品的用户
已在使用CeraVe护肤线、把同一逻辑延伸到头皮的消费者
所有发质与卷度，含染后发；官网标注适用年龄为3岁以上（页面另一处写13岁以上）
en: Sensitive, easily irritated scalps
Dry scalps that do not want heavy conditioning
Existing CeraVe skincare users extending the same logic to the scalp
All hair types and curl patterns including colour-treated; the site says ages 3+ in one place and 13+ in another

zh: 三种必需神经酰胺（EOP、NP、AP）
头皮与头发保湿维持72小时（消费者测试，与护发素配合单次使用后）
单次清洗后保湿度提升5倍、顺滑度提升10倍（对照：非调理型洗发水）
免硫酸盐、无香精、无邻苯二甲酸酯、无对羟基苯甲酸酯、无MIT
pH平衡、非致粉刺、致敏性测试、与皮肤科医生共同开发
en: Three essential ceramides (EOP, NP, AP)
Scalp and hair stay hydrated for up to 72 hours (consumer test, after one use with the conditioner)
5x more hydrated and 10x smoother after one wash (comparator: non-conditioning shampoo)
Sulfate-free, fragrance-free, phthalate-free, paraben-free, MIT-free
pH-balanced, non-comedogenic, allergy-tested, developed with dermatologists

ingredients.zh: 洗净基剂为Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate、Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate、Disodium Cocoamphodiacetate、Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate与Coco-Betaine的复配，全部避开SLS与SLES。屏障成分为Ceramide NP、Ceramide AP、Ceramide EOP三种神经酰胺，加Cholesterol与Phytosphingosine——后两者是护肤配方中构成屏障脂质三要素的标准组合，出现在洗发水中并不常见。另含Niacinamide、Sodium Hyaluronate、Salicylic Acid（低量）、Amodimethicone与Potato Starch Modified。全配方无香精。
ingredients.en: The cleansing base combines sodium C14-16 olefin sulfonate, disodium laureth sulfosuccinate, disodium cocoamphodiacetate, sodium lauryl sulfoacetate and coco-betaine — all avoiding SLS and SLES. Barrier ingredients are ceramide NP, AP and EOP plus cholesterol and phytosphingosine; those last two complete the standard barrier-lipid trio from skincare formulation and are uncommon in a shampoo. Also present are niacinamide, sodium hyaluronate, a low level of salicylic acid, amodimethicone and modified potato starch. The formula is entirely fragrance-free.

ingredientsNote.zh: 神经酰胺＋胆固醇＋植物鞘氨醇的组合是CeraVe护肤配方的核心结构，这次原样移植到洗发水。在冲洗型产品中这些成分的实际留存量存疑，但配方设计本身传达的信息很明确：这是把一整套护肤配方逻辑整体搬了过来，而非在洗发水里添加几个概念成分。
ingredientsNote.en: Ceramides plus cholesterol plus phytosphingosine is the core structure of CeraVe's skincare formulas, transplanted here unchanged. How much of it survives a rinse-off product is open to question, but the design communicates something clear: a whole skincare formulation logic has been moved across, rather than a few concept ingredients being added to a shampoo.

zh.name: 三种神经酰胺（EOP・NP・AP）
zh.desc: CeraVe二十年来的品牌识别成分，此次原样带入护发。消费者对这三个名字的认知已经在护肤端完成，护发端不需要重新教育。

zh.name: Cholesterol + Phytosphingosine
zh.desc: 与神经酰胺共同构成皮肤屏障脂质的标准配比结构。这两个成分出现在洗发水中是少见的，说明配方是从护肤端整体移植而非局部借用。

zh.name: Niacinamide
zh.desc: 维生素B3，护肤端的成熟成分，在头皮场景承担舒缓与屏障支持。

zh.name: Sodium Hyaluronate
zh.desc: 承担「72小时保湿」宣称的保湿主力。

en.name: Three ceramides (EOP, NP, AP)
en.desc: CeraVe's identifying ingredients for twenty years, brought into haircare unchanged. Consumer recognition of these three names was already built in skincare, so haircare needs no re-education.

en.name: Cholesterol + phytosphingosine
en.desc: With the ceramides these complete the standard ratio structure of skin barrier lipids. Seeing them in a shampoo is unusual and indicates a whole transplant from skincare rather than selective borrowing.

en.name: Niacinamide
en.desc: Vitamin B3, mature in skincare, here handling comfort and barrier support on the scalp.

en.name: Sodium hyaluronate
en.desc: The main humectant behind the 72-hour hydration claim.

zh.title: 护肤资产的跨品类迁移
zh.desc: CeraVe没有为护发线开发新的识别成分，而是直接使用护肤端已经建立认知的三种神经酰胺。品类扩张的成本主要落在配方适配上，认知教育成本接近于零。这是集团型品牌最有效率的扩张路径。

zh.title: 屏障脂质结构的完整移植
zh.desc: 神经酰胺、胆固醇、植物鞘氨醇三者按护肤配方的结构关系一起投料，而不是单独添加神经酰胺。这个细节把「加了神经酰胺」和「移植了屏障体系」区分开。

zh.title: 皮肤科医生共同开发的背书结构
zh.desc: CeraVe从护肤端沿用的核心背书方式。产品页直接引用具名皮肤科医生（Dr. Natasha Mesinkovska）的评价，这比匿名的「专家推荐」更具体，也更难被模仿。

zh.title: 系统化测试设计
zh.desc: 所有功效数字都标注「与护发素配合使用」的前提。测试设计本身把连带购买写进了数据条件，与OLAPLEX的Nº.4＋Nº.5做法一致。

en.title: Moving a skincare asset across categories
en.desc: CeraVe did not develop new signature ingredients for haircare; it used the three ceramides already recognised from skincare. The cost of category expansion falls on formulation adaptation, and the cost of consumer education is close to zero. This is the most efficient expansion route available to a group brand.

en.title: Transplanting the full barrier lipid structure
en.desc: Ceramides, cholesterol and phytosphingosine are dosed together in the structural relationship used in skincare, rather than adding ceramides alone. That detail separates “contains ceramides” from “the barrier system was moved across.”

en.title: The developed-with-dermatologists endorsement
en.desc: CeraVe's core endorsement structure, carried over from skincare. The product page quotes a named dermatologist (Dr. Natasha Mesinkovska), which is more specific — and harder to imitate — than anonymous expert recommendation.

en.title: System-based test design
en.desc: Every efficacy figure is footnoted “when used as a system with the conditioner.” The test design writes the attached purchase into the data condition, the same move OLAPLEX makes with Nº.4 plus Nº.5.

evidence.zh:
官网提供了三组量化数字：72小时保湿（消费者测试，单次使用洗发水＋护发素后）、单次清洗后保湿度5倍与顺滑度10倍（对照为非调理型洗发水）。对照条件与测试前提标注清晰，这一点优于本库中多数产品。

但同一页面内存在数字冲突：主视觉区写「5倍保湿・10倍顺滑」，Key Features区写「4倍保湿・12倍顺滑」，两组数据的脚注均为「与非调理型洗发水对照」。适用年龄也同时出现「3岁以上」与「13岁以上」两种表述。做对标资料引用时需要注明出处位置。此外所有数字均为品牌自行委托，无第三方机构报告。
evidence.en:
The site publishes three quantified figures: 72-hour hydration (consumer test, after one use of shampoo plus conditioner) and, after a single wash, 5x hydration and 10x smoothness against a non-conditioning shampoo. Comparators and test conditions are stated clearly, which is better than most products in this library.

But the same page contradicts itself. The hero area says 5x hydrated and 10x smoother while the Key Features section says 4x hydrated and 12x smoother, both footnoted against a non-conditioning shampoo. Age suitability appears as both 3+ and 13+. Any benchmarking citation needs to record which part of the page it came from. All figures are brand-commissioned with no third-party report.

zh: 72小时头皮与头发保湿（消费者测试，洗发水＋护发素单次使用后）
单次清洗保湿度5倍・顺滑度10倍（对照：非调理型洗发水）
同页面另一处：保湿度4倍・顺滑度12倍（同一对照条件）
pH平衡、非致粉刺、致敏性测试、临床测试
适用年龄同页面出现3岁以上与13岁以上两种表述
可引用性：中。对照条件标注清晰是优点，但页内数字冲突需注明出处
en: 72-hour scalp and hair hydration (consumer test, one use of shampoo + conditioner)
5x hydration and 10x smoothness after one wash (comparator: non-conditioning shampoo)
Elsewhere on the same page: 4x hydration and 12x smoothness, same comparator
pH-balanced, non-comedogenic, allergy-tested, clinically tested
Age suitability given as both 3+ and 13+ on the same page
Citability: medium. Clear comparators are a strength, but the on-page conflict means the source location must be recorded

zh: 泡沫：免硫酸盐复配基剂，泡量中等，细腻易冲洗
无香精：主动放弃香味差异化，换取敏感人群可用性
干后手感：偏干爽，设计上依赖同系列护发素
适用性：Ulta评价指出更适合中性至干性发质，油性发质可能觉得过润
经济性：355 mL／US$10.99，单毫升约US$0.031，本库最低
en: Lather: sulfate-free blend, moderate volume, fine and easy to rinse
Fragrance-free: gives up scent differentiation in exchange for usability by sensitive users
Dry feel: on the clean side; the design depends on the matching conditioner
Fit: Ulta reviews point to normal-to-dry hair; oily hair may find it too rich
Value: 355 mL for US$10.99, about US$0.031/mL — the lowest in this library

packaging.zh: 白瓶蓝字跟CeraVe护肤线一模一样，第一眼直接把"皮肤科信任感"嫁接到护发品类上，没有做任何护发专属的视觉区隔。
packaging.en: The white bottle with blue type is visually identical to the CeraVe skincare line, transplanting dermatologist-level trust onto a haircare product at first glance, with no visual concession to the category at all.

distribution.zh: Target、Walmart、Ulta Beauty、Amazon、CVS等美国药妆与商超渠道，另有澳新市场

en.concept: CeraVe has argued one thing for twenty years: three essential ceramides restore the skin barrier. Entering haircare in November 2024 it did not change the argument — it treated the scalp as a continuation of skin and organised the new line on the same barrier logic.

zh.name: 8 THE THALASSO Moist Shampoo（日本）
points: 同为保湿主张，成分资产方向相反：CeraVe用3种神经酰胺讲皮肤屏障，8T用海洋来源成分与Thalasso干细胞概念讲美容液
两者都把护肤语言带进洗发水，但CeraVe的背书是皮肤科医生与品牌体系，8T是「84%美容液成分」这一个数字（含水）
CeraVe无香精、无硫酸盐，8T保留Aqua White Floral香型并把香氛作为体验的一部分
CeraVe 355 mL US$10.99（US$0.031/mL），8T本体475 mL ¥1,540且有替换装，两者都属大众价位，8T的规格与补充装体系更完整

CeraVe渠道覆盖与品牌声量远大于Vanicream

CeraVe的屏障脂质结构更完整，Aveeno的天然定位更清晰

en.name: 8 THE THALASSO Moist Shampoo (Japan)
points: Both lead on hydration from opposite ingredient assets: CeraVe argues the skin barrier through three ceramides, 8T argues a beauty serum through marine-derived actives and its Thalasso stem-cell concept
Both carry skincare language into shampoo, but CeraVe is backed by dermatologists and a brand system while 8T rests on one figure — 84% beauty serum ingredients, water included
CeraVe is fragrance-free and sulfate-free; 8T keeps its Aqua White Floral scent and treats fragrance as part of the experience
CeraVe is 355 mL at US$10.99 (US$0.031/mL); 8T is 475 mL at ¥1,540 with a refill. Both sit at mass pricing, but 8T's size and refill system is more developed

CeraVe's distribution and brand volume are far larger

en.name: Aveeno Scalp Soothing

Both bring skincare ingredients onto the scalp, so the persuasion structures are similar

insight.zh:
CeraVe 把护肤端的信任直接嫁接到了头皮。

* 借用已建立的信任不用重新证明：神经酰胺+胆固醇这套皮肤屏障修护体系，消费者已经在CeraVe护肤产品里建立信任，这支洗发水只需要说"跟你脸上用的是同一套逻辑"。
* 靠低价和成分背书双重吸引：定价是本库最低（约US\$0.031/mL），不靠故事或渠道溢价，靠成分背书本身的可信度和低价共同吸引敏感头皮人群。
* 同一概念可以撑起完全不同的价格：竞品选了8 THE THALASSO这种日系高端护肤化洗发水形成反差——同样是"保护屏障"的逻辑，CeraVe用最低价做，8 THE THALASSO用高价做。

战略启示：把一个品类已经建立的信任原样搬到相邻品类，比重新建立信任更快，也可以选择用低价或高价两种完全不同的方式变现这份信任。
insight.en:
CeraVe grafts trust built in skincare directly onto the scalp.

* Borrows established trust, no need to re-prove it: the ceramide-plus-cholesterol barrier-repair system already has consumer trust from CeraVe's skincare line; this shampoo only needs to say "same logic as what you use on your face."
* Dual pull from low price and ingredient credibility: priced lowest in this library (about US$0.031/mL), not relying on story or channel premium — ingredient credibility and low price together attract sensitive-scalp users.
* The same concept can support wildly different prices: its competitor 8 THE THALASSO, a premium Japanese skinified shampoo, creates a sharp contrast — same "protect the barrier" logic, but CeraVe executes it at the lowest price and 8 THE THALASSO at a premium one.

Strategic takeaway: transplanting trust already built in one category onto an adjacent one is faster than building trust from scratch, and that trust can be monetized through either a low-price or high-price strategy.

name.zh: KUNDAL Airy Volume Hyaluron Treatment
name.en: KUNDAL Airy Volume Hyaluron Treatment

company.zh: THE SKINFACTORY Co., Ltd.（韩国首尔，2016年10月成立）
company.en: THE SKINFACTORY Co., Ltd. (Seoul, Korea; founded Oct 2016)

launch.zh: Airy Volume Hyaluron系列的护发素单品，与同系列洗发水配套销售
launch.en: The conditioner in the Airy Volume Hyaluron line, sold alongside the matching shampoo

price.en: US$20.00–20.90 (500 mL); the 300 mL shampoo+treatment set is about US$25.08 on Stylevana

market.zh: 韩国、日本、东南亚跨境电商为主
market.en: Korea, Japan and Southeast Asian cross-border e-commerce

sources: KUNDAL official store — Airy Volume Hyaluron

positioning.zh: Airy Volume Hyaluron系列的配套护发素，承担系列中「补润」的一半：洗发水刻意做得轻盈、不留包覆感，润度不足的部分由这支补上。配方沿用同系列的透明质酸多形态与海藻提取物，但基底换成Behentrimonium Chloride加硬脂醇、鲸蜡醇的阳离子调理体系。500 mL约US$20，与洗发水同价位，套装销售是主要的走量方式。
positioning.en: The matching conditioner in the Airy Volume Hyaluron line, carrying the moisture half of the system. The shampoo is deliberately light and leaves no coating, and this product supplies what it withholds. It reuses the line's multi-form hyaluronic acid and seaweed extracts but switches the base to a cationic conditioning system of behentrimonium chloride with stearyl and cetyl alcohol. At around US$20 for 500 mL it matches the shampoo's price, and set purchase is the main volume route.

target.zh: 细软发质但发梢需要补润的人群；已购买同系列洗发水的用户
target.en: Fine hair that still needs moisture at the ends, and existing buyers of the matching shampoo

zh: 细软发质、担心护发素会压塌发根的人群
头皮易出油但发梢干燥的混合型头皮
已购买同系列洗发水、按套装使用的用户
偏好韩系香氛型个护的消费者
en: Fine hair worried that conditioner will flatten the roots
Combination scalps — oily roots, dry ends
Buyers of the matching shampoo using the two as a set
Shoppers who buy Korean personal care for fragrance

zh: 维持头皮水油平衡，打造蓬松发感
透明质酸与Niosome booster技术
AHA・PHA配合的温和去角质
海洋复合物（Blue Marine Complex）
与同系列洗发水配套的两步护理
en: Maintains the scalp's oil-water balance for voluminous hair
Hyaluronic acid with niosome booster technology
Gentle exfoliation with AHA/PHA
Blue Marine Complex
A two-step routine with the matching shampoo

ingredients.zh: 共48个成分。基底为Behentrimonium Chloride配Stearyl Alcohol与Cetyl Alcohol——阳离子表面活性剂加长链脂肪醇的标准护发素结构，冲洗后的顺滑感主要来自这一层。Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride为阳离子瓜尔胶，增强附着。功效层沿用同系列洗发水的成分组：海水（Maris Aqua）、裙带菜与海带等海藻提取物、Hydrogenated Lecithin与Sorbitan Olivate构成的脂质体载体，以及多形态透明质酸。油脂为葵花籽油。防腐体系为Hydroxyacetophenone配Caprylyl Glycol与1,2-Hexanediol，不含传统对羟基苯甲酸酯。
ingredients.en: Forty-eight ingredients. The base is behentrimonium chloride with stearyl and cetyl alcohol — the standard conditioner structure of a cationic surfactant plus long-chain fatty alcohols, and the source of most of the post-rinse slip. Guar hydroxypropyltrimonium chloride, a cationic guar, improves deposition. The functional layer reuses the shampoo's set: sea water, wakame and kombu extracts, a liposomal carrier of hydrogenated lecithin and sorbitan olivate, and multi-form hyaluronic acid. The oil is sunflower seed. Preservation is hydroxyacetophenone with caprylyl glycol and 1,2-hexanediol, with no traditional parabens.

ingredientsNote.zh: YesStyle等渠道提到「Niosome booster technology」，对应成分表中的Hydrogenated Lecithin与Sorbitan Olivate——这两者可形成脂质体结构包裹水溶性成分。品牌未公开粒径、包封率等具体参数，因此这是一个成分层面可确认、但效果层面无法验证的说法。另外，与同系列洗发水一样，宣传写「AHA & PHA」但成分表中只有PHA与水杨酸衍生物。
ingredientsNote.en: Retailers such as YesStyle mention “niosome booster technology,” which corresponds to the hydrogenated lecithin and sorbitan olivate in the list — together they can form liposomal structures around water-soluble actives. No particle size or encapsulation rate is published, so this is confirmable at the ingredient level but unverifiable at the effect level. As with the matching shampoo, the marketing says “AHA & PHA” while the list holds only a PHA and a salicylic derivative.

zh.name: Behentrimonium Chloride
zh.desc: 长链阳离子表面活性剂，位列成分表第三位。护发素的顺滑感主要由它提供，虽然不出现在宣传前排。

zh.name: 多形态透明质酸
zh.desc: 沿用同系列洗发水的透明质酸组，构成系列一致性。在冲洗型护发素中，阳离子化形态是唯一能留存的。

zh.name: Hydrogenated Lecithin + Sorbitan Olivate
zh.desc: 可形成脂质体结构，对应品牌所称的Niosome booster technology。成分可确认，参数未公开。

zh.name: 海藻提取物 + 海水
zh.desc: 裙带菜、海带等，与洗发水共用同一套海洋成分，是KUNDAL的成分识别点。

en.name: Behentrimonium chloride
en.desc: A long-chain cationic surfactant, third on the list. It supplies most of the conditioner's slip even though it never appears in the front row of the marketing.

en.name: Multi-form hyaluronic acid
en.desc: The same hyaluronic set as the shampoo, giving the line consistency. In a rinse-off conditioner the cationised form is the only one that stays.

en.name: Hydrogenated lecithin + sorbitan olivate
en.desc: Can form liposomal structures; this is what the brand calls niosome booster technology. Confirmable as ingredients, unpublished as parameters.

en.name: Seaweed extracts + sea water
en.desc: Wakame, kombu and others, shared with the shampoo — KUNDAL's ingredient signature.

zh.title: 洗护分工的配方设计
zh.desc: 洗发水刻意避开重型调理成分以保住蓬松感，把补润完全交给护发素。这种分工让单品各自极端化，但也意味着单用任何一支都不完整——这是套装销售的配方基础。

zh.title: 成分组跨单品复用
zh.desc: 透明质酸组、海藻组、防腐组在洗发水与护发素之间完全共用，只更换基底。开发成本与原料采购成本都被摊薄，同时保证了系列的成分一致性。这是韩系品牌做系列线的标准做法。

zh.title: 载体技术的命名（Niosome booster）
zh.desc: 用可采购的Hydrogenated Lecithin与Sorbitan Olivate构建脂质体结构，再以技术名称对外表述。与Kérastase的Abyssine是同一类做法：用命名而非专利建立技术感。

en.title: Splitting the job across cleanse and condition
en.desc: The shampoo deliberately avoids heavy conditioning agents to protect lift, handing all the moisture work to the conditioner. The split lets each product go to an extreme, but it also means neither is complete alone — the formulation basis for set selling.

en.title: Reusing ingredient blocks across SKUs
en.desc: The hyaluronic block, the seaweed block and the preservative block are shared wholesale between shampoo and conditioner, with only the base swapped. Development and raw material costs are spread while the line stays consistent. Standard practice for Korean brands building a range.

en.title: Naming the carrier (niosome booster)
en.desc: A liposomal structure built from purchasable hydrogenated lecithin and sorbitan olivate, then given a technology name. The same move as Kérastase's Abyssine: technical credibility from naming rather than patent.

evidence.zh: 没有公开的临床或消费者测试数据。可验证的只有成分表本身（Skinsort标注48个成分）与「Niosome booster technology」对应的载体成分。品牌未公开粒径、包封率、留存量等任何参数。宣称中的「AHA & PHA」与实际成分表存在偏差，与同系列洗发水的问题相同。可引用性低。
evidence.en: No published clinical or consumer test data. The only verifiable material is the ingredient list itself (Skinsort counts 48) and the carrier ingredients behind “niosome booster technology.” No particle size, encapsulation rate or deposition figure is published. The “AHA & PHA” claim mismatches the list, the same issue as the matching shampoo. Citability is low.

insight.zh:
这支护发素存在的理由，是它的搭档洗发水刻意留下的空缺。

* 空缺是设计出来的：洗发水故意做得轻盈不包覆，把"润度不够"的体验缺口留给护发素来填，用两支产品完成一支产品能做的事，提高客单价。
* 分工不只是营销：配方沿用同系列的透明质酸多形态保持认知一致，但阳离子调理体系是单独针对护发素调理需求换的基底，说明分工也体现在配方上。
* 目标是卖一整套：定价跟洗发水一致，套装销售是主要走量方式，说明品牌的目标不是让消费者买一支，是买一整套。

战略启示：故意在一支产品里留下体验缺口，用配套产品去填补，是提高系列客单价的常见设计手法。
insight.en:
This conditioner's reason to exist is a gap deliberately left by its paired shampoo.

* The gap is designed, not accidental: the shampoo is deliberately made light and non-coating, leaving a moisture gap for the conditioner to fill — splitting what one product could do into two, raising basket size.
* The division of labor isn't just marketing: the formula keeps the same multi-form hyaluronic acid for consistency, but swaps in a cationic conditioning base specifically for the conditioner's needs — the split shows up in the formula too.
* The goal is selling the full set: priced the same as the shampoo, with bundled sets as the main sales driver, showing the brand's goal is a full-set purchase, not a single item.

Strategic takeaway: deliberately leaving an experience gap in one product, then filling it with a companion product, is a common way to raise basket size across a line.

positioning.zh: Deep Damage Repair系列的第一步，品牌称之为「蛋白安瓶洗发水」：30种蛋白质与氨基酸配5种植物油，主张头皮清爽、发丝柔顺。290 mL售价US$22，单毫升约US$0.076，价格约为同品牌发膜的一半略高。系列定位明确——洗发水负责清洁与预处理，修护的主体交给Treatment EX。
positioning.en: STEP 1 of the Deep Damage Repair range, branded a “protein ampoule shampoo”: 30 proteins and amino acids with five plant oils, promising a fresh scalp and soft hair. At US$22 for 290 mL, about US$0.076 per mL, it costs a little over half the brand's mask per mL. The role in the range is explicit — the shampoo handles cleansing and preparation, and the repair work belongs to Treatment EX.

target.zh: 染烫热损伤发质；已在使用同系列发膜、按两步流程购买的用户
target.en: Chemically and heat-damaged hair, and existing Treatment EX users buying into the two-step routine

头皮易出油但发丝受损的混合状态
已购买Deep Damage Treatment EX、按STEP 1+2使用的用户
通过Olive Young或Sephora接触品牌的K-beauty消费者

Combination condition — oily scalp with damaged lengths
Existing Treatment EX buyers following the STEP 1 + 2 routine
K-beauty shoppers who meet the brand at Olive Young or Sephora

zh: 30种蛋白质与氨基酸
5种植物来源黄金油
丰盈泡沫彻底清洁头皮与残留
蛋白安瓶洗发水（Protein Ampoule Shampoo）
与Treatment EX配套的两步护理
en: 30 proteins and amino acids
Five plant-derived golden oils
Rich foam that thoroughly cleanses scalp and buildup
Protein ampoule shampoo
A two-step routine with Treatment EX

ingredients.zh: 共65个成分。洗净基剂为Sodium Laureth Sulfate配Ammonium Lauryl Sulfate与Cocamidopropyl Betaine——两种硫酸盐同时使用，是相当强的清洁体系，与「蛋白安瓶」的温和印象存在落差。蛋白质部分为水解牛奶蛋白、水解胶原蛋白、水解丝蛋白、水解角蛋白、水解玉米蛋白、水解大豆蛋白、水解小麦蛋白共7种，加丝氨基酸。游离氨基酸多达22种（亮氨酸、牛磺酸、异亮氨酸、缬氨酸、天冬氨酸、鸟氨酸、谷氨酸、甘氨酸、谷氨酰胺、胱氨酸、蛋氨酸、酪氨酸、赖氨酸、丙氨酸、苯丙氨酸、丝氨酸、色氨酸、苏氨酸、精氨酸、组氨酸、天冬酰胺、脯氨酸）。植物油为山茶籽油、橄榄果油、摩洛哥坚果油、澳洲坚果油、葵花籽油共5种。另含薄荷、洋甘菊、美国薄荷、迷迭香、小苍兰、薰衣草6种植物提取物。
ingredients.en: Sixty-five ingredients. The cleansing base is sodium laureth sulfate with ammonium lauryl sulfate and cocamidopropyl betaine — two sulfates together, a fairly strong system that sits at odds with the gentle impression of “protein ampoule.” Proteins number seven: hydrolysed milk, collagen, silk, keratin, corn, soy and wheat, plus silk amino acids. Free amino acids run to 22 (leucine, taurine, isoleucine, valine, aspartic acid, ornithine, glutamic acid, glycine, glutamine, cystine, methionine, tyrosine, lysine, alanine, phenylalanine, serine, tryptophan, threonine, arginine, histidine, asparagine, proline). Five plant oils: camellia, olive, argan, macadamia and sunflower. Six botanical extracts round it out — peppermint, chamomile, bee balm, rosemary, freesia and lavender.

ingredientsNote.zh: 「30种蛋白质与氨基酸」这个数字可以在成分表上逐项数出来：7种水解蛋白＋丝氨基酸＋22种游离氨基酸＝30。计数完全属实，这一点比多数品牌的模糊表述可靠。但需要注意两件事：一是把每一种游离氨基酸单独计为一项，数字才能到30；二是这是冲洗型产品，游离氨基酸在洗发过程中的实际留存量极低，它们对成分表的贡献大于对头发的贡献。
ingredientsNote.en: The “30 proteins and amino acids” figure can be counted item by item on the list: 7 hydrolysates + silk amino acids + 22 free amino acids = 30. The count is literally true, which is more than most brands' vaguer phrasing offers. Two things to note, though. The number only reaches 30 because each free amino acid is counted separately. And this is a rinse-off product, so deposition of free amino acids during a wash is very low — they contribute more to the ingredient list than to the hair.

zh.name: 7种水解蛋白
zh.desc: 牛奶、胶原、丝、角蛋白、玉米、大豆、小麦。分子量各异，是「蛋白安瓶」说法的实际支撑。

zh.name: 22种游离氨基酸
zh.desc: 逐项列出的氨基酸，把宣称数字从8推到30。在冲洗型产品中留存有限，主要作用在成分表层面。

zh.name: 5种植物黄金油
zh.desc: 山茶籽油、橄榄果油、摩洛哥坚果油、澳洲坚果油、葵花籽油，提供顺滑与光泽，缓冲双硫酸盐基剂的干涩感。

zh.name: Sodium Laureth Sulfate + Ammonium Lauryl Sulfate
zh.desc: 两种硫酸盐同时使用，清洁力强、泡沫丰富。这是「丰盈泡沫彻底清洁」宣称的来源，也是这支产品与温和印象之间的落差所在。

en.name: Seven hydrolysed proteins
en.desc: Milk, collagen, silk, keratin, corn, soy and wheat at varying molecular weights — the real support behind the protein ampoule claim.

en.name: Twenty-two free amino acids
en.desc: Listed individually, they push the claim from 8 to 30. Deposition from a rinse-off product is limited, so their main work happens on the ingredient list.

en.name: Five plant golden oils
en.desc: Camellia, olive, argan, macadamia and sunflower, providing slip and shine and buffering the dryness of a double-sulfate base.

en.name: Sodium laureth sulfate + ammonium lauryl sulfate
en.desc: Two sulfates together give strong cleansing and rich foam. This is what delivers the thorough-cleansing claim, and also where the product diverges from its gentle impression.

zh.title: 可逐项验证的计数式宣称
zh.desc: 「30种」这个数字能在成分表上一项一项数出来，与多数品牌的模糊表述不同。计数属实是这套手法能成立的前提——一旦被拆穿，整个说服结构会反噬。

zh.title: STEP编号的两步结构
zh.desc: 洗发水标STEP 1、发膜标STEP 2，把两支产品绑成一个流程。与OLAPLEX的编号体系是同一思路，但UNOVE只做两步，门槛更低、转化更直接。

zh.title: 洗净力与温和印象的分离
zh.desc: 基剂用双硫酸盐保证清洁力与泡沫，对外表述则集中在蛋白与氨基酸上。消费者感知到的是「泡沫丰富、洗得干净」，记住的是「蛋白安瓶」，两者并不冲突但也不是同一件事。

zh.title: 价格阶梯设计
zh.desc: 52 mL US$8的小规格远低于发膜的40 mL US$11，用洗发水做系列的入口，再向单价更高的发膜转化。

en.title: A count that can be verified item by item
en.desc: The number 30 can be counted straight off the INCI list, unlike most brands' vaguer phrasing. That the count is literally true is the precondition for the tactic working — if it were exposed as padded, the whole persuasion structure would turn against the brand.

en.title: A two-step STEP-numbered structure
en.desc: The shampoo is STEP 1 and the mask STEP 2, binding the two into one routine. Same thinking as OLAPLEX's numbering, but UNOVE stops at two steps, which lowers the barrier and converts more directly.

en.title: Separating cleansing power from the gentle impression
en.desc: The base uses two sulfates to guarantee cleansing and foam while the messaging sits entirely on proteins and amino acids. Users perceive rich lather and a clean rinse; what they remember is “protein ampoule.” The two do not conflict, but they are not the same thing.

en.title: A price ladder into the range
en.desc: The 52 mL at US$8 undercuts the mask's 40 mL at US$11, using the shampoo as the entry point and converting upward to the higher-priced mask.

evidence.zh: 可验证的是成分计数（30种蛋白质与氨基酸，逐项可数）与成分总数（65项，Hwahae与INCIDecoder均可查证）。但没有公开的临床或仪器测试数据支撑修护功效，也未见断裂强度、蛋白留存率等指标。品牌层面的背书沿用系列共通的Olive Young获奖记录与「韩国销量第一」表述，属于渠道事实而非产品功效数据。与同系列发膜相同，需要注意蛋白类产品长期单用可能造成的干燥脆化风险。
evidence.en: Verifiable: the ingredient count (30 proteins and amino acids, countable item by item) and the total (65 ingredients, checkable on Hwahae and INCIDecoder). But there is no published clinical or instrumental data behind the repair claim, and no breakage-strength or protein-deposition figures. Brand-level endorsement reuses the range's Olive Young awards and number-one-in-Korea claim — channel facts rather than product efficacy data. As with the matching mask, prolonged sole use of a protein-led product carries a dryness and brittleness risk.

zh: 30种蛋白质与氨基酸：7种水解蛋白＋丝氨基酸＋22种游离氨基酸，逐项可验证
5种植物油：山茶、橄榄、摩洛哥坚果、澳洲坚果、葵花籽，逐项可验证

zh.tagline: Surreal softness
zh.concept: UNOVE由韩国头皮护理品牌Dr.ForHair的技术孵化，专注损伤发护理。品牌把「非现实的柔软」作为唯一的核心承诺，所有产品线都围绕这一个感官目标组织，不做多方向诉求。2022年起连续获得Olive Young护发品类奖项，2025年成为首个进入美国Sephora的韩国护发品牌。

en.concept: UNOVE was incubated on the technology of Korean scalp-care brand Dr.ForHair and focuses on damaged hair. The brand holds a single core promise — surreal softness — and organises every line around that one sensory goal rather than spreading across claims. It has won the Olive Young haircare category since 2022 and in 2025 became the first Korean haircare brand to enter Sephora US.

KUNDAL堆叠透明质酸形态，UNOVE堆叠蛋白与氨基酸种类，是同一手法的两种应用

insight.zh:
这支洗发水明确知道自己在系列里的角色是预处理，不是主角。

* 明确分工避免两头不讨好：品牌自己把它定位成"第一步"，修护的主体交给Treatment EX，避免了洗发水要同时承担清洁和修护、结果两个都做不到极致的问题。
* 借用护肤界的"安瓶"认知："蛋白安瓶"这个命名借用了护肤界"安瓶=高浓度急救"的认知，跟同门Treatment EX的"30,000ppm"数字打法是同一套语言体系的延伸。
* 价格梯度也在提示购买顺序：定价约为同品牌发膜的一半略高，价格本身在提示消费者"这是入门步骤，修护要靠后面那支"。

战略启示：系列产品里，让每一支产品都说清楚自己不是主角，反而能让消费者更清楚该怎么组合购买整套。
insight.en:
This shampoo clearly knows its role in the line is pre-treatment, not the star.

* Clear division of labor avoids doing two jobs poorly: the brand positions it as "step one," leaving the main repair job to Treatment EX — avoiding the trap of a shampoo trying to both cleanse and repair without excelling at either.
* Borrows the "ampoule" concept from skincare: the name "protein ampoule" borrows skincare's "ampoule equals high-concentration rescue" association, extending the same vocabulary as sibling product Treatment EX's "30,000 ppm" play.
* The price ladder signals purchase order too: priced at roughly half plus a bit of the same-brand mask, the price itself signals to consumers "this is the entry step, repair comes from the next one."

Strategic takeaway: within a product line, having each item clearly admit it's not the star actually makes it easier for consumers to understand how to buy the whole set.

notes.zh: 资料采集日 2026-07-31。成分表以INCIDecoder（65项）为准，30种蛋白质与氨基酸的计数已逐项核对。价格取自UNOVE官方全球商城与韩国官方商城。
notes.en: Researched 2026-07-31. Ingredient list per INCIDecoder (65 items); the count of 30 proteins and amino acids was verified item by item. Prices from the official UNOVE global store and the Korean official store.

name.zh: The Ordinary Multi-Peptide Serum for Hair Density
name.en: The Ordinary Multi-Peptide Serum for Hair Density

company.zh: DECIEM（加拿大多伦多，现属雅诗兰黛集团）
company.en: DECIEM (Toronto, Canada; now part of the Estée Lauder Companies)

launch.zh: 品牌护发线的核心单品，长期在售

market.en: Brand site, Sephora, Boots, Watsons, Amazon and other global channels

positioning.zh: 护肤品牌把整套方法论直接搬进头皮护理的最纯粹样本。免洗型头皮精华，同时搭载6种授权活性复合物：REDENSYL、Procapil、CAPIXYL、BAICAPIL、AnaGain与高溶解度咖啡因。60 mL售价US$24，单毫升US$0.40，把护肤线「成分透明＋低价」的定价逻辑一并移植过来——这是多数护发品牌不敢做的部分。
positioning.en: The purest sample of a skincare brand carrying its entire methodology into scalp care. A leave-in scalp serum running six licensed active complexes at once: REDENSYL, Procapil, CAPIXYL, BAICAPIL, AnaGain and high-solubility caffeine. At US$24 for 60 mL, or US$0.40/mL, it transplants the skincare line's transparency-plus-low-price logic as well — the part most haircare brands will not copy.

target.zh: 关注头发密度与稀疏问题、习惯以成分表判断产品的消费者；已在使用The Ordinary护肤线的用户
target.en: Consumers concerned with density and thinning who judge products by the INCI list, and existing users of The Ordinary's skincare line

习惯以成分表与浓度判断产品的消费者
