zh: 泡沫：烯烃磺酸钠基剂，泡量大、洗净感明确
干后手感：受损或干燥发质单用偏涩，依赖同系列护发素
香型：含香精，OGX一贯的香氛型大众路线（品牌称beauty-forward）
定位差异：与Neutrogena刻意压低感官的路线相反
规格：385 mL大容量，符合大卖场购买习惯
en: Lather: olefin sulfonate base, generous foam, a clear cleansing feel
Dry feel: damaged or dry hair used alone feels tight and depends on the matching conditioner
Scent: fragranced, in OGX's long-standing scent-led mass style (the brand calls it beauty-forward)
Positioning contrast: the opposite of Neutrogena's deliberately muted sensory profile
Size: 385 mL, matching mass-retail buying habits

packaging.zh: 高瘦瓶型配前置的"1.5% Mandelic Acid"浓度标注，第一眼把功效护肤的表达方式移植到一支US$6.97的产品上，Click Pen点涂笔更是把这种"成分护肤化"延伸到了包装形态本身。
packaging.en: The tall slim bottle fronts '1.5% Mandelic Acid' at first glance, transplanting active-skincare language onto a US$6.97 product — the Click Pen format extends that skinification down to the packaging itself.

distribution.zh: Walmart、Target、Kroger、Amazon等美国大众渠道；英国Boots、澳洲Chemist Warehouse等国际市场同步
distribution.en: Walmart, Target, Kroger and Amazon in the US, with Boots in the UK and Chemist Warehouse in Australia rolling out in parallel

zh.channelDesc: 覆盖大卖场、超市与药妆的全渠道铺货，是本库中触达面最广、价格最低的产品

en.channelDesc: Full distribution across hypermarkets, grocery and drugstores — the widest reach and lowest price in this library

zh.tagline: Beauty-forward science at the root
zh.concept: OGX以香氛型大众洗护建立市场地位，被Kenvue称为「第一修护品牌」。ProGrowth + Peptide是它首次把毛发学专家背书与浓度标注纳入产品体系，同时保留品牌一贯的感官吸引力——集团称之为beauty-forward、即时见效的路线。

en.concept: OGX built its position on scent-led mass haircare and is described by Kenvue as the number one hair repair brand. ProGrowth + Peptide is its first range to bring trichologist endorsement and stated concentrations into the system while keeping the brand's sensory appeal — what the group calls a beauty-forward, instant-results approach.

zh.name: Neutrogena Hair Restore Strength + Purity Shampoo（同集团）
points: 同一集团、同日发布、同一活性同一浓度（1.5%苦杏仁酸），数字几乎相同（98% vs 97%）
基剂不同：OGX用烯烃磺酸钠成本更低、清洁力更强；Neutrogena免硫酸盐更温和
US$6.97 vs US$9.97，OGX覆盖更下沉价格带；背书专家一个是毛发学专家、一个是皮肤科医生

zh.name: UNOVE Deep Damage Repair Shampoo
points: 两者都用成分数字做宣称，UNOVE数「30种蛋白质与氨基酸」，OGX数「98%去除残留」
UNOVE的计数可在成分表上逐项核对，OGX的百分比来自未公开方法的测试——可核查程度不同
价格差距大（US$0.018/mL vs US$0.076/mL），渠道属性也不同（Olive Young vs Walmart）

zh.name: The Doux BREAKDOWN Clarifying Shampoo
points: 同为清洁型洗发水，The Doux面向纹理发社群，OGX面向全发质大众市场
OGX用苦杏仁酸做化学去角质，路线更接近护肤；The Doux更强调社群认同与使用场景
OGX的渠道覆盖与价格优势明显，但缺乏The Doux那种社群黏性

en.name: Neutrogena Hair Restore Strength + Purity Shampoo (same group)
points: Same group, same launch day, same active at the same level (1.5% mandelic acid), near-identical figures (98% vs 97%)
Different bases: OGX's olefin sulfonate is cheaper and cleanses harder, Neutrogena's sulfate-free base is milder
US$6.97 against US$9.97, with OGX reaching lower; one is endorsed by trichologists, the other by dermatologists

en.name: UNOVE Deep Damage Repair Shampoo
points: Both claim through numbers — UNOVE counts 30 proteins and amino acids, OGX cites 98% buildup removal
UNOVE's count can be verified item by item on the INCI list while OGX's percentage comes from an unpublished method; the verifiability differs
A large price gap (US$0.018/mL against US$0.076/mL) and different channels (Olive Young against Walmart)

en.name: The Doux BREAKDOWN Clarifying Shampoo
points: Both are clarifying shampoos, but The Doux serves the textured-hair community and OGX the all-hair-types mass market
OGX exfoliates chemically with mandelic acid, closer to skincare; The Doux leans on community identity and usage occasion
OGX has clear advantages in distribution and price but none of The Doux's community loyalty

insight.zh:
这支产品的角色是帮同一个母公司覆盖价格带的下限。

* 同一逻辑，两端价位：跟Neutrogena Hair Restore同一天发布、同一套皮肤科学化逻辑，但价格只要US\$6.97，单毫升US\$0.018，是本库最便宜的产品，Kenvue用两条线覆盖同一概念的高低两端。
* 极低价位仍保留一点专业感："毛发学专家共同开发"这个背书，是在极低价位段依然想保留一点专业可信度，不完全放弃科学感这个卖点。
* 战场是大众货架的性价比竞争：竞品选了同集团Neutrogena以及UNOVE、The Doux这些同样走清洁+去残留路线的平价品牌。

战略启示：同一个新概念可以用两个不同价位的产品线同时铺开，高价线建立专业形象，低价线抢占价格敏感消费者，两条线互相借力。
insight.en:
This product's job is to cover the lower end of the price band for the same parent company.

* Same logic, opposite price points: launched the same day as Neutrogena Hair Restore with the same dermatology-inspired logic, but priced at only US$6.97, or US$0.018/mL — the cheapest product in this library, with Kenvue covering both ends of the same concept.
* Keeps a bit of professional credibility even at the lowest price: the "co-developed with trichologists" credential preserves some scientific credibility even at this rock-bottom price point.
* The battlefield is mass-shelf value competition: its competitors include sibling brand Neutrogena plus value peers UNOVE and The Doux, all taking a similar cleanse-plus-clarify approach.

Strategic takeaway: the same new concept can be rolled out across two different price tiers at once — the premium line builds a professional image, the value line captures price-sensitive consumers, and the two reinforce each other.

notes.zh: 资料采集日 2026-07-31。成分表与宣称取自Target产品页；发布信息取自Kenvue官方新闻稿与Chain Drug Review（2025年11月13日）。价格取自Walmart（US$6.97）与Kroger（US$6.49）。「最高3倍丰盈感」原注为「Instrumental results with full routine vs. untreated hair」。
notes.en: Researched 2026-07-31. Ingredients and claims from the Target product page; launch details from Kenvue's press release and Chain Drug Review (13 November 2025). Prices from Walmart (US$6.97) and Kroger (US$6.49). The "up to 3x fuller-looking hair" claim is footnoted "Instrumental results with full routine vs. untreated hair".

name.zh: Briogeo Scalp Revival Charcoal + Coconut Oil Micro-Exfoliating Shampoo
name.en: Briogeo Scalp Revival Charcoal + Coconut Oil Micro-Exfoliating Shampoo

company.zh: Briogeo（美国纽约，Nancy Twine于2013年创立；2022年被Wella集团收购）
company.en: Briogeo (New York, USA; founded by Nancy Twine in 2013, acquired by Wella in 2022)

launch.zh: Scalp Revival系列的核心单品，与Scalp Treatment精华共同构成该系列的两大支柱
launch.en: A hero item of the Scalp Revival range, forming its two pillars alongside the Scalp Treatment serum

capacity.zh: 2 oz / 59 mL（迷你）・8 oz / 236 mL・946 mL（专业装）
capacity.en: 2 oz / 59 mL mini, 8 oz / 236 mL, and a 946 mL professional size

price.zh: US$42.00（8 oz，Sephora）＝ US$0.178/mL；迷你装2 oz US$15.00
price.en: US$42.00 for 8 oz at Sephora = US$0.178/mL; the 2 oz mini is US$15.00

market.zh: Sephora、Ulta、Cult Beauty、品牌官网；沙龙渠道
market.en: Sephora, Ulta, Cult Beauty, the brand's own site and salon distribution

positioning.zh: Briogeo的茶树系列（Scalp Revival）是沙龙渠道销量第一的头皮护理品牌，聚焦头皮磨砂与精华两个品类，主张为头皮提供类似面部护理的仪式感体验（facial-like ritual for the scalp），呼应沙龙的head spa头疗趋势。这支是系列的磨砂端：每周使用的头皮去角质洗发水，用可溶解的植物来源磨砂颗粒，宣称一次使用即减少最高82%的干性头皮脱屑。946 mL专业装的存在直接对应沙龙头疗的操作场景。
positioning.en: Briogeo's tea tree range, Scalp Revival, is the number one scalp care brand in salon distribution, focused on two categories — scalp scrub and scalp serum — and built around delivering a facial-like ritual for the scalp, in step with the head spa trend in salons. This is the scrub end of the range: a weekly exfoliating scalp shampoo using dissolvable plant-derived particles, clinically shown to reduce up to 82% of dry scalp flaking after one use. The 946 mL professional size maps directly onto salon head spa treatment.

target.zh: 头皮脱屑、产品残留堆积的消费者；把头皮护理当作仪式体验的人群；提供头疗服务的沙龙
target.en: People with flaking and product buildup, consumers who treat scalp care as a ritual, and salons offering head spa services

zh: 头皮干燥脱屑、有明显残留堆积的人群
造型产品使用频繁、洗发频率低的消费者
把头皮护理当作仪式体验而非功能步骤的人群
提供head spa头疗服务的沙龙（946 mL专业装）
en: Dry, flaking scalps with visible buildup
Frequent stylers who wash infrequently
People who treat scalp care as a ritual rather than a functional step
Salons offering head spa services (the 946 mL professional size)

zh: 临床验证一次使用即减少最高82%的干性头皮脱屑
可溶解的植物来源磨砂颗粒，不残留
备长炭吸附头皮与毛囊内杂质
椰子油补充水分、平衡油脂
茶树、薄荷、留兰香、姜四种精油
每周一次的头皮磨砂步骤
en: Clinically shown to reduce up to 82% of dry scalp flaking after one use
Dissolvable plant-derived exfoliating particles that leave no residue
Binchotan charcoal draws impurities from scalp and follicles
Coconut oil restores moisture and balances oil
Four essential oils: tea tree, peppermint, spearmint and ginger
A once-weekly scalp scrub step

ingredients.zh: 洗净基剂为月桂酰甲基异硫代硫酸钠＋椰油酰胺丙基甜菜碱＋椰油酰基羟乙磺酸钠，是免硫酸盐的温和氨基酸系组合。第6位为椰子油。磨砂颗粒来自微晶纤维素（Microcrystalline Cellulose）——这是「可溶解植物来源磨砂」的实际成分，与塑料微珠或核桃壳粉不同，它在冲洗中溶解，不会造成头皮微创伤。木糖醇葡糖苷与脱水木糖醇构成保湿系统。四种精油：茶树、薄荷、留兰香、姜，配乳酸薄荷酯提供清凉感。红没药醇为舒缓成分。全成分23项。
ingredients.en: The cleansing base is sodium lauroyl methyl isethionate with cocamidopropyl betaine and sodium cocoyl isethionate — a mild, sulfate-free amino-acid style combination. Coconut oil sits sixth. The scrub particles are microcrystalline cellulose, which is what "dissolvable plant-derived exfoliant" actually means: unlike plastic microbeads or walnut shell powder it dissolves during rinsing and causes no micro-abrasion to the scalp. Xylitylglucoside and anhydroxylitol form the hydration system. Four essential oils — tea tree, peppermint, spearmint and ginger — are joined by menthyl lactate for cooling, with bisabolol as a soother. Twenty-three ingredients in total.

ingredientsNote.zh: 微晶纤维素这个选择值得注意。头皮磨砂的核心矛盾是：颗粒够硬才能去角质，但硬颗粒会在头皮上造成微创伤，而头皮的角质层比面部更薄。微晶纤维素在摩擦阶段提供物理去角质，在冲洗阶段溶解消失，避开了这个矛盾。同系列的Scalp Treatment精华用Saccharide Isomerate做长效保湿，两支产品的「说服成分」都在成分表后段——前排讲炭与茶树的故事，后排做实际工作。
ingredientsNote.en: The choice of microcrystalline cellulose is worth noting. The central conflict in scalp scrubs is that particles must be hard enough to exfoliate, yet hard particles cause micro-abrasion on a scalp whose stratum corneum is thinner than the face's. Microcrystalline cellulose provides physical exfoliation during massage and dissolves away during rinsing, sidestepping the conflict. The range's Scalp Treatment serum uses saccharide isomerate for long-lasting hydration, and in both products the ingredient doing the persuading sits late on the list — charcoal and tea tree tell the story up front while the back end does the work.

zh.name: 微晶纤维素
zh.desc: 「可溶解植物来源磨砂」的实际成分。摩擦时去角质、冲洗时溶解，避开了硬颗粒对薄头皮角质层的微创伤风险。

zh.name: 备长炭粉
zh.desc: 系列命名与包装配色的核心，吸附残留的视觉化说法。在洗发水中比在免洗精华中更能发挥作用。

zh.name: 四种精油＋乳酸薄荷酯
zh.desc: 茶树、薄荷、留兰香、姜。清凉与草本香气构成「头皮护理正在进行」的感官信号——这是facial-like ritual的实际实现方式。

zh.name: 免硫酸盐氨基酸系基剂
zh.desc: 月桂酰甲基异硫代硫酸钠等。既然要做物理去角质，洗净基剂必须先降低刺激。

en.name: Microcrystalline cellulose
en.desc: What "dissolvable plant-derived exfoliant" really is. It exfoliates during massage and dissolves on rinsing, avoiding the micro-abrasion risk hard particles pose to a thin scalp barrier.

en.name: Binchotan charcoal powder
en.desc: The core of the range's name and colourway, a visualisable way to talk about drawing out buildup — and more functional in a shampoo than in a leave-in serum.

en.name: Four essential oils + menthyl lactate
en.desc: Tea tree, peppermint, spearmint and ginger. Cooling and herbal aroma form the sensory signal that scalp care is happening — the practical mechanism behind a facial-like ritual.

en.name: Sulfate-free amino-acid style base
en.desc: Sodium lauroyl methyl isethionate and similar. If you are going to exfoliate physically, the cleansing base has to be de-escalated first.

zh.title: 把面部护理流程移植到头皮
zh.desc: 面部护理有清洁、去角质、精华三步，Scalp Revival把同样的结构搬到头皮：磨砂洗发水（每周）＋日常洗发水＋免洗精华。品类结构的移植比单个成分的移植影响更大——它改变的是消费者的使用频次与购买数量。

zh.title: 可溶解磨砂颗粒解决物理矛盾
zh.desc: 用微晶纤维素在摩擦阶段去角质、冲洗阶段溶解，同时满足「够有效」与「不伤头皮」两个互斥要求。这是配方层面的实际创新，不是话术。

zh.title: 感官作为仪式的载体
zh.desc: 四种精油加清凉剂，让使用过程本身成为可感知的体验。仪式感不能靠宣称建立，必须靠感官反馈——这是它与只标浓度的Nécessaire路线的根本差异。

zh.title: 规格阶梯对应渠道分层
zh.desc: 2 oz试用装US$15、8 oz正装US$42、946 mL专业装。专业装的存在直接对应沙龙head spa的操作用量，让品牌在零售与沙龙两个渠道同时成立。

en.title: Transplanting the facial routine to the scalp
en.desc: Facial care runs cleanse, exfoliate, serum, and Scalp Revival moves that structure to the scalp: a weekly scrub shampoo, a daily shampoo and a leave-in serum. Transplanting a category structure matters more than transplanting one ingredient, because it changes how often people use and how much they buy.

en.title: Dissolvable particles resolving a physical conflict
en.desc: Microcrystalline cellulose exfoliates during massage and dissolves on rinsing, satisfying both "effective enough" and "gentle on the scalp". Genuine formulation innovation rather than copywriting.

en.title: Sensation as the vehicle for ritual
en.desc: Four essential oils plus a cooling agent make the process itself a perceptible experience. Ritual cannot be established by claims; it needs sensory feedback — the fundamental difference from Nécessaire's percentage-only route.

en.title: A size ladder matching channel tiers
en.desc: A 2 oz trial at US$15, an 8 oz full size at US$42 and a 946 mL professional size. The professional size maps to the volumes a salon head spa treatment consumes, letting the brand work in retail and salon at once.

evidence.zh: 临床验证一次使用即减少最高82%的干性头皮脱屑。这个数字的可引用性高于同系列精华的「2倍水分」：脱屑减少是可视觉计数的终点指标，比头皮水分的仪器读数更接近消费者的实际感知。但同样带「up to（最高）」限定，为最优值而非平均值，且样本量、测试周期、对照组设计均未公开。「一次使用后」这个时间点的选择也值得注意——去角质产品在单次使用后的脱屑减少最明显，长期效果需要另行验证。
evidence.en: Clinically shown to reduce up to 82% of dry scalp flaking after one use. This figure is more citable than the range serum's "2x hydration": flake reduction is a visually countable endpoint, closer to what a consumer actually perceives than an instrumental hydration reading. It carries the same "up to" qualifier, though, making it a best case rather than an average, and sample size, duration and control design are all unpublished. The choice of "after one use" is also worth noting — flake reduction from an exfoliant is at its most visible immediately after a single use, and longer-term effect needs separate verification.

zh: 临床验证：一次使用即减少最高82%的干性头皮脱屑
脱屑减少为可视觉计数的终点指标，比水分读数更贴近消费者感知
带「up to」限定，为最优值非平均值
样本量、测试周期、对照组设计未公开
「一次使用后」为去角质产品效果最明显的时间点，长期效果需另行验证
可引用性：中高。终点指标合理，但需标注up to与时间点
en: Clinically shown: up to 82% less dry scalp flaking after one use
Flake reduction is a visually countable endpoint, closer to consumer perception than a hydration reading
Carries an "up to" qualifier, so it is a best case rather than an average
Sample size, duration and control design are unpublished
"After one use" is when an exfoliant looks best; longer-term effect needs separate verification
Citability: medium-high. The endpoint is reasonable, but the "up to" and the timepoint must be flagged

zh: 质地：含颗粒膏状，颗粒在按摩中逐渐溶解
用法：头皮分区按摩1-2分钟——按摩时长本身是仪式的一部分
感受：四种精油＋乳酸薄荷酯的清凉与草本气味，感官信号明确
泡沫：免硫酸盐＋含油脂，泡量不大，需要适应
频率：每周一次，与日常洗发水交替；8 oz约3-4个月
en: Texture: a grainy paste whose particles dissolve as you massage
Use: massage into the scalp section by section for one to two minutes — the duration is part of the ritual
Feel: cooling and herbal aroma from four essential oils plus menthyl lactate, a clear sensory signal
Lather: modest, being sulfate-free and oil-containing; takes adjustment
Frequency: weekly, alternating with a daily shampoo; 8 oz lasts three to four months

packaging.zh: 白色管型配黑标签，跟同系列精华的深色滴管瓶形成互补而非重复，第一眼就能靠形态区分出"这是磨砂膏而不是精华"。
packaging.en: The white tube with a black label complements rather than repeats the range serum's dark dropper bottle, letting the format alone signal at first glance that this is a scrub, not a serum.

distribution.zh: Sephora、Ulta、Cult Beauty、品牌官网；沙龙渠道（946 mL专业装）
distribution.en: Sephora, Ulta, Cult Beauty and the brand's own site, plus salon distribution via the 946 mL professional size

japan: 日本无正式渠道，依赖跨境购买（楽天等）
zh.channelDesc: 沙龙渠道头皮护理销量第一，946 mL专业装对应head spa头疗操作场景

japan: No official channel in Japan; cross-border purchase via Rakuten and similar
en.channelDesc: The number one scalp care brand in salon distribution, with the 946 mL professional size serving head spa treatments

zh.tagline: Like skincare for your scalp
zh.concept: Briogeo由Nancy Twine于2013年创立，以6-free标准与天然成分起家。Scalp Revival是品牌最具代表性的系列，也是沙龙渠道头皮护理的销量第一，把面部护理的清洁—去角质—精华三步结构完整移植到头皮，为head spa头疗趋势提供了零售端的产品对应。

en.concept: Founded by Nancy Twine in 2013 on a 6-free standard and natural ingredients, Briogeo's signature range Scalp Revival is the number one scalp care line in salon distribution. It transplants the facial cleanse-exfoliate-serum structure wholesale onto the scalp, giving the head spa trend its retail counterpart.

zh.name: Briogeo Scalp Revival Scalp Treatment（同系列）
points: 同系列互补：这支是每周磨砂（洗去型），精华是日常免洗，共同构成面部护理式的两步结构
两支产品的核心成分分工不同：磨砂用微晶纤维素，精华用Saccharide Isomerate做长效保湿
数字表达也不同：磨砂是「减少82%脱屑」（可视觉计数），精华是「水分提升2倍」（仪器读数）

zh.name: Neutrogena Hair Restore Strength + Purity Shampoo
points: 两者都做头皮去角质，Briogeo用物理磨砂（微晶纤维素），Neutrogena用化学去角质（1.5%苦杏仁酸）
US$0.178/mL对US$0.025/mL，约7倍差价，买的是仪式感体验与沙龙渠道背书
Neutrogena主张日常使用，Briogeo主张每周一次——使用频次的定位完全不同

zh.name: OUAI Detox Clarifying Shampoo
points: 同为高端清洁型洗发水，OUAI用螯合剂处理硬水矿物质，Briogeo用物理磨砂处理角质与残留
Briogeo有「减少82%脱屑」的临床数字，OUAI更依赖品牌调性与香型
Briogeo有946 mL沙龙专业装，渠道纵深更完整

en.name: Briogeo Scalp Revival Scalp Treatment (same range)
points: Complementary within the range: this is the weekly rinse-off scrub, the serum is the daily leave-in, and together they form the facial-style two-step
Their core ingredients divide the work: microcrystalline cellulose here, saccharide isomerate for lasting hydration there
Their numbers differ too: 82% less flaking (visually countable) against 2x hydration (an instrumental reading)

en.name: Neutrogena Hair Restore Strength + Purity Shampoo
points: Both exfoliate the scalp, Briogeo physically with microcrystalline cellulose and Neutrogena chemically with 1.5% mandelic acid
US$0.178/mL against US$0.025/mL, roughly 7x, buying ritual experience and salon endorsement
Neutrogena is positioned for daily use and Briogeo for weekly — entirely different frequency positioning

en.name: OUAI Detox Clarifying Shampoo
points: Both are prestige clarifying shampoos, OUAI using chelators against hard-water minerals and Briogeo physical exfoliation against dead skin and buildup
Briogeo has a clinical figure (82% less flaking) while OUAI leans more on brand tone and scent
Briogeo's 946 mL professional size gives it deeper channel coverage

insight.zh:
这支磨砂洗发水卖的是"沙龙头疗搬回家"这个体验。

* 概念不是凭空造的："facial-like ritual for the scalp"把美容院常见的面部护理仪式感移植到头皮护理，呼应了近年沙龙渠道流行的head spa头疗趋势。
* 专业装是给渠道的信任印证：946 mL专业装不是给消费者家用的，是直接对应沙龙操作场景设计的，零售装给消费者、专业装给沙龙渠道，两头互相印证"这是专业级产品"。
* 磨砂精华分工明确：跟同系列的Scalp Revival Treatment构成两件套，磨砂负责物理去角质，精华负责保湿，分工清楚。

战略启示：同时铺零售和专业两个规格，能让消费者在家用产品时也联想到"这是沙龙同款"的专业背书。
insight.en:
This scalp scrub sells the experience of bringing a salon scalp spa home.

* The concept isn't invented from thin air: "facial-like ritual for the scalp" transplants the familiar facial-treatment ritual feel onto scalp care, echoing the head-spa trend popular in salon channels recently.
* The professional size is a channel trust signal: the 946 mL professional size isn't meant for home use — it's built for salon operations, with the retail size for consumers and the professional size for salons cross-validating "this is a professional-grade product."
* Clear division of labor between scrub and treatment: paired with the same-line Scalp Revival Treatment as a two-piece set, the scrub handles physical exfoliation and the treatment handles hydration.

Strategic takeaway: offering both a retail and a professional size lets consumers associate their at-home product with a salon-grade credential.

notes.zh: 资料采集日 2026-07-31。成分表以INCIDecoder（23项）为准；价格与规格取自Sephora（8 oz US$42.00、2 oz迷你US$15.00）与品牌官网（946 mL专业装）。「减少最高82%干性头皮脱屑（一次使用后）」为品牌官方临床宣称。
notes.en: Researched 2026-07-31. Ingredients per INCIDecoder (23 items); prices and sizes from Sephora (8 oz at US$42.00, 2 oz mini at US$15.00) and the brand site (946 mL professional). The claim of up to 82% less dry scalp flaking after one use is the brand's own clinical claim.

name.zh: Aveda Scalp Solutions Balancing Shampoo
name.en: Aveda Scalp Solutions Balancing Shampoo

company.zh: Aveda（美国明尼阿波利斯，1978年创立；现属雅诗兰黛集团）
company.en: Aveda (Minneapolis, USA; founded 1978, now part of the Estée Lauder Companies)

launch.zh: Scalp Solutions系列2023年1月上市，本品为系列的每日清洁步骤；系列替代了此前停产的Scalp Benefits线
launch.en: Scalp Solutions launched in January 2023; this is the daily cleansing step of the range, which replaced the discontinued Scalp Benefits line

price.en: US$39.00 (200 mL, official site); US$14.00 (50 mL); UK RRP £30.00, £22.50 at LOOKFANTASTIC; Japan ¥4,950 (200 mL, incl. tax) and ¥19,800 (1000 mL, incl. tax). Roughly US$0.195/mL

market.zh: Aveda沙龙与直营店、Sephora、Boots、LOOKFANTASTIC、日本Aveda官方渠道与沙龙
market.en: Aveda salons and stores, Sephora, Boots, LOOKFANTASTIC, and Aveda's official channels and salons in Japan

positioning.zh: Scalp Solutions系列的每日清洁步骤，US$39/200 mL的沙龙价位。官网宣称与同系列护发素完全相同：头皮水分1周+92%、2周+128%，同为「临床测试32名女性」。产品自身的差异化在感官——薄荷醇与乳酸薄荷酯带来即刻清凉感，配合无硫酸盐的异硫酸酯基底，主打「清洁但不干燥」。
positioning.en: The daily cleansing step of Scalp Solutions, at a salon price of US$39 per 200 mL. The official claim is identical to the matching conditioner's: +92% scalp hydration at one week and +128% at two, both from "clinical testing on 32 women". Its own differentiation is sensory — menthol and menthyl lactate give an immediate cooling sensation over a sulfate-free isethionate base, selling "cleansing without drying".

target.zh: 头皮出油、有产品残留感、但同时怕洗发水洗得太干的人群；愿意为沙龙头皮护理付费的消费者
target.en: People with oily scalps and build-up who still fear that shampoo will strip them, and consumers willing to pay for salon scalp care

有造型品残留、在意「洗不干净」的人群
从停产的Scalp Benefits线转过来的老用户
偏好植物来源与环境责任叙述的沙龙客
en: Combination scalps — oily roots with dry ends
People bothered by styling-product build-up and the sense of never getting clean
Long-time users migrating from the discontinued Scalp Benefits line
Salon clients who favour plant-derived formulas and environmental positioning

温和清洁，去除多余油脂、污垢与环境污染物
不致干燥的每日用配方，即刻清凉感
温和不刺激头皮；染发适用；皮肤科医生评估；经临床测试

Gently cleanses to remove excess oil, impurities and pollution
A non-drying everyday formula with an instant cooling sensation
Gentle and non-irritating to the scalp; colour safe; dermatologist evaluated; clinically tested
94% naturally derived on average per the ISO 16128 Standard, from plant, non-petroleum mineral and/or water
Vegan and cruelty free

ingredients.zh: 水、椰油酰羟乙磺酸酯钠、氯化钠、丙二醇、甲基椰油酰基牛磺酸钠、巴巴苏酰胺丙基甜菜碱、椰油酰胺MIPA、硬脂酸乙二醇酯、穿心莲提取物、积雪草提取物、乳酸杆菌发酵产物、向日葵籽油、锌PCA、甘油、澳洲坚果油乙酯、薄荷醇、乳酸薄荷酯、辛酸甘油酯、生育酚、瓜尔胶羟丙基三甲基氯化铵、柠檬酸、苹果酸、香精、芳樟醇、柠檬烯、香叶醇、羟基香茅醛、水杨酸苄酯、亚氨基二琥珀酸四钠、山梨酸钾、苯氧乙醇、苯甲酸钠。共31项。
ingredients.en: Water (Aqua) Eau, Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Sodium Chloride, Propanediol, Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate, Babassuamidopropyl Betaine, Cocamide Mipa, Glycol Stearate, Andrographis Paniculata Extract, Centella Asiatica (Hydrocotyl) Extract, Lactobacillus Ferment, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Zinc Pca, Glycerin, Ethyl Macadamiate, Menthol, Menthyl Lactate, Glyceryl Caprylate, Tocopherol, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride, Citric Acid, Malic Acid, Fragrance (Parfum), Linalool, Limonene, Geraniol, Hydroxycitronellal, Benzyl Salicylate, Tetrasodium Iminodisuccinate, Potassium Sorbate, Phenoxyethanol, Sodium Benzoate. 31 items in total.

ingredientsNote.zh:
配方里没有任何去角质酸。柠檬酸与苹果酸的位置在香精之前、含量段很低，功能是调pH而非去角质。但Sephora马来西亚站给这支产品打了「AHAs/Glycolic Acid」和「BHAs/Salicylic Acid」两个标签——全成分表里既没有甘醇酸也没有水杨酸。渠道方自动生成的功效标签不能作为竞品分析的依据，必须回到INCI。

功效成分（穿心莲、积雪草、乳酸杆菌发酵产物、向日葵籽油、锌PCA）与同系列护发素几乎完全一致，是一套跨剂型共用的功效平台。这与Neutrogena和OGX共用1.5%苦杏仁酸的做法同类：一次原料谈判与安全性评估，摊到整条线上。
ingredientsNote.en:
There is no exfoliating acid in the formula. Citric and malic acid sit just before the fragrance at very low levels and adjust pH rather than exfoliate. Yet Sephora Malaysia tags the product with both "AHAs/Glycolic Acid" and "BHAs/Salicylic Acid" — the INCI list contains neither glycolic nor salicylic acid. Retailer-generated benefit tags cannot serve as a basis for competitive analysis; go back to the INCI.

The functional set — andrographis, centella, lactobacillus ferment, sunflower seed oil, zinc PCA — is almost identical to the matching conditioner's: one active platform shared across formats. The logic matches Neutrogena and OGX sharing a 1.5% mandelic acid platform: negotiate the raw material and clear the safety work once, then spread it across the line.

zh.name: 椰油酰羟乙磺酸酯钠（SCI）
zh.desc: 第一位表活，无硫酸盐体系里成本较高的一档，泡沫细密、洗后不涩。搭配甲基椰油酰基牛磺酸钠与巴巴苏酰胺丙基甜菜碱，构成「清洁力够但不夺脂」的基底。

zh.name: 薄荷醇＋乳酸薄荷酯
zh.desc: 两种清凉剂叠加：薄荷醇起效快，乳酸薄荷酯持续时间长、刺激性更低。清凉感是这支洗发水唯一可被消费者即时感知的差异点，也是它与护发素共用数字时的自我标识。

zh.name: 锌PCA
zh.desc: 与同系列护发素共用，支撑「油性到干性头皮都适用」的宣称。

zh.name: 穿心莲＋积雪草＋乳酸杆菌发酵产物
zh.desc: 三者在洗发水与护发素中位置几乎相同，是系列功效叙述的统一来源，而不是单品专属配方。

en.name: Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate (SCI)
en.desc: The first surfactant listed and one of the costlier options in a sulfate-free system, giving dense lather without a squeaky finish. With sodium methyl cocoyl taurate and babassuamidopropyl betaine it forms a base that cleans without stripping.

en.name: Menthol + menthyl lactate
en.desc: Two coolants stacked: menthol acts fast, menthyl lactate lasts longer and irritates less. The cooling sensation is the only difference a consumer can register instantly, and it is how this shampoo signs its own name while sharing the range's numbers.

en.name: Zinc PCA
en.desc: Shared with the matching conditioner; it supports the "oily to dry scalp" claim.

en.name: Andrographis + centella + lactobacillus ferment
en.desc: All three appear at almost the same positions in the shampoo and the conditioner — the range's efficacy story comes from one platform, not from per-product formulas.

zh.title: 一组临床数字覆盖两支单品
zh.desc: +92%/+128%（32名女性）在洗发水页与护发素页上完全相同。系列联合测试的结果被拆开、分别挂在两支产品上。这在合规表述上成立（消费者本就被要求配套使用），成本上只做一次测试，宣称上却覆盖整条线。

zh.title: 清凉感作为单品识别
zh.desc: 数字与系列共用，感官归单品。洗发水在头皮上停留时间短，清凉是唯一能在几秒内建立记忆的通道。

zh.title: 无硫酸盐但不弱化清洁叙述
zh.desc: 用SCI＋牛磺酸盐体系换掉SLES，同时保留「去除油脂、污垢与污染物」的强清洁措辞。温和与清洁力在文案上不互相让步。

zh.title: ISO 16128：可核查的天然宣称
zh.desc: 「94%天然来源」直接标注ISO 16128与计算范围（植物、非石油来源矿物、水）。给出标准名的天然宣称比自定义比例更难被质疑，也更容易在跨市场沿用。

en.title: One clinical number covering two SKUs
en.desc: +92%/+128% on 32 women appears identically on the shampoo page and the conditioner page. A range-level test is split and attached to each product. It holds up in claim terms — consumers are told to use them together — costs one study, and covers the whole line.

en.title: Cooling as the product's own signature
en.desc: The numbers belong to the range, the sensation to the product. A shampoo sits on the scalp for seconds, so cooling is the only channel that can build a memory in that time.

en.title: Sulfate-free without softening the cleansing story
en.desc: SLES is replaced by an SCI and taurate system, yet the copy keeps the strong wording of removing oil, impurities and pollution. Mildness and cleansing power concede nothing to each other in the text.

en.title: ISO 16128 as a checkable natural claim
en.desc: "94% naturally derived" names the ISO 16128 Standard and the calculation basis (plant, non-petroleum mineral, water). A natural claim tied to a published standard is harder to challenge and easier to reuse across markets.

evidence.zh: 头皮水分1周+92%、2周+128%（临床测试，32名女性）；94%天然来源（ISO 16128）；皮肤科医生评估；经临床测试；染发适用。
evidence.en: +92% scalp hydration at one week, +128% at two (clinical testing, 32 women); 94% naturally derived (ISO 16128); dermatologist evaluated; clinically tested; colour safe.

zh: 头皮水分：1周+92%、2周+128%（临床测试，32名女性）
与同系列护发素的宣称数字完全一致，来源应为同一项系列测试
样本量32人偏小，基线值、对照组与测量方法均未公开
94%天然来源有ISO 16128标准与计算范围支撑，是本条目里可核查程度最高的数字

Identical to the matching conditioner's figures, so the source is presumably one range-level study
A sample of 32 is small; baseline, control and measurement method are all undisclosed
"94% naturally derived" is backed by the ISO 16128 Standard and a stated calculation basis — the most checkable number in this entry

561 customer reviews on the official site; the negatives cluster around "not the same as the discontinued Scalp Benefits" and itchy scalp for some users

zh.tagline: Beautiful hair starts from within
zh.concept: Aveda自1978年起以植物来源成分与环境责任建立品牌。Scalp Solutions系列2023年上市，取代停产多年的Scalp Benefits，把「头皮健康决定头发状态」从品牌主张变成一条五步产品线。

功效成分（锌PCA、穿心莲、积雪草、乳酸杆菌发酵产物）在两支产品中高度重叠

zh.name: 8 THE THALASSO Moist Shampoo
points: 同为头皮向清洁，8T用海洋深层水与保湿讲故事，Aveda用可测量的头皮水分数字
价格差距明显：Aveda US$0.195/mL属沙龙价，8T为日本药妆价位
Aveda把ISO 16128标准名写进天然宣称，8T的天然表述未绑定第三方标准

zh.name: CeraVe Gentle Hydrating Shampoo
points: 同为「清洁但不干燥」，CeraVe用神经酰胺讲屏障，Aveda用清凉感与植物来源讲体感
CeraVe无香精、皮肤科背书、低价；Aveda以植物精油香氛为品牌签名，两者对香精敏感人群方向相反
CeraVe的宣称数字在官网自相矛盾（5x与4x），Aveda两支产品的数字则完全一致——系列内一致性是可以做到的

en.name: Aveda Scalp Solutions Replenishing Conditioner (same range)
points: Both carry the same clinical figures (+92%/+128%, 32 women), pointing to one range-level study
The conditioner stands on redefining an existing step; the shampoo stands on cooling — shared numbers, divided sensory roles
The actives (zinc PCA, andrographis, centella, lactobacillus ferment) overlap heavily between the two

en.name: 8 THE THALASSO Moist Shampoo
points: Both are scalp-oriented cleansers; 8T tells a deep-sea-water hydration story while Aveda publishes a measurable scalp-hydration number
The price gap is wide: Aveda's US$0.195/mL is salon-tier against 8T's Japanese drugstore pricing
Aveda names the ISO 16128 Standard inside its natural claim; 8T's natural wording is not tied to a third-party standard

en.name: CeraVe Gentle Hydrating Shampoo
points: Both promise cleansing without drying; CeraVe argues barrier through ceramides, Aveda sells sensation through cooling and plant origin
CeraVe is fragrance-free, dermatologist-backed and cheap; Aveda signs with plant-essence fragrance — opposite directions for fragrance-sensitive users
CeraVe's own site contradicts itself on its numbers (5x vs 4x) while Aveda's two products match exactly — internal consistency is achievable

insight.zh:
这支洗发水的核心宣称完全借用了同系列护发素的数据。

* 系列共享数据省了测试成本：官网直接说"与护发素相同的头皮水分提升数据"，系列产品共享同一套临床证据，省去单独测试的成本，也强化"这是一整套系统"的认知。
* 差异化落在感官上：功效数据既然是共享的，真正的差异化就落在感官层面——薄荷醇带来的清凉感是消费者能立刻感知到的东西，弥补了功效数据看不见摸不着的问题。
* 同一概念不同价位段都能立足：定价沙龙级，跟CeraVe、8 THE THALASSO这些走完全不同定价策略的"头皮屏障"品牌对比，说明清洁不干燥这个概念可以在不同价位段找到市场。

战略启示：系列内共享同一套功效数据是合理的成本节省方式，但每个单品仍然需要一个消费者能立刻感知到的独立卖点。
insight.en:
This shampoo's core claim entirely borrows the data from its same-line conditioner.

* Shared line data saves testing costs: the official site states directly that it shares the same scalp-hydration data as the conditioner — sharing one clinical dataset across a line saves on separate testing and reinforces the "this is one system" perception.
* Differentiation sits in sensation: since the efficacy data is shared, real differentiation moves to the sensory level — the cooling feel from menthol is something consumers notice instantly, compensating for efficacy data that can't be felt.
* The same concept works at different price tiers: priced at the salon tier, contrasting with CeraVe and 8 THE THALASSO, which take entirely different pricing strategies for a similar "scalp barrier" concept, showing "cleanse without drying" can find a market at multiple price points.

Strategic takeaway: sharing one efficacy dataset across a product line is a reasonable cost-saving move, but each item still needs its own instantly perceptible selling point that doesn't rely on the shared data alone.

positioning.zh: 品类开创型抗湿防毛躁喷雾，主打热感激活的防水'雨衣'技术，为顺直/微卷发质提供长效（3-4次洗发）光滑抗湿定型效果。
positioning.en: A category-defining anti-frizz, humidity-proofing spray built around heat-activated 'raincoat' technology, delivering long-lasting (3-4 shampoos) sleek, humidity-resistant styling for straight to wavy hair.

target.zh: 受湿度/毛躁困扰、追求顺直有光泽造型效果的顺发至微卷发质消费者；也覆盖染烫后需要额外光泽与热保护的人群。
target.en: Consumers with straight-to-wavy hair battling humidity and frizz who want a sleek, glassy finish; also color-treated or heat-styled hair needing extra shine and heat protection.

ingredients.zh: 水、二丙二醇、聚硅氧烷-29（Polysilicone-29）、季铵化硅油-18、甘油、洋甘菊花提取物、金盏花提取物等；核心为受纺织防水技术启发的热感激活聚合物体系。
ingredients.en: Water, Dipropylene Glycol, Polysilicone-29, Silicone Quaternium-18, Glycerin, Chamomilla Recutita (Matricaria) Flower Extract, Calendula Officinalis Flower Extract, and others; the core is a heat-activated polymer system inspired by textile waterproofing technology.

evidence.zh: 官网未公开第三方临床测试数据；宣称效果基于消费者规模化好评（Color Wow官网显示超2万条评价，平均4.7/5星）与热感/拉力实测原理说明，而非发表的临床研究。
evidence.en: No third-party clinical trial data is disclosed on the official site; efficacy claims rest on large-scale consumer review volume (Color Wow's site shows 22,000+ reviews averaging 4.7/5 stars) and a mechanism explanation for heat/tension activation, rather than a published clinical study.

packaging.zh: 瓶身印着水珠滚落发丝的插画，把"防水"这个功能概念直接可视化，第一眼就能看懂产品是干什么用的。整体调性偏功能演示型，不走高级感路线，更像一个"说明书式包装"。
packaging.en: The bottle prints an illustration of water beading off a hair strand, visualizing the "waterproof" claim so directly that the function reads instantly. The overall tone is demonstrative rather than luxurious, closer to an instruction diagram than a beauty object.

insight.zh:
这支喷雾的护城河是"洗几次都不掉"这个具体承诺。

* 数字比形容词更有说服力：大部分抗湿喷雾只说"当天有效"，这支产品把有效期具体到"3-4次洗发"，可验证的数字比模糊的"长效"更容易被记住、也更容易拿来跟竞品比较。
* 用比喻翻译技术概念："雨衣"把一个防水成膜的化学原理翻译成了生活化的画面，不需要理解成分也能秒懂产品在做什么。
* 竞品选了Redken、Living Proof、Kérastase这些专业线品牌，说明Color Wow虽然渠道更大众，但技术叙事是在跟沙龙专业线正面竞争，价位卡在大众和专业线中间（masstige）。

战略启示：给功效诉求配一个具体可验证的数字，比堆砌形容词更容易建立信任。
insight.en:
This spray's moat is a concrete promise: it won't wash out for 3-4 shampoos.

* A number persuades more than an adjective: most anti-frizz sprays just say "lasts all day"; this product specifies its lifespan as 3-4 washes, a verifiable figure that's easier to remember and compare against competitors than a vague "long-lasting" claim.
* A metaphor translates the technical concept: "raincoat" turns a waterproof-film chemistry into an everyday image, instantly understandable without knowing the science.
* Its competitors, Redken, Living Proof, and Kérastase, are all professional-line brands, showing Color Wow's technology narrative competes head-on with salon lines even though its channel is more mass, landing its price between mass and prestige (masstige).

Strategic takeaway: pairing a benefit claim with a specific, verifiable number builds more trust than stacking adjectives.

name.zh: HONEYQUE Deep Repair Shampoo Moist
name.en: HONEYQUE Deep Repair Shampoo Moist

company.zh: Bottle Works（ボトルワークス株式会社）
company.en: Bottle Works Inc.

launch.en: Core item in the HONEY PROTEIN SERIES; ongoing lineup item

market.zh: 日本药妆、乐天、Amazon 日本官方店，以及 LAMOUR、YesStyle 等海外电商
market.en: Japanese drugstores, Rakuten and Amazon Japan, plus overseas e-commerce such as LAMOUR and YesStyle

capacity.zh: 450 mL（另有 400 mL 替换装、10 mL+10 mL 1日体验装）
capacity.en: 450 mL (also a 400 mL refill and a 10 mL+10 mL 1-day trial set)

positioning.zh: HONEY PROTEIN SERIES 的核心洗发水，主打“从发芯强韧”的密发概念：蜂蜜负责保水，3 种水解蛋白（乳、大豆、蜂王浆）与多种水解角蛋白/水解丝负责从内部强韧发丝，另含水解芝麻蛋白 PG-丙基甲基硅烷二醇提供热保护。产品页明确列出五项功效——うねりケア（卷翘护理）、湿气ブロック（防湿气）、パサつき（干燥毛躁护理）、キューティクル补修、ヒートプロテクト。与同品牌 HONEY COLLAGEN SERIES（如 Rich Gloss Treatment）以“胶原蛋白＋空洞化修护”为核心不同，Deep Repair 这条线把“蛋白质密度”作为差异化技术语言。
positioning.en: The hero shampoo of the HONEY PROTEIN SERIES, built around a core message of strengthening hair from the inside. Honey handles water retention, while three hydrolyzed proteins (milk, soy, royal jelly) plus several hydrolyzed keratins and hydrolyzed silk reinforce the fiber from within; a hydrolyzed sesame protein PG-propyl methylsilanediol adds heat protection. The official page lists five benefits: wave/frizz care, humidity block, dryness care, cuticle repair and heat protection. Unlike the brand's HONEY COLLAGEN SERIES (e.g. Rich Gloss Treatment), which centers on collagen and hollow-damage repair, this line uses protein density as its differentiating technology language.

target.zh: 面向うねり（卷翘）、广散、干燥毛躁困扰的人群，以及愿意做“泡パック”（泡沫敷面式）深层护理的消费者。价格带与 &honey、TSUBAKI 等大众高机能洗护重叠，目标客群同样偏年轻至中年女性。
target.en: For consumers dealing with waviness/frizz, flyaways and dryness who are willing to do a foam-mask style deep-conditioning ritual. The price band overlaps with &honey and TSUBAKI in Japan's mass-premium haircare segment, targeting a similar young-to-middle-aged female audience.

distribution.zh: 450 mL／¥1,650，与 &honey Deep Moist Shampoo 1.0（440 mL／¥1,540）几乎同价位，是日本大众高机能洗护的主流价格带。替换装 400 mL／¥1,210 降低复购门槛，10 mL+10 mL 体验装／¥143 提供极低门槛试用入口。
distribution.en: At 450 mL for ¥1,650, this sits almost exactly at the same price as &honey Deep Moist Shampoo 1.0 (440 mL at ¥1,540) — the mainstream Japanese mass-premium haircare price band. A 400 mL refill at ¥1,210 lowers the repeat-purchase barrier, and a 10 mL+10 mL trial set at ¥143 offers an extremely low-commitment entry point.

ingredients.zh: 洗净基剂为月桂酰胺丙基甜菜碱、月桂酰甲基丙氨酸钠、C14-16 烯烃磺酸钠、椰油酰甲基 MEA、椰油酰甲基牛磺酸钠的复配，属氨基酸系与烯烃磺酸盐混合的中等偏温和清洁体系。功效层为蜂蜜、水解乳蛋白、水解大豆蛋白、水解蜂王浆蛋白，配合甜杏仁油、芒果籽脂、杏仁核油；角质层修护成分包括水解羊毛角质蛋白、多种水解角蛋白（羊毛来源）、水解丝；水解芝麻蛋白 PG-丙基甲基硅烷二醇标注为热保护成分；另含羟丙基三甲基氯化铵透明质酸、透明质酸羧甲基钠、聚季铵盐-47/10 等调理成分，以及肉桂酸乙基己酯等 UV 防护成分。
ingredients.en: The cleansing base combines lauramidopropyl betaine, sodium lauroyl methylalanine, sodium C14-16 olefin sulfonate and cocamide MEA with sodium methyl cocoyl taurate — a medium-mild blend of amino-acid-type and olefin-sulfonate surfactants. The functional layer is honey plus three hydrolyzed proteins (milk, soy, royal jelly), with sweet almond oil, mango seed butter and apricot kernel oil; cuticle-repair actives include hydrolyzed wool cuticle protein, several wool-derived hydrolyzed keratins and hydrolyzed silk. Hydrolyzed sesame protein PG-propyl methylsilanediol is specifically labeled as the heat-protection ingredient. The formula also carries hydroxypropyltrimonium hyaluronate, sodium carboxymethyl hyaluronate, Polyquaternium-47/10 as conditioning agents, and ethylhexyl methoxycinnamate as a UV filter.

evidence.zh: 官方页面以成分功能描述与使用方法为主，未见公开的独立第三方临床或仪器测试。第三方证据来自日本美妆评测杂志《LDK the Beauty》2023 年 1 月号洗发水与护发素专栏，获得 A 评价；拥有 45 万+ 订阅的美妆化学博主“かずのすけ”在 YouTube 上评价其“タンパク质成分的豪华程度”突出。这些是外部媒体/意见领袖的评价，不等同于品牌自行委托的临床数据。
evidence.en: The official page focuses on ingredient function and usage instructions, with no published independent clinical or instrumental data. Third-party validation comes from Japanese beauty review magazine LDK the Beauty (January 2023 issue), which rated it A in its shampoo and conditioner category, and from cosmetic-chemistry YouTuber Kazunosuke (450,000+ subscribers), who highlighted the richness of its protein ingredients. These are external media/influencer assessments, not brand-commissioned clinical data.

packaging.zh: 延续品牌一贯的蜂蜜色系视觉语言，色调温暖圆润，传递"甜润亲肤"的第一印象。视觉基调与同品牌胶原蛋白系列高度雷同，货架识别度不如&honey。
packaging.en: Continues the brand's honey-toned visual language, with warm, rounded tones that read as sweet and skin-friendly at first glance. The visual tone closely echoes the brand's own collagen line, giving it less shelf distinctiveness than &honey.

insight.zh:
这支洗发水把"哪里会出问题"拆解成了五个具体场景。

* 五个功效点对应五种具体困扰：卷翘护理、防湿气、干燥毛躁护理、角质层修补、热保护，而不是笼统说"修复受损"，消费者可以直接对号入座自己的问题。
* 保湿和强韧被拆开分别处理：蜂蜜负责宏观保水，三种水解蛋白负责微观强韧，把两个经常混为一谈的诉求用不同成分分别对应，逻辑更清楚。
* 竞品直接对标同品牌&honey，两条产品线服务不同价位段和功效诉求，避免了左右手互搏。

战略启示：把一个笼统的"修复受损"诉求拆解成用户能对号入座的具体场景清单，比一句话概括更容易让人觉得"这就是给我设计的"。
insight.en:
This shampoo breaks down "what could go wrong" into five concrete scenarios.

* Five benefit points map to five specific concerns: frizz/wave care, humidity block, dryness care, cuticle repair, heat protection, instead of a generic "repairs damage" claim, letting consumers match their own problem directly.
* Hydration and strength are handled separately: honey covers macro-level moisture, three hydrolyzed proteins cover micro-level strength, splitting two often-conflated demands across different ingredients for clearer logic.
* Its competitor is the same brand's own &honey, with the two lines serving different price tiers and benefit claims to avoid cannibalizing each other.

Strategic takeaway: breaking a generic "repairs damage" claim into a checklist of concrete scenarios users can match themselves against feels more "made for me" than a single summary line.

name.zh: ANUA PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum
name.en: ANUA PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum

company.zh: The Founders Inc.（더파운더즈，韩国首尔，2017年成立）
company.en: The Founders Inc. (Seoul, Korea; founded 2017)

launch.zh: 品牌"VIRAL PDRN"系列核心单品，持续在售
launch.en: Core item in the brand's VIRAL PDRN collection, ongoing lineup item

market.zh: Amazon美国/日本、Ulta Beauty、Olive Young、品牌官网（anua.com/anua.kr）
market.en: Amazon US/Japan, Ulta Beauty, Olive Young, brand DTC (anua.com/anua.kr)

positioning.zh: 以鲑鱼来源PDRN（Sodium DNA）为核心的高浓度精华，主打"三重修护复合物"——PDRN、8种以上不同分子量透明质酸与水解胶原蛋白协同，用"Smart Capsule 100"微囊递送技术包裹活性成分。产品呈天然祖母绿色（来自配方本身而非色素），官方强调这是韩国首支"100%纯粹未稀释"的PDRN精华，把近两年韩妆最热的PDRN成分从医美语境带入日常护肤品类。
positioning.en: A high-concentration serum built on salmon-derived PDRN (Sodium DNA), positioned around a Triple Revitalizing Complex — PDRN, eight-plus molecular weights of hyaluronic acid and hydrolyzed collagen working together, delivered via the brand's Smart Capsule 100 microcapsule technology. The serum's natural emerald tint comes from the formula itself, not added colorant. The brand markets it as Korea's first fully undiluted PDRN serum, moving PDRN — one of K-beauty's hottest actives over the past two years — from med-spa treatments into everyday skincare.

target.zh: 追求高浓度活性成分、愿意为"医美成分居家化"买单的消费者；干燥缺水、追求"玻璃肌"光泽感的人群；已经在关注PDRN这一成分趋势、通过社媒（尤其TikTok）了解到该品类的年轻消费者。
target.en: Consumers seeking high-concentration actives and willing to pay for med-spa ingredients brought home; dry, dehydrated skin chasing a glass-skin glow; younger consumers who discovered the PDRN trend through social media, especially TikTok.

distribution.zh: 30 mL / US$30.00，单毫升约US$1.00，定位在美妆专业零售（Ulta）与电商（Amazon）之间的masstige价位。品牌80%以上营收来自海外市场，2022年12月通过Amazon切入北美，主要靠TikTok话题营销＋Amazon承接转化的打法起量。
distribution.en: 30 mL at US$30.00, about US$1.00 per mL, sitting in the masstige band between prestige retail (Ulta) and e-commerce (Amazon). Over 80% of the brand's revenue comes from overseas markets; it entered North America via Amazon in December 2022, scaling mainly through TikTok-driven awareness converted into Amazon sales.

ingredients.zh: 水、丁二醇、丙二醇、甘油、水解透明质酸（29,049ppm）、1,2-己二醇、烟酰胺、油酸甘油酯、月桂醇葡糖苷、肉豆蔻醇葡糖苷、聚甘油-6月桂酸酯、氢化卵磷脂、谷胱甘肽、水解胶原蛋白、透明质酸钠（800ppm）、黄连根提取物、腺苷、Sodium DNA（PDRN，100ppm）、透明质酸（30ppm）、水解透明质酸钠（30ppm）、羟丙基三甲基氯化铵透明质酸（30ppm）、透明质酸钾（30ppm）、透明质酸钠交联聚合物（30ppm）、乙酰化透明质酸钠（1ppm）、印楝叶/花提取物、茄科植物（茄子）果提取物、圣罗勒叶提取物、柠檬酸、姜黄根提取物、珊瑚藻提取物、柠檬酸钠、戊二醇。
ingredients.en: Water, Butylene Glycol, Propanediol, Glycerin, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid (29,049 ppm), 1,2-Hexanediol, Niacinamide, Glyceryl Oleate, Lauryl Glucoside, Myristyl Glucoside, Polyglyceryl-6 Laurate, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Glutathione, Hydrolyzed Collagen, Sodium Hyaluronate (800 ppm), Coptis Japonica Root Extract, Adenosine, Sodium DNA (PDRN, 100 ppm), Hyaluronic Acid (30 ppm), Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate (30 ppm), Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate (30 ppm), Potassium Hyaluronate (30 ppm), Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer (30 ppm), Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate (1 ppm), Melia Azadirachta (Neem) Leaf/Flower Extract, Solanum Melongena (Eggplant) Fruit Extract, Ocimum Sanctum (Holy Basil) Leaf Extract, Citric Acid, Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract, Corallina Officinalis Extract, Sodium Citrate, Pentylene Glycol.

evidence.zh: 官方宣称：单次使用后即时保湿蓬润感提升8.93%，深层保湿提升24.64%（均标注为"temporary"暂时性效果）。另标注"Clinically Tested""Non-comedogenic""Low irritation""No Artificial Color"四项标识。品牌另有公开报道称与美国哈佛大学背景研究者合作开发"Smart Capsule"递送技术，宣称人体试验中该工艺角质层渗透优于未采用该工艺的对照组。Amazon官网评分4.7/5（48条评价），94%推荐率。
evidence.en: Official claims: temporary hydration and plumping effect improved 8.93% after one use, and temporary deep skin hydration improved 24.64% after one use (both explicitly labeled temporary). The listing also carries "Clinically Tested," "Non-comedogenic," "Low irritation" and "No Artificial Color" badges. Separate press coverage states the brand worked with a Harvard-trained researcher to develop its Smart Capsule delivery technology, claiming better stratum-corneum penetration than a non-encapsulated control in human testing. The official site shows 4.7/5 from 48 reviews with a 94% recommend rate.

packaging.zh: 深色玻璃瓶配黑色滴管头，唯一记忆点是瓶身放大的"100+"数字，像成分浓度检测报告贴纸。第一眼传递理性克制的"成分党"调性，与&honey式的高级感堆叠路数相反。
packaging.en: A dark glass bottle with a black dropper cap, its one memorable detail an oversized "100+" printed on the front like a concentration test-report sticker. The first impression is rational and restrained, ingredient-nerd territory, the opposite of &honey's stacked-luxury approach.

insight.zh:
这支精华的护城河是"愿意把浓度写到百万分之一"这件事本身。

* 过度透明比笼统宣称更难被质疑：8种透明质酸逐一标注具体ppm数值，从29,049到1，跨度极大但每一个都写清楚，这种做法比笼统说"高浓度"更难被指责是营销话术。
* 数字命名法延伸成了统一资产：品牌把这套ppm精确标注延伸成跨产品线的统一命名逻辑（Heartleaf 77%、PDRN 100+），一个具体数字比模糊的"高浓度"更容易被记住、也更容易复制到新品类。
* 竞品选了医美线PDRN鼻祖Rejuran而不是同价位韩妆，说明品牌是想把PDRN从医美语境往日常护肤拉，直接对标医美渠道的可信度。

战略启示：把浓度精确到具体数字并逐一公开，比笼统宣称高浓度更难被指责是文字游戏，也更容易被记住。
insight.en:
This serum's moat is a willingness to disclose concentration down to one part per million.

* Excessive transparency is harder to dismiss than a vague claim: eight forms of hyaluronic acid are each labeled with an exact ppm figure, spanning from 29,049 down to 1 — an approach harder to write off as marketing spin than a plain "high concentration" claim.
* The numeric naming convention becomes a unified asset: the brand extends this ppm precision into a naming logic across its whole line (Heartleaf 77%, PDRN 100+); a specific number is more memorable and more portable to new categories than a vague "high concentration."
* Its competitor is Rejuran, the med-spa originator of PDRN, rather than a same-priced K-beauty peer, showing the brand wants to pull PDRN from a medical context into daily skincare, borrowing directly against med-spa credibility.

Strategic takeaway: disclosing exact concentration figures rather than making a vague high-concentration claim is harder to dismiss as spin, and easier to remember.

company.zh: d'Alba Global Co., Ltd.（달바글로벌，韩国首尔，2016年成立，2025年韩国交易所上市）
company.en: d'Alba Global Co., Ltd. (Seoul, Korea; founded 2016; listed on the Korea Exchange in 2025)

launch.zh: 品牌招牌单品，全球累计销量超5000万瓶，持续在售
launch.en: The brand's flagship product with over 50 million bottles sold globally; ongoing lineup item

market.zh: 品牌官网（dalba.com）、Amazon、Ulta Beauty、Costco、YesStyle等，海外销售已覆盖15个以上国家
market.en: Brand DTC (dalba.com), Amazon, Ulta Beauty, Costco, YesStyle and more; sold in 15+ countries

price.zh: US$17.00（50 mL）／US$21.00（100 mL，官网价，常有折扣至US$21左右）
price.en: US$17.00 (50 mL) / US$21.00 (100 mL, official site price, frequently discounted)

positioning.zh: 以意大利皮埃蒙特白松露（Trufferol™，白松露+维生素E专利抗氧化复合物）为核心的双层喷雾精华，官方定位为"3合1玻璃肌喷雾"——摇匀后同时具备爽肤水、精华、定妆喷雾三种用法。产品采用油层+水层双相分离设计，喷前摇匀混合，主打"随时随地一喷即光泽"的即时体验，是d'Alba在全球最知名的单品，也是品牌从韩国本土走向海外市场的核心带货产品。
positioning.en: A dual-layer spray serum built around Trufferol™, d'Alba's patented antioxidant complex of Piedmont white truffle and Vitamin E. Positioned as a 3-in-1 glass-skin mist that works as toner, serum and setting spray after shaking to blend its separated oil and water layers. The instant-glow, spray-anywhere experience makes it d'Alba's single most recognized product and the one that carried the brand from the Korean domestic market into global retail.

target.zh: 追求快速提亮、补妆定妆的人群；喜欢喷雾质地、不愿意走完整护肤步骤但想要即时光泽感的用户；化妆师及需要长时间带妆的职业用户。
target.en: Consumers seeking instant brightening and makeup touch-up; those who prefer a mist texture and want immediate glow without a full skincare routine; makeup artists and professionals who need makeup to last through long days.

distribution.zh: 50 mL US$17／100 mL US$21，单毫升价格随规格增大而降低，是典型的"入门尝鲜规格+主力规格"结构。定价处于K-beauty大众高机能价位，比同品牌其他精华类产品（如White Truffle Vital Spray Serum）略低，承担引流角色。
distribution.en: US$17 for 50 mL and US$21 for 100 mL, with per-mL cost dropping at the larger size — a classic trial-size-plus-hero-size structure. Priced in the K-beauty mass-premium band, slightly below the brand's other spray serums, positioning it as the traffic-driving entry item.

ingredients.zh: 水、二丙二醇、新戊二醇二庚酸酯、甘油醚-26、1,2-己二醇、烟酰胺、山梨醇、羟乙基脲、鳄梨油、水杨酸鼠尾草提取物、罗勒花叶茎提取物、甜菜碱、燕麦仁提取物、丁二醇、白松露提取物（Tuber Magnatum Extract）、甘油、向日葵籽油、生育酚乙酸酯、EDTA二钠、甘草酸二钾、腺苷、双歧杆菌发酵产物溶胞物、大豆油、雪莲提取物、人参根提取物、莲花提取物、桑树皮提取物、百合花提取物、高山火绒草提取物、鱼腥草提取物、小苍兰提取物、卡波姆、雏菊花提取物、精氨酸、山柰子提取物、山柰油、生育酚、香精等，全成分共约45项。
ingredients.en: Water, Dipropylene Glycol, Neopentyl Glycol Diheptanoate, Glycereth-26, 1,2-Hexanediol, Niacinamide, Sorbitol, Hydroxyethyl Urea, Avocado Oil, Salvia Hispanica (Chia) Seed Extract, Basil Flower/Leaf/Stem Extract, Betaine, Oat Kernel Extract, Butylene Glycol, Tuber Magnatum (White Truffle) Extract, Glycerin, Sunflower Seed Oil, Tocopheryl Acetate, Disodium EDTA, Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate, Adenosine, Bifida Ferment Lysate, Soybean Oil, Saussurea Involucrata (Snow Lotus) Extract, Panax Ginseng Root Extract, Lotus Flower Extract, Mulberry Bark Extract, Lily Flower Extract, Edelweiss Extract, Houttuynia Cordata Extract, Freesia Extract, Carbomer, Daisy Flower Extract, Arginine, Potassium Sorbate, Bixa Orellana Seed Oil, Tocopherol, Fragrance and more — around 45 ingredients in total.

evidence.zh: 官方消费者测试宣称：单次使用后皮肤水润度提升8.4%；出油减少46%；皱纹改善33%；干燥脱屑改善28%；面部提拉22%。各项测试均标注具体受试人数（20-22人不等），并标注为消费者自评研究（consumer study），非独立第三方临床。产品页标注经皮肤科测试、致痘性测试、24小时贴肤测试证实低敏。官网累计评价750+条，平均4.9/5。
evidence.en: Official consumer-study claims: +8.4% skin hydration after one use, 46% oil reduction, 33% wrinkle reduction, 28% flaky-skin relief and 22% facial lifting. Each figure discloses its sample size (20-22 participants) and is labeled a consumer study, not independent third-party clinical data. The product page states it has been dermatologist-tested, non-comedogenic tested, and hypoallergenic-verified via a 24-hour patch test. The official site shows 750+ reviews averaging 4.9/5.

packaging.zh: 透明塑料喷雾瓶让油水分层清晰可见，本身就是产品最大的视觉卖点——瓶身即广告。整体调性偏轻盈日常，不走厚重奢华路线，第一眼传递的是"随身补水神器"而非精品护肤仪式感。
packaging.en: The clear plastic spray bottle makes the visible oil-water separation itself the biggest visual selling point — the bottle is the ad. The overall tone is light and everyday rather than heavy luxury, reading at first glance as a portable hydration essential rather than a ritual skincare object.

insight.zh:
这支喷雾证明单一大单品策略也能做出全球现象级销量。

* 用场景延展代替产品延展：没有铺开产品线打组合拳，而是让一支双层喷雾同时覆盖爽肤水、精华、定妆喷雾三个使用场景，用场景多元化代替产品数量多元化做增长。
* 配方设计参与自我营销：油水分层本身就是最直观的视觉卖点，消费者不需要看成分表就能理解"这跟普通喷雾不一样"。
* 竞品选了BIODANCE（同为韩系精华喷雾）、Torriden（单一成分叙事）、Mario Badescu（欧美经典水基喷雾）三个完全不同技术路径的对手，说明这支产品是靠摇一摇的仪式感和多场景使用在同一个品类里建立差异化。

战略启示：与其把预算分散到多支新品，不如让一支核心单品承担更多使用场景，靠场景延展而非产品延展来推动增长。
insight.en:
This mist proves an extreme single-hero-product strategy can still produce global-phenomenon sales.

* Extends occasions instead of the product line: rather than a broad SKU matrix, one dual-layer mist covers toner, serum, and setting-spray occasions at once, growing through use-case expansion instead of product-line expansion.
* The formula design does its own marketing: the visible oil-water separation is itself the most intuitive selling point, understood instantly without reading the ingredient list.
* Its competitors, BIODANCE (another Korean spray serum), Torriden (a single-ingredient narrative), and Mario Badescu (a Western water-based mist classic), take three entirely different technical routes, showing this product differentiates within the category through its shake-before-use ritual and multi-occasion use.

Strategic takeaway: rather than spreading budget across many new SKUs, one core product carrying more use occasions can itself be a growth lever.

notes.zh: 资料采集日 2026-08-02。价格、成分与测试数据取自d'Alba官网dalba.com产品页；公司信息取自韩文维基百科与达尔巴官网页脚。

The formula includes meadowfoam lactone, yuzu extract and trehalose, in a violet musk fragrance. It is a distinct formula from the line's Moisture variant, not a renamed version of it.

target.zh: 干燥发梢、分叉、烫染受损发质人群；偏好日系温泉水疗概念、无硅无硫酸盐配方的消费者。
target.en: Consumers with dry ends, split ends and perm/color-damaged hair; those who favor the Japanese onsen-spa concept and silicone-/sulfate-free formulas.

distribution.en: 460 mL at roughly US$18-22, in the mass-premium Japanese haircare band; overseas pricing runs above Japanese drugstore pricing, reflecting cross-border logistics and duty costs.

ingredients.zh: 水、椰油酰甲基牛磺酸钠、月桂酰羟基磺基甜菜碱、椰油酰胺甲基MEA、甘油、温泉水、牛磺酸、洋水仙内酯、柚子提取物、海藻糖、乙酰化透明质酸钠、羟丙基三甲基氯化铵、水解丝蛋白、酒粕精华、甘草酸二钾、水解玉米淀粉、聚季铵盐-10、丙二醇、乙醇、丁二醇、柠檬酸、苯甲酸钠、苯氧乙醇、EDTA二钠、生育酚、香精（紫罗兰麝香）。（原始零售页面成分表翻译质量较差，已按可辨识的INCI术语整理，如与实物包装标注不符请以实物为准）
ingredients.en: Water, Sodium Cocoyl Methyl Taurate, Lauryl Hydroxysultaine, Cocamide MEA, Glycerin, Hot Spring Water, Taurine, Meadowfoam Lactone, Yuzu Extract, Trehalose, Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate, Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride, Hydrolyzed Silk Protein, Sake Lees Extract, Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate, Hydrolyzed Cornstarch, Polyquaternium-10, Propylene Glycol, Alcohol, Butylene Glycol, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate, Phenoxyethanol, Disodium EDTA, Tocopherol, Fragrance (Violet Musk). (The retailer's listed ingredient text had translation-quality issues; cleaned up to recognizable INCI terms — defer to the physical packaging if it differs)

evidence.zh: 2020年官方宣称在日本乐天市场（Rakuten）洗发水类目取得销量第一，属于电商平台销量排名，非独立第三方功效测试。未见公开的临床或仪器测试数据。
evidence.en: The brand states it took the #1 spot in the shampoo category on Rakuten Japan in 2020 — an e-commerce sales ranking, not an independent third-party efficacy test. No public clinical or instrumental data was found.

packaging.zh: 460 mL泵头瓶，日系温泉风格的克制配色，第一眼传递"水疗馆同款"的专业感，而非家用大众洗护的既视感。
packaging.en: A 460 mL pump bottle in restrained Japanese-onsen styling, reading at first glance like something from a spa rather than a mass-market home shampoo.

insight.zh:
这支洗发水把"洗头"和"睡觉"这两件事绑在了一起。

* 具体的时间设定是差异化本身：大部分洗发水只说"修复受损"，没有具体到什么时候用效果最好，这支产品直接把使用场景锁定在晚上，暗示配方是配合睡眠时间设计的。
* 共享母概念但各自独立：跟同系列Moisture保湿款共享"溫泉水療"这个大概念，但香调、成分、场景完全独立，是用同一个母概念孵化出多支各自独立的产品。
* 竞品选了日本专业沙龙线Aujua，说明品牌虽然渠道是大众电商，但想在"专业头皮护理"这个心智位置上跟沙龙品牌竞争。

战略启示：给一个功效诉求配上具体的使用时间点，比笼统说"修复受损"更容易在消费者的日常习惯里找到一个固定位置。
insight.en:
This shampoo ties "washing your hair" to "going to sleep."

* A specific time setting is the differentiator itself: most shampoos just say "repairs damage" without specifying when it works best; this product locks the use case to nighttime, implying the formula is designed around sleep.
* Shares a parent concept but stands independently: it shares the "onsen spa" umbrella concept with the same line's Moisture variant, but scent, ingredients, and occasion are entirely separate — one parent concept incubating several standalone products.
* Its competitor is Aujua, a Japanese professional salon line, showing the brand wants to compete for "professional scalp care" mindshare even though its channel is mass e-commerce.

Strategic takeaway: pairing a benefit claim with a specific time of use finds a fixed spot in a consumer's daily habit more easily than a generic "repairs damage" claim.

It represents the same anti-dandruff platform tuned for a different scalp state.

target.zh: 干性头皮、伴随头屑与紧绷感的人群；不适合强控油型去屑产品的用户。

ingredients.zh: 与同系列Clarifying款共享核心去屑技术平台（锌类去屑活性成分体系），保湿层面官方描述加入植物保湿精华，具体全成分未见独立公开的INCI列表。

evidence.zh: 官方未公开针对本产品的独立临床测试数据，去屑功效宣称基于品牌去屑技术平台的一般性描述。
evidence.en: No independent clinical data specific to this product was found; the anti-dandruff claim is based on general description of the brand's shared dandruff-technology platform.

packaging.zh: 延续系列统一视觉体系，仅靠文字与瓶身细节区分"Hydrating/Dry"与"Clarifying/Oily"，第一眼不容易分辨，需要仔细看标签。
packaging.en: Shares the line's unified visual system, distinguished from the Clarifying/Oily version only by text and minor bottle details — not easy to tell apart at first glance without reading the label closely.

insight.zh:
这支产品存在的理由，是它的姐妹产品刻意留下的空白。

* 同一技术平台服务相反状态：跟Clarifying（油性款）共享同一套去屑技术平台，但配方重心从控油移到保湿，用同一个技术底座服务两种相反的头皮状态，降低了扩张品类的成本。
* 瞄准一个容易被忽略的细分："干性头皮+头屑"听起来矛盾（大家一般觉得头屑跟出油有关），这支产品专门服务这个容易被忽略的人群。
* 竞品选了海飞丝这种国际大众去屑品牌，说明品牌想在被大牌垄断的去屑品类里找一个更精细的切口。

战略启示：同一个技术平台，通过调整配方重心就能服务两种相反的人群，是比重新研发更省成本的品类扩张方式。
insight.en:
This product's reason to exist is a gap deliberately left by its sibling product.

* One technology platform serves opposite conditions: it shares the same anti-dandruff technology platform as the Clarifying (oily) variant, but shifts the formula's focus from oil control to hydration — one technical base serving two opposite scalp conditions, lowering the cost of expanding the line.
* Targets an overlooked niche: "dry scalp plus dandruff" sounds contradictory (dandruff is usually associated with oiliness), and this product specifically serves that overlooked group.
* Its competitor is Head & Shoulders, an international mass dandruff brand, showing the brand is looking for a more precise angle within a category dominated by big names.

Strategic takeaway: the same technology platform can serve two opposite groups just by shifting the formula's emphasis, a cheaper way to expand a line than developing something new from scratch.

positioning.en: The oily-scalp item in the anti-dandruff line, built around a double zinc colloid formula to suppress excess sebum and the odor/itchiness risk that comes with it, alongside plankton extract, piroctone olamine (the anti-dandruff active), sake lees extract, tea leaf extract and eucalyptus leaf oil to improve the scalp environment. It's the cleansing-power-first version of the brand's shared anti-dandruff platform.

ingredients.zh: 核心为双重锌胶体（抑制皮脂过度分泌）与吡罗克酮乙醇胺（去屑活性成分），配合浮游生物提取物、酒粕精华、茶叶精华、桉树叶油等改善头皮环境的辅助成分。三种日本温泉水作为系列共通基底。
ingredients.en: The core is a double zinc colloid (suppressing excess sebum) plus piroctone olamine (the anti-dandruff active), supported by plankton extract, sake lees extract, tea leaf extract and eucalyptus leaf oil to improve the scalp environment. The line's shared base of three Japanese hot spring waters underpins the formula.

evidence.zh: 官方以功效成分组合（双重锌胶体+吡罗克酮乙醇胺）作为去屑力的主要说明依据，未见独立公开的临床测试数据或消费者自评百分比数据。
evidence.en: The brand's main evidence is the named functional combination (double zinc colloid + piroctone olamine) rather than published clinical data or consumer self-assessment percentages.

packaging.zh: 延续系列统一视觉体系，仅靠文字区分"Clarifying/Oily"与"Hydrating/Dry"，第一眼不容易分辨，货架识别度依赖仔细读标签而非配色区隔。
packaging.en: Shares the line's unified visual system, distinguished from the Hydrating/Dry version only by text — shelf recognition depends on reading the label closely rather than color-coding.

insight.zh:
这支产品的核心逻辑是"控油"和"去屑"其实是两件事，只是经常被混为一谈。

* 两个功能分别用不同成分对应：双重锌胶体负责控油，吡罗克酮乙醇胺负责去屑，大部分去屑产品把这两件事打包成一个笼统诉求，这支产品把它们拆开来分别解决。
* 辅助成分负责体感差异化：浮游生物提取物、酒粕精华负责改善头皮环境，在控油和去屑这两个核心功能之外，再加一层体感上的差异化。
* 竞品同样是海飞丝，说明去屑系列的两支产品（干性/油性）都在同一个赛道里对标同一个国际大牌，用细分人群去分流大牌的通用市场。

战略启示：把一个笼统的功能诉求拆解成两个具体的技术动作，能让配方逻辑显得更专业、更有说服力。
insight.en:
This product's core logic: oil control and dandruff control are actually two different things, though usually lumped together.

* Two functions, two different ingredients: double zinc colloid handles oil control, piroctone olamine handles dandruff — most dandruff products bundle these into one vague claim, this one separates them.
* Supporting ingredients differentiate on feel: plankton extract and sake lees extract improve the scalp environment, adding a sensory layer of differentiation on top of the two core functions.
* Its competitor is again Head & Shoulders, showing both items in the anti-dandruff line (dry and oily) compete against the same international giant in the same category, using niche segments to peel off share from a generic mass product.

Strategic takeaway: breaking a vague functional claim into two specific technical actions makes the formula logic feel more professional and persuasive.

positioning.zh: 定位为"防脱发"（Anti Hair Loss）医药部外品级洗发水，日本认证配方，主打促进17型胶原蛋白生成以支持毛囊健康再生，搭配日本人参、甘草根提取物等专利植物复合与三重活性成分协同，针对干性、紧绷头皮人群，改善血液循环、强韧发根。这条产品线跟同品牌"Hair Revitalizing Series"里矿物质酵母发酵技术路线是两套不同的技术平台，命名容易混淆但配方不同，购买前需以具体地区零售页面标注为准。
positioning.en: Positioned as a Japan-certified quasi-drug anti-hair-loss shampoo, built around boosting Type 17 collagen production to support healthy follicle regeneration, paired with a proprietary botanical complex (Japanese ginseng, licorice root extract) and triple active ingredients that improve circulation and reinforce fragile roots, for dry, tight scalps. This is a different technology platform from the mineral-yeast-ferment route used elsewhere in the brand's Hair Revitalizing Series — the naming is easy to conflate but the formulas differ; check the specific regional retail listing before purchase.

target.zh: 干性头皮、发根纤细易断、发量稀薄困扰人群。
target.en: Dry scalps with fine, breakage-prone roots and thinning-hair concerns.

distribution.en: About US$25+ for 100 mL and around US$42 for 300 mL; per-mL pricing varies notably by size and channel, with a clear overseas-distribution markup.

ingredients.zh: 水、乙醇、丁二醇、牛蒡根提取物、酵母/薏苡仁发酵滤液、人参根提取物、葛根提取物、甘草酸二钾、赖氨酸二月桂酰谷氨酸钠、留兰香叶油、桉树叶油、汉防己根提取物、龙胆根提取物、毛竹笋壳提取物。
ingredients.en: Water, Alcohol, Butylene Glycol, Arctium Lappa (Burdock) Root Extract, Saccharomyces/Coix Lacryma-Jobi Ma-Yuen Seed Ferment Filtrate, Panax Ginseng Root Extract, Pueraria Lobata Root Extract, Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate, Sodium Dilauramidoglutamide Lysine, Spearmint Leaf Oil, Eucalyptus Globulus Leaf Oil, Stephania Cepharantha Root Extract, Gentiana Lutea Root Extract, Phyllostachys Pubescens Shoot Bark Extract.

evidence.zh: 官方宣称在日本获得"医药部外品"（quasi-drug）认证，能促进17型胶原蛋白生成，但未见公开的独立临床测试数据、样本量或百分比改善数据。
evidence.en: The brand states it holds Japanese quasi-drug (医薬部外品) certification and claims to boost Type 17 collagen production, but no published independent clinical data, sample size or percentage improvement figures were found.

packaging.zh: 延续系列统一视觉，仅靠"Fortify"与"Densify"文字及Dry/Oily标注区分，第一眼容易与同品牌其他系列混淆，需要仔细读标签才能选对头皮类型。
packaging.en: Shares the line's unified visual system, distinguished only by the words 'Fortify'/'Densify' and the Dry/Oily label — easy to confuse with the brand's other lines at first glance, requiring a close label read to pick the right scalp type.

insight.zh:
这支产品的命名系统本身，就是一个容易踩坑的提醒。

* 命名相似但技术平台完全不同：走医药部外品认证路线，主打促进17型胶原蛋白生成，这跟同品牌"Hair Revitalizing Series"的矿物质酵母发酵技术完全不同，但命名和定位容易被误认成同一条线。
* 老成分配新表述：用人参、甘草根这类传统草本成分，配合"三重活性成分"这种听起来现代的表述，把老成分包装出了新配方的感觉。
* 竞品选了Aveda Scalp Solutions，说明这支产品对标的是专业头皮护理线，而不是大众防脱产品。

战略启示：同一个品牌旗下，如果产品命名相似但技术平台完全不同，消费者和研究者都容易搞混——这提醒我们做竞品调研时，同名不代表同配方，需要逐一核实。
insight.en:
This product's naming system is itself a reminder about a common research pitfall.

* Similar naming, entirely different technology: it takes a quasi-drug certification route built around boosting Type 17 collagen production, completely different from the same brand's "Hair Revitalizing Series" mineral-yeast-ferment technology, yet the naming and positioning are easy to mistake as the same line.
* Old ingredients get new language: ginseng and licorice root, classic botanicals, are paired with modern-sounding phrasing like "triple active ingredients," dressing up old ingredients as a new formula.
* Its competitor is Aveda Scalp Solutions, showing this product benchmarks against professional scalp-care lines, not mass anti-hair-loss products.

Strategic takeaway: within the same brand, similarly-named products on entirely different technology platforms are easy for both consumers and researchers to mix up — a reminder that a shared name doesn't mean a shared formula, and each needs independent verification.

evidence.zh: 官方未公开针对本产品的独立临床测试数据，功效宣称基于命名成分组合的一般性描述，官网无评价数据（MiauMall页面显示暂无评论）。

packaging.zh: 延续系列统一视觉，仅靠"Densify"与"Fortify"文字及Oily/Dry标注区分，第一眼容易混淆，货架辨识度依赖仔细读标签。
packaging.en: Shares the line's unified visual system, distinguished from Fortify only by text and an Oily/Dry label — easy to confuse at first glance, with shelf recognition depending on a close label read.

insight.zh:
这支产品跟Fortify（干性款）共享几乎同一套成分表，但走的是完全不同的技术故事。

* 用发酵技术讲不一样的话：矿物质酵母发酵物（锌铜镁铁硅）是核心技术，用发酵这个相对少见的路径强韧发丝，跟大部分防脱产品主打的咖啡因或胜肽是不同的技术语言。
* 共享平台仍愿意做细致调整：配方针对油性头皮做了清爽度调整，说明品牌在共享技术平台的基础上，仍然愿意为不同头皮状态做细致的配方微调，而不是简单换标签卖同一支产品。
* 竞品选了平价防脱品牌OGX ProGrowth，价格带差距明显，说明这支产品虽然走大众渠道，但价位定得更高。

战略启示：矿物质发酵这类相对小众的技术路径，能帮产品在一个被咖啡因、胜肽占满话语权的品类里找到差异化的技术语言。
insight.en:
This product shares almost the same ingredient list as the Fortify (dry) variant, but tells an entirely different technology story.

* Fermentation technology speaks a different language: mineral yeast ferments (zinc, copper, magnesium, iron, silicon) are the core technology, taking a relatively uncommon fermentation route to strengthen strands, distinct from the caffeine or peptide language most anti-hair-loss products use.
* Fine-tunes even on a shared platform: the formula is adjusted for a lighter feel on oily scalps, showing the brand still makes detailed formula tweaks for different scalp conditions on a shared platform, rather than just relabeling the same product.
* Its competitor is the value brand OGX ProGrowth, with a notable price gap, showing this product is priced higher despite being in a mass channel.

Strategic takeaway: a relatively niche technology route like mineral fermentation can help a product find a differentiated technical vocabulary in a category dominated by caffeine and peptide language.

name.zh: Biore UV Aqua Rich Watery Essence
name.en: Biore UV Aqua Rich Watery Essence

company.zh: 花王株式会社
company.en: Kao Corporation

launch.zh: 2011年首发，2025年已迭代至第5代，累计出货超1亿支
launch.en: First launched in 2011, now in its 5th generation as of 2025, with over 100 million units shipped cumulatively

market.zh: 日本全国药妆店、松本清、Amazon日本、乐天等
market.en: Drugstores nationwide in Japan, Matsumoto Kiyoshi, Amazon Japan, Rakuten and more

positioning.zh: 日本国民级防晒单品，SPF50+/PA++++，主打"瞬间服帖、无涂抹不均"的水感质地。核心技术是2019年第3代开始搭载的"Micro Defense处方"（ミクロディフェンス処方）——官方宣称是全球首创：用含甘油山萮酸酯、山梨坦倍半油酸酯等两亲性成分制成的胶囊包裹UV防护成分，涂抹后胶囊瞬间崩解、均匀铺展，专门解决毛孔、细纹等微观凹凸导致的防晒膜不均匀问题。2025年第5代进一步升级"均一涂膜技术"。
positioning.en: A Japanese mass-market sunscreen staple, SPF50+/PA++++, built around an instant-blend, no-uneven-application watery essence texture. Its core technology, the Micro Defense Formulation introduced in the 3rd generation (2019), is claimed by the brand to be a world first: UV filters are encapsulated in amphiphilic-ingredient capsules (glyceryl behenate, sorbitan sesquioleate) that instantly collapse and spread evenly on skin contact, specifically targeting the uneven film caused by micro-level skin texture like pores and fine lines. The 5th generation (2025) further upgrades the uniform-film-forming technology.

target.zh: 日常通勤、户外活动，追求轻薄不黏腻防晒体验的大众消费者；对涂抹不均、卡粉、泛白问题敏感的用户。
target.en: Mainstream consumers seeking a light, non-sticky sunscreen for daily commuting and outdoor activity; users sensitive to uneven application, caking, or white cast.

distribution.zh: 70g/¥1,078，是日本药妆防晒品类的主流大众价位，另有约1.7倍容量的补充装（フレッシュパウチ）可选，进一步拉低单位成本。
distribution.en: 70g at ¥1,078, sitting in the mainstream mass-market price band for Japanese drugstore sunscreen; a refill pouch at roughly 1.7x the volume is also available, further lowering the per-use cost.

ingredients.zh: 水、甲氧基肉桂酸乙基己酯、乙醇、二氧化硅、棕榈酸异丙酯、乙基己基三嗪酮、DPG、烷基苯甲酸酯(C12-15)、二乙氨羟苯甲酰基苯甲酸己酯、双-乙基己氧苯酚甲氧苯基三嗪、糊精棕榈酸酯、丁二醇、木糖醇、山梨坦倍半油酸酯、(丙烯酸酯类/丙烯酸烷酯(C10-30))交联聚合物、甘油、丙二醇、(丙烯酸羟乙酯/丙烯酰二甲基牛磺酸钠)共聚物、山萮酸甘油酯、异十六烷、氢氧化钾、鲸蜡醇、聚硅氧烷-9、硬脂酰谷氨酸、聚山梨醇酯60、精�酸、抗坏血酸葡糖苷、PEG-12、透明质酸钠、苯氧乙醇、EDTA-2Na、BHT、香精。
ingredients.en: Water, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Alcohol, Silica, Isopropyl Palmitate, Ethylhexyl Triazone, DPG, Alkyl Benzoate (C12-15), Diethylamino Hydroxybenzoyl Hexyl Benzoate, Bis-Ethylhexyloxyphenol Methoxyphenyl Triazine, Dextrin Palmitate, Butylene Glycol, Xylitol, Sorbitan Sesquioleate, (Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate) Crosspolymer, Glycerin, Propanediol, (Hydroxyethyl Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate) Copolymer, Glyceryl Behenate, Isohexadecane, Potassium Hydroxide, Cetyl Alcohol, Polysilicone-9, Stearoyl Glutamate, Polysorbate 60, Arginine, Ascorbyl Glucoside, PEG-12, Sodium Hyaluronate, Phenoxyethanol, Disodium EDTA, BHT, Fragrance.

evidence.zh: 官方展示了2024年8月实施的对比实验：在儿童、成年女性、成年男性面部/前臂以相同用量（2mg/cm²）常规涂抹后，比较UV涂膜均匀性的对照图片，显示改良款涂膜更均匀，但未公开具体量化数值或统计学检验方法。"世界首创"胶囊技术的表述标注了具体查证依据（先行技术调查及Mintel Japan数据库，2018年7月自查）。另标注经非致痘测试与过敏测试。
evidence.en: The brand shows a comparative experiment conducted in August 2024: photos comparing UV film uniformity across children, adult women, and adult men after applying the same amount (2mg/cm²) with normal technique on face/forearm, showing the improved version forms a more even film — but no quantified figures or statistical method are disclosed. The "world first" capsule-technology claim cites a specific basis (prior-art search and the Mintel Japan database, self-checked July 2018). The product is also labeled non-comedogenic tested and allergy tested.

packaging.zh: 透明瓶身配简洁蓝白配色，第一眼传递"药妆平价、家庭常备"的印象，走功能实用路线，不追求精品化视觉。
packaging.en: A clear bottle in a simple blue-and-white palette reads as drugstore-affordable and a household staple at first glance, functional rather than premium in visual language.

insight.zh:
这支防晒最厉害的地方，是十几年只解决一个问题。

* 每一代升级都在解决同一件事：从瞬时服帖配方到Micro Defense胶囊技术再到均一涂膜技术，历代升级都是在解决"涂抹不均"，没有靠新增功效（比如抗老、美白）维持热度。
* 用对比场景让技术卖点可见：用蒸热环境vs干燥室内两种极端场景做对比演示涂膜效果，而不是笼统说"全天舒适"，让一个技术卖点变得可以被直接看到。
* 竞品选了Anessa（专业防晒线）、d'Alba（精品叙事）、NIVEA SUN（国际大众线）三个完全不同定位的对手，说明这支产品靠十几年积累的技术故事，在多个价位段都有说服力。

战略启示：一个基础但被忽视的痛点，只要持续做深，也能撑起十几年的产品生命周期，不需要不断叠加新概念。
insight.en:
This sunscreen's biggest strength is spending over a decade solving one problem.

* Every generation upgrade solves the same thing: from the instant-blend formula, to Micro Defense capsule technology, to uniform-film-forming technology, every upgrade targets uneven application, without leaning on new benefits like anti-aging or brightening to stay relevant.
* Contrasting scenarios make the technology claim visible: comparing hot-humid versus dry-indoor conditions demonstrates the film effect directly, rather than a vague "comfortable all day" claim.
* Its competitors, Anessa (professional sunscreen), d'Alba (prestige narrative), and NIVEA SUN (international mass), span three entirely different positions, showing this product's decade-plus technology story holds up across multiple price tiers.

Strategic takeaway: a basic but overlooked pain point can sustain a decade-plus product lifecycle if pursued deeply enough, without needing to keep stacking new concepts.

name.zh: 肌研 极润 Premium 玻尿酸美容液（化妆水）
name.en: Hada Labo Gokujyun Premium Hyaluronic Lotion

company.zh: 乐敦制药株式会社
company.en: Rohto Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.

launch.zh: 极润系列旗舰高保湿升级线，持续在售并多次改版升级
launch.en: The flagship high-hydration upgrade line within the Gokujyun series, ongoing with multiple reformulation upgrades

market.zh: 日本药妆、乐敦官方商城、LOHACO、Amazon日本、乐天24
market.en: Japanese drugstores, Rohto's official shop, LOHACO, Amazon Japan, Rakuten 24

capacity.en: 170 mL (also available as a 170 mL refill)

positioning.zh: 肌研（Hada Labo）品牌旗下"极润 Premium"系列的高保湿化妆水，主打"肌研史上最多8种玻尿酸"配方，官方给每一种玻尿酸都赋予了具体功能命名（如"3D玻尿酸"负责立体网状锁水、"纳米化玻尿酸"负责深入角质层、"乳酸发酵玻尿酸"用日本清酒酿造用乳酸菌发酵而成）。定位在基础款"极润"（3种玻尿酸）与顶级抗老线之间，是品牌"玻尿酸叙事"里配方最复杂的一条产品线。
positioning.en: The high-hydration lotion within Hada Labo's "Gokujyun Premium" line, built around what the brand calls its most complex hyaluronic acid formula ever — 8 named forms, each assigned a specific function (e.g. "3D Hyaluronic Acid" for net-like moisture retention, "Nano Hyaluronic Acid" for penetrating the stratum corneum, "Lactic Acid-Fermented Hyaluronic Acid" fermented using the same lactic acid bacteria used in sake brewing). It sits between the brand's entry-level Gokujyun line (3 hyaluronic acid forms) and its top anti-aging lines, making it the most formulation-dense product in Hada Labo's hyaluronic acid narrative.

target.zh: 追求高保湿、偏好浓厚黏稠质地化妆水的人群；已经在用基础版极润、想要功能升级的复购用户。
target.en: Consumers seeking intense hydration and a thick, viscous lotion texture; existing basic-Gokujyun users looking to upgrade.

distribution.zh: 170 mL/¥990，比基础版极润（约¥770/170mL）高出约20%，是典型的"基础款引流+升级款拉高客单价"的产品线结构，另配170mL替换装降低复购成本。
distribution.en: 170 mL at ¥990, roughly 20% above the basic Gokujyun (about ¥770/170mL) — a classic entry-line-for-traffic, upgrade-line-for-margin structure, with a 170 mL refill lowering the repeat-purchase cost.

ingredients.zh: 水解透明质酸(C12-13烷基甘油醚)、透明质酸交联聚合物钠、透明质酸羟丙基三甲基氯化铵、透明质酸钠、乙酰化透明质酸钠、水解透明质酸、乳酸球菌/透明质酸发酵液、水解透明质酸钠等8种玻尿酸为核心，配方另含甘油、丁二醇等基础保湿剂，官方标注弱酸性、无香料、无着色、无酒精（乙醇）、无对羟基苯甲酸酯类防腐剂、无矿物油。
ingredients.en: Built on 8 named forms of hyaluronic acid — Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid (C12-13 Alkyl Glyceryl Ether), Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer, Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate, Sodium Hyaluronate, Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Lactobacillus/Hyaluronic Acid Ferment Filtrate, and Sodium Hydrolyzed Hyaluronate — plus base moisturizers like glycerin and butylene glycol. The brand states the formula is mildly acidic, fragrance-free, colorant-free, alcohol-free, paraben-free, and mineral-oil-free.

evidence.zh: 官方描述以"美容液级保湿""うるおいが続く"等体验性表述为主，未见公开的独立临床测试数据、样本量或百分比改善数值；品牌页面展示了消费者证言式好评，属于主观感受分享而非量化测试。
evidence.en: Official description leans on experiential phrasing ("serum-level hydration," "lasting moisture") rather than published independent clinical data, sample sizes, or percentage-improvement figures; the brand page features consumer testimonial quotes, which are subjective impressions rather than quantified testing.

packaging.zh: 白瓶配蓝绿色标签延续肌研一贯的药妆临床感视觉，第一眼传递"高浓度成分、专业配方"的印象，而非精品化妆水的仪式感包装路线。
packaging.en: The white bottle with a blue-green label continues Hada Labo's drugstore-clinical visual language, reading as high-concentration, formula-driven at first glance rather than a ritual-object premium bottle.

insight.zh:
这支化妆水最厉害的地方，是把"透明质酸"这个用烂的词重新讲出了新故事。

* 给同质化成分拆出八个角色：8种玻尿酸形态各自有名字和功能定位（3D玻尿酸负责锁水、纳米化玻尿酸负责渗透、乳酸发酵玻尿酸负责温和），把一个同质化严重的成分拆成了8个有台词的角色。
* 用配方复杂度撑住中间价位：定位卡在基础款"极润"和顶级抗老线中间，用配方复杂度而不是主打成分种类去撑起中间价位，让消费者有理由从入门款升级。
* 竞品选了CeraVe（皮肤科学背书）、Naturie（极简单一成分）、Beauty of Joseon（韩系人参叙事）三个完全不同的差异化路径，说明玻尿酸这个成分本身已经很难单独形成差异化，必须靠叙事方式取胜。

战略启示：一个被用滥的成分词，可以靠拆分成多个带功能名字的分子形态重新讲出新故事，不需要换成分本身。
insight.en:
This lotion's biggest strength is retelling the overused word "hyaluronic acid" as a new story.

* Splits a commoditized ingredient into eight characters: eight forms of hyaluronic acid each get a name and functional role (3D Hyaluronic Acid for moisture lock, Nano Hyaluronic Acid for penetration, Lactic Acid-Fermented Hyaluronic Acid for gentleness), turning one over-commoditized ingredient into eight named roles.
* Formula complexity supports a mid-tier price: positioned between the basic Gokujyun line and the top anti-aging line, using formula complexity rather than a headline ingredient to justify the mid-tier price, giving consumers a reason to upgrade.
* Its competitors, CeraVe (dermatological endorsement), Naturie (minimalist single ingredient), and Beauty of Joseon (Korean ginseng narrative), take three entirely different differentiation paths, showing hyaluronic acid alone can barely differentiate anymore — the narrative has to do the work.

Strategic takeaway: an overused ingredient word can be retold as a new story by splitting it into multiple named molecular forms, without changing the ingredient itself.

name.zh: 毛穴撫子 大米面膜
name.en: Keana Nadeshiko Rice Mask

brand.zh: 毛穴撫子（Keana Nadeshiko）お米シリーズ

company.zh: 石泽研究所株式会社
company.en: Ishizawa Laboratories, Inc.

launch.zh: 2015年11月首发，2025年迎来发售10周年，累计销量突破5亿枚
launch.en: First launched November 2015, marking its 10th anniversary in 2025, with cumulative sales exceeding 500 million sheets

market.zh: 日本药妆连锁、LOFT、Hands、PLAZA、石泽研究所官方商城，是访日游客热门伴手礼
market.en: Japanese drugstore chains, LOFT, Hands, PLAZA, Ishizawa Labs' official shop; a popular souvenir among inbound tourists to Japan

positioning.zh: "毛穴撫子 お米シリーズ"的核心面膜单品，主打100%日本国产大米来源的"Rice Serum ライスセラム"复合保湿成分（米发酵液、米糠提取物、米糠神经酰胺、米糠油），针对干燥导致毛孔明显的肌肤。厚实亲肤的日本制无纺布材质是产品另一大卖点。2015年发售以来长期占据日本大米面膜品类的国民度地位，是石泽研究所旗下增长最快的单品之一。
positioning.en: The core mask in the Keana Nadeshiko Rice Series, built around a proprietary "Rice Serum" complex (100% Japan-sourced) — rice ferment filtrate, rice bran extract, rice bran ceramide, and rice bran oil — targeting skin where dryness makes pores look more prominent. A thick, skin-friendly Japan-made nonwoven sheet material is another key selling point. Since its 2015 launch, it has held a near-iconic status in Japan's rice-based sheet mask category and is one of Ishizawa Labs' fastest-growing single items.

target.zh: 干燥导致毛穴明显的人群；追求高性价比、日常可负担的日常护理型面膜的消费者；敏感肌、追求厚实贴合感面膜的用户。
target.en: Consumers whose dryness makes pores appear more prominent; those seeking an affordable, everyday-usable mask; sensitive-skin users who prefer a thick, well-adhering sheet.

distribution.zh: 10枚/¥715，单片约¥71.5，是日本面膜品类里极具性价比的大众价位，另有28枚装大容量BOX（2020年推出）和170g的"お米のパック"（免洗涂抹式）可选。
distribution.en: 10 sheets at ¥715, about ¥71.5 per sheet — a highly cost-effective mass-market price in Japan's sheet mask category. A 28-sheet value box (launched 2020) and a 170g leave-on "Rice Pack" (no-rinse spreadable format) are also available.

ingredients.zh: 水、甘油、PG、乙醇、米发酵液（ライスセラム：米发酵液）、水解米糠提取物（ライスセラム：米糠提取物）、米糠鞘糖脂（ライスセラム：米糠神经酰胺）、米糠油（ライスセラム：米糠油）、(苯乙烯/VP)共聚物、BG、氢化卵磷脂、氢化溶血磷脂、戊二醇、精氨酸、黄原胶、聚山梨醇酯80、柠檬酸、柠檬酸钠、苯氧乙醇、羟苯甲酯。
ingredients.en: Water, Glycerin, PG, Alcohol, Rice Ferment Filtrate (Rice Serum), Hydrolyzed Rice Bran Extract (Rice Serum), Rice Bran Sphingoglycolipid (Rice Serum), Rice Bran Oil (Rice Serum), (Styrene/VP) Copolymer, BG, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Hydrogenated Lysolecithin, Pentylene Glycol, Arginine, Xanthan Gum, Polysorbate 80, Citric Acid, Sodium Citrate, Phenoxyethanol, Methylparaben.

evidence.zh: 官方证据以品牌自行开展的消费者问卷调查为主（2025年调查，回答数83人）：68.7%的用户将其作为日常护肤流程的一部分，27.7%用于犒赏自己的放松时刻，25.3%用于肌肤干燥等特殊护理场景；页面同时展示了多条消费者证言式好评，均标注为个人感想、效果因人而异，未见独立第三方临床测试数据。
evidence.en: The official evidence is primarily the brand's own consumer survey (conducted 2025, 83 respondents): 68.7% use it as part of their daily skincare routine, 27.7% for a relaxing treat, and 25.3% for special-care occasions like dryness. The page also features multiple consumer testimonial quotes, each labeled as a personal impression with effects varying by individual; no independent third-party clinical data was found.

packaging.zh: 粉色调配可爱风LOGO与卡通形象，第一眼传递"平价、亲切、少女感"的调性，跟专业美容液面膜的克制包装形成鲜明反差，货架识别度很高。
packaging.en: A pink-toned package with a cute logo and cartoon mascot reads as affordable, friendly, and girlish at first glance, a sharp contrast to the restrained packaging of premium serum-style masks, giving it strong shelf recognition.

insight.zh:
这片面膜靠一个谐音梗撑起了10年、5亿枚的销量。

* 品牌名本身是可传播的语言游戏："毛穴撫子"戏仿"毛穴無子"（没有明显毛孔的女孩），用轻松好记的品牌叙事代替严肃的成分功效宣讲。
* 命名比成分本身更抓眼球：米系保湿成分在市场上并不稀缺，大量同类面膜都在用类似配方，真正撑起差异化的是命名和厚实亲肤的材质体验。
* 竞品选了SK-II（高端专柜）、MEDIHEAL（韩系大众）、Biodance（近年爆红水凝胶）三个完全不同价位段和渠道的对手，说明这片面膜靠品牌资产而非成分壁垒，在多个层级都有辨识度。

战略启示：在一个高度同质化的品类里，一个好记的品牌名本身就可以是最持久的差异化资产，比反复更新成分配方更能撑起长销地位。
insight.en:
This sheet mask has sustained a 10-year, 500-million-unit run on the strength of a wordplay pun.

* The brand name itself is a shareable language game: "Keana Nadeshiko" puns on "pore-less girl," swapping serious ingredient-efficacy messaging for a light, memorable brand story.
* The name grabs attention more than the ingredients: rice-based moisturizing ingredients aren't scarce, plenty of similar masks use comparable formulas; the naming and thick, skin-friendly material are what actually build differentiation.
* Its competitors, SK-II (prestige counter), MEDIHEAL (Korean mass), and Biodance (a recently viral hydrogel), span entirely different price tiers and channels, showing this mask has recognition across multiple levels through brand equity rather than an ingredient moat.

Strategic takeaway: in a highly commoditized category, a memorable brand name can itself be the most durable differentiation asset, more so than repeatedly reformulating.
